AI.title_translation: MSP：用于无需配对跨模态数据训练多模态大语言模型的模态自我博弈
AI.tldr: MSP提出了一种基于代理文本作为语义桥梁的模态自我博弈框架，无需真实的非文本配对跨模态数据即可实现零样本多模态组合与推理。
AI.motivation: 现有大型多模态模型严重依赖海量配对的多模态数据，但高质量对齐数据集构建成本高昂且难以扩展到各种模态组合，成为阻碍模型进一步发展的根本瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了模态自我博弈（MSP）框架，基于代理介导的模态组合：在给定某一种已观测模态（如图像或音频）时，模型生成互补未观测模态的代理文本描述作为语义桥梁，再通过预训练对比编码器及学习到的桥梁将其与已观测模态进行编码与对齐，从而无需真实非文本成对监督即可实现跨模态交互。
AI.result: MSP实现了零样本模态组合，在推理阶段能直接整合并推理未曾配对训练的多种模态；在多个多模态基准评测中达到了最先进（SOTA）或具有竞争力的表现；消融实验证明了学习桥梁和代理文本描述对对齐与组合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MSP有效消除了训练多模态大模型时对真实非文本跨模态配对数据的依赖，仅通过模态-文本对、预训练对比编码器和模态分布桥梁校准，即可使模型具备强大的零样本多模态组合推理能力。
AI.translation: 大型多模态模型通过扩展模型容量并在海量配对多模态数据上进行训练，取得了显著进展。然而，这一范式带来了一个根本性瓶颈：对齐的多模态数据集构建成本高昂，难以扩展到多样化的模态组合中，并日益制约着进一步的发展。我们提出了模态自我博弈（MSP），这是一种基于代理介导的模态组合的多模态基座模型训练框架。MSP无需依赖配对的跨模态数据，而是在训练期间使用支持锚点的未见模态代理文本描述作为语义桥梁。给定一个已观测到的模态（例如图像或音频），模型会为互补的未见模态生成代理描述，随后通过学习到的桥梁对这些描述进行编码并与已观测模态对齐，从而在没有真实配对的非文本监督的情况下实现跨模态交互。我们的核心假设是：代理文本结合经对比训练的预训练编码器，能够为多模态组合的涌现提供充足的语义结构。我们证明了MSP能够实现零样本模态组合：仅使用真实锚点模态和伴随的代理描述进行训练的模型，尽管在训练期间从未观测到真实的非文本配对数据，但依然可以在推理时整合多种模态并进行推理。在实证方面，MSP在多个多模态基准测试上取得了最先进或极具竞争力的性能。消融实验进一步表明，学习到的桥梁改善了对齐效果，而支持锚点的代理描述则实现了有效的跨模态组合。MSP消除了对真实非文本（例如音-视）配对监督的需求，同时继续依赖模态-文本对、预训练对比编码器以及模态分布桥梁校准。
AI.summary: 针对多模态模型训练中成对跨模态数据匮乏与昂贵的难题，本研究提出了模态自我博弈（MSP）框架。MSP通过利用代理文本描述充当未见模态的语义桥梁，结合预训练对比编码器进行对齐，成功在没有真实非文本配对监督的情况下实现了跨模态学习与零样本模态组合，并在多项基准上取得了优异性能。
AI.keywords: 模态自我博弈 (Modality Self-Play), 多模态大语言模型 (Multimodal LLMs), 跨模态对齐 (Cross-Modal Alignment), 零样本模态组合 (Zero-Shot Modality Composition)
AI.comments: 创新性与重要性：该论文创新性地摆脱了对昂贵、难以采集的真实非文本多模态配对数据（如音-视对）的依赖，提出利用文本作为语义代理桥梁和自我博弈机制来实现跨模态对齐与组合，为可扩展的多模态模型训练提供了全新范式。局限性：正如文中所述，该方法仍依赖于模态-文本对、预训练对比编码器以及模态分布的桥梁校准，若代理文本存在语义偏差可能会影响最终跨模态推理的准确性。

title: A Coupled Fluid Naghdi Shell Windkessel Model for Pulmonary Artery Banding: Partitioned Numerical Scheme and Parameter Estimation
summary:
We develop a 3D fluid structure interaction model for blood flow through deformable vessels with localized constrictions, motivated by pulmonary artery banding in neonates with congenital heart disease. The model couples incompressible Navier Stokes equations in an Arbitrary Lagrangian Eulerian framework with a Naghdi shell model for the arterial wall and a three element Windkessel model for downstream circulation. The shell describes a 3D cylindrical vessel wall with variable radius and is defined on a 2D reference domain. Its low regularity formulation retains membrane, bending, and transverse shear deformation while requiring only first derivatives of the reference midsurface, accommodating piecewise smooth geometries with discontinuous surface slopes.
  We derive the coupled variational formulation and develop a non-iterative partitioned scheme with a Robin-type interface condition incorporating arterial wall inertia. For a linearized fixed domain problem, we establish a discrete energy estimate under suitable assumptions. A unscented Kalman filter estimates proximal and distal resistances and compliance from inlet-pressure observations. Numerical experiments demonstrate consistent pressure wave propagation and wall deformation under spatial and temporal refinement. Comparisons of the standard Naghdi shell and a modified, predominantly radial shell model reveal how structural deformation mechanisms affect wave speed and displacement. An idealized pulmonary artery banding example demonstrates the coupled fluid shell Windkessel model with parameter estimation. The framework enables investigation of the hemodynamic and mechanical effects of localized constrictions and their dependence on downstream vascular properties.

AI.title_translation: 肺动脉束带术的耦合流体Naghdi壳Windkessel模型：分区数值方案与参数估计
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个用于肺动脉束带术的3D流固耦合模型，结合Naghdi壳和Windkessel模型，并提出了一种分区数值方案和基于无迹卡尔曼滤波的参数估计方法，以研究局部血管收缩的血流动力学和力学效应。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机是针对患有先天性心脏病的新生儿进行肺动脉束带术，旨在开发一个框架来研究局部狭窄的血流动力学和力学效应及其对下游血管特性的依赖性。
AI.method: 研究开发了一个3D流固耦合模型，将任意拉格朗日-欧拉框架下的不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程与动脉壁的Naghdi壳模型和下游循环的三元Windkessel模型耦合。Naghdi壳模型描述了具有可变半径的3D圆柱形血管壁，并定义在2D参考域上。该方法导出了耦合变分公式，并开发了一种非迭代分区方案，其中包含结合动脉壁惯性的Robin型界面条件。此外，使用无迹卡尔曼滤波器根据入口压力观测值估计近端和远端阻力及顺应性。
AI.result: 数值实验证明了在空间和时间细化下，压力波传播和壁变形的一致性。标准Naghdi壳模型与改进的、主要径向壳模型的比较揭示了结构变形机制如何影响波速和位移。一个理想化的肺动脉束带示例展示了耦合流体壳Windkessel模型及其参数估计功能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够研究局部狭窄的血流动力学和力学效应及其对下游血管特性的依赖性。
AI.translation:
我们开发了一个3D流固耦合模型，用于通过局部收缩的可变形血管中的血流，其灵感来源于先天性心脏病新生儿的肺动脉束带术。该模型将任意拉格朗日-欧拉框架下的不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程与动脉壁的Naghdi壳模型和下游循环的三元Windkessel模型耦合。该壳模型描述了具有可变半径的3D圆柱形血管壁，并定义在2D参考域上。其低正则性公式保留了薄膜、弯曲和横向剪切变形，同时仅需要参考中面的第一个导数，从而适应具有不连续表面斜率的分段光滑几何形状。
我们推导了耦合变分公式，并开发了一种非迭代分区方案，其中包含结合动脉壁惯性的Robin型Robin型界面条件。对于线性化的固定域问题，我们在适当的假设下建立了离散能量估计。无迹卡尔曼滤波器根据入口压力观测值估计近端和远端阻力以及顺应性。数值实验证明了在空间和时间细化下，压力波传播和壁变形的一致性。标准Naghdi壳模型与改进的、主要径向壳模型的比较揭示了结构变形机制如何影响波速和位移。一个理想化的肺动脉束带示例展示了耦合流体壳Windkessel模型及其参数估计功能。该框架能够研究局部狭窄的血流动力学和力学效应及其对下游血管特性的依赖性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个用于肺动脉束带术的3D流固耦合模型，结合了Navier-Stokes方程、Naghdi壳模型和三元Windkessel模型。研究开发了一种非迭代分区数值方案，并利用无迹卡尔曼滤波器进行参数估计。数值实验验证了模型的有效性，并探讨了结构变形机制对波速和位移的影响，为研究局部血管狭窄的血流动力学和力学效应提供了工具。
AI.keywords: 流固耦合, Naghdi壳, Windkessel模型, 肺动脉束带术, 参数估计
AI.comments: 该论文在流固耦合建模方面具有创新性，特别是在结合Naghdi壳模型和Windkessel模型来模拟肺动脉束带术。其分区数值方案和参数估计方法为处理复杂的生物力学问题提供了实用的计算框架。该模型对于理解先天性心脏病中局部血管收缩的生理影响具有重要意义。

title: MIDI-REPA: Improving Text-to-Music Generation with Symbolic Representation Alignment
comments: 5 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Demo and code: https://midi-repa.vaclis.net
summary: State-of-the-art text-to-music models increasingly rely on scaling model capacity, data, and compute, while still learning musical structure directly from dense audio. Yet melody, rhythm, harmony, and structure can be represented compactly in symbolic form. We introduce MIDI-REPA, a representation-alignment framework that derives MIDI supervision from automatic music transcription (AMT) to align intermediate representations of a flow-matching DiT. Building on the 122M-parameter FluxAudio-S baseline from the 2026 ICME Academic Text-To-Music Challenge, we investigate what, where, and when to align. Aligning a MuScriptor-derived piano roll with an early DiT layer throughout the full flow trajectory performs the best. Without additional training data or techniques, MIDI-REPA remains competitive on the ATTM objective metrics while remaining trainable on a single RTX 3090 in about 31 hours. Our results highlight symbolic supervision as a simple and inexpensive learning signal for improving text-to-music generation. We release our transcription pipeline, JamendoMIDI, training code, and audio samples at https://midi-repa.vaclis.net.
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Demo and code: https://midi-repa.vaclis.net

AI.title_translation: MIDI-REPA：通过符号表示对齐改进文本到音乐生成
AI.tldr: MIDI-REPA通过从自动音乐转录中提取MIDI监督信号，对齐文本到音乐模型的中间表示，以改进生成质量，且训练成本低。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到音乐模型依赖于模型容量、数据和计算的扩展，但仍直接从密集音频中学习音乐结构，而旋律、节奏、和声和结构可以用符号形式紧凑表示。
AI.method: 引入MIDI-REPA，一个表示对齐框架。它从自动音乐转录（AMT）中导出MIDI监督信号，以对齐流匹配DiT模型的中间表示。研究了在FluxAudio-S基线上何时、何地以及如何对齐，发现将MuScriptor导出的钢琴卷与早期DiT层在整个流轨迹中对齐效果最佳。
AI.result: 在不增加额外训练数据或技术的情况下，MIDI-REPA在ATTM客观指标上保持竞争力，并且可以在单张RTX 3090上在大约31小时内完成训练。结果强调了符号监督作为一种简单且廉价的学习信号，可以改进文本到音乐生成。
AI.conclusion: 符号监督是一种简单且廉价的学习信号，可以有效改进文本到音乐生成模型。
AI.translation: 当前最先进的文本到音乐模型越来越依赖于扩展模型容量、数据和计算，同时仍然直接从密集音频中学习音乐结构。然而，旋律、节奏、和声和结构可以以符号形式紧凑地表示。我们引入了MIDI-REPA，一个表示对齐框架，它从自动音乐转录（AMT）中导出MIDI监督信号，以对齐流匹配DiT模型的中间表示。基于2026年ICME学术文本到音乐挑战赛的1.22亿参数FluxAudio-S基线，我们研究了何时、何地以及如何进行对齐。将MuScriptor导出的钢琴卷与早期DiT层在整个流轨迹中对齐表现最佳。在不增加额外训练数据或技术的情况下，MIDI-REPA在ATTM客观指标上保持竞争力，并且可以在大约31小时内在一张RTX 3090上进行训练。我们的结果强调了符号监督作为一种简单且廉价的学习信号，可以改进文本到音乐生成。我们在https://midi-repa.vaclis.net发布了我们的转录管道JamendoMIDI、训练代码和音频样本。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MIDI-REPA，一个用于改进文本到音乐生成的表示对齐框架。它利用自动音乐转录（AMT）生成的MIDI数据作为监督信号，对齐流匹配DiT模型的中间表示，从而在不增加模型规模或额外数据的情况下，有效提升生成质量。研究表明，在早期层对齐MuScriptor导出的钢琴卷效果最佳，且训练成本低廉。
AI.keywords: 文本到音乐生成, 符号表示对齐, MIDI监督, 自动音乐转录, DiT
AI.comments: 这项工作提出了一种新颖且高效的方法，通过引入符号表示对齐来改进文本到音乐生成，避免了对大规模模型和计算资源的过度依赖。其创新点在于利用廉价的MIDI监督信号指导模型学习音乐结构，这为未来的文本到音乐生成研究提供了新的方向。低训练成本也是其重要优势。

title: SOMA: Stack-of-Objects Manipulation using a Quadruped Robot
summary: Executing heavy-duty physical manipulation in unpredictable environments remains a major challenge for quadrupedal robots lacking dedicated manipulators. This paper presents SOMA, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for whole-body non-prehensile manipulation of multi-object stacks using a quadruped robot. Unlike traditional methods restricted to two-dimensional planar pushing, SOMA integrates explicit robot base-height control, unlocking full three-dimensional pushing strategies. This capability enables the quadruped to manipulate complex payload stacks as a unified system while preventing relative sliding or tipping of upper layers. The architecture factorizes control into a high-level manipulation policy using a Simplified Structured State Space Sequence (S5) encoder to reason over long-horizon temporal history and predict bounded target tracking commands via Beta distributions, and a low-level locomotion policy that dynamically adapts leg stance configurations. In extensive simulation benchmarks, SOMA achieves a $90.3\%$ success rate for single-object reposing and up to $90.1\%$ for dynamic two-box stacks under stringent error margins ($0.05\text{ m}$ position error, $1^\circ$ orientation error). Finally, we validate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree Go1 quadruped robot across diverse payload masses and geometries, demonstrating active base-height adjustments to maintain traction and balance during heavy pushing tasks.

AI.title_translation: SOMA：使用四足机器人的物体堆叠操作
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SOMA的分层强化学习框架，使无机械臂的四足机器人能够通过全身协同操作实现复杂三维物体堆叠的精确非抓取推动。
AI.motivation: 解决缺乏专用机械臂的四足机器人在不可预测环境中执行重型物理操作的巨大挑战，突破传统二维平面推动的限制。
AI.method: 提出一个分层强化学习框架，包含使用S5编码器的高层操作策略（预测有界目标跟踪命令）和动态调整腿部姿态的低层运动策略。
AI.result: 在仿真基准测试中，单物体重新摆放成功率达到90.3%，动态双箱堆叠成功率高达90.1%；并在Unitree Go1四足机器人上成功验证了零样本Sim-to-Real迁移。
AI.conclusion: SOMA框架成功实现了四足机器人在无专用机械臂情况下的重载非抓取堆叠操作，具备极高的成功率和零样本Sim-to-Real泛化能力。
AI.translation: 在缺乏专用机械臂的情况下，在不可预测环境中执行重型物理操作仍然是四足机器人的一大挑战。本文提出了SOMA，这是一个用于四足机器人对多物体堆叠进行全身非抓取操作的分层强化学习框架。与局限于二维平面推动的传统方法不同，SOMA集成了显式的机器人底盘高度控制，解锁了全三维推动策略。该能力使四足机器人能够将复杂的负载堆叠作为统一系统进行操作，同时防止上层相对滑动或倾斜。该架构将控制分解为：高层操作策略，利用简化结构状态空间序列（S5）编码器来推理长期时间历史并通过Beta分布预测有界目标跟踪命令；低层运动策略，动态调整腿部姿态配置。在广泛的仿真基准测试中，SOMA在严格的误差范围内（0.05米位置误差，1度方向误差），单物体重新摆放的成功率达到了90.3%，动态双箱堆叠的成功率高达90.1%。最后，我们在Unitree Go1四足机器人在各种负载质量和几何形状下验证了零样本模拟到真实的迁移，证明了在重型推动任务中主动调整底盘高度以维持牵引力和平衡的能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SOMA，一个通过四足机器人进行多物体堆叠整体非抓取操作的分层强化学习框架。通过集成显式的机器人底盘高度控制和长视角的S5编码器策略，实现了全三维推动策略，并在仿真和真实机器人的重载任务中展现了优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 四足机器人, 物理操作, 分层强化学习, 机器人底盘高度控制, 零样本迁移
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种无机械臂四足机器人进行多物体堆叠操作的分层强化学习框架，突破了传统平面推动的限制，实现了三维空间内的复杂物理操作，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其有效性。

title: Integer-Free Control Synthesis for Signal Temporal Logic via Ranked Implicants
summary: This paper proposes an integer-free method for control synthesis of nonlinear discrete-time systems under finite-horizon Signal Temporal Logic (STL) constraints. Instead of introducing integer variables, we consider the discrete choices of the specification in a ranked order and solve a standard nonlinear program for each selected choice until a satisfying trajectory is found. We first define implicants as sets of timed atomic constraints whose joint satisfaction is sufficient to satisfy the specification. A reference trajectory obtained from a smooth approximation of the STL robustness is used to rank these implicants. Fixing one implicant turns the problem into a standard nonlinear program with no auxiliary weights or bilinear terms. If the solution does not satisfy the specification, the next implicant will be considered. We prove soundness and completeness of our method relative to the nonlinear programming solver. Numerical evaluation on nonlinear multi-agent systems shows that our proposed method identifies satisfying trajectories where the exact continuous reformulation fails, and moreover, it is faster than a mixed-integer formulation of the same specification.

AI.title_translation: 基于排序蕴涵项的信号时序逻辑无整数控制综合
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于信号时序逻辑(STL)控制综合的无整数方法，通过排序蕴涵项和顺序非线性规划，优于混合整数和精确连续重构方法。
AI.motivation: 现有信号时序逻辑(STL)约束下的控制综合方法常引入整数变量，导致混合整数规划等复杂问题。本文旨在避免使用整数变量。
AI.method: 本文提出一种无整数方法。该方法按排序顺序考虑规范的离散选择。它定义“蕴涵项”为一组定时原子约束，其联合满足足以满足规范。利用STL鲁棒性平滑近似得到的参考轨迹对这些蕴涵项进行排序。固定一个蕴涵项后，问题转化为一个标准的无辅助权重或双线性项的非线性规划。如果解不满足规范，则考虑下一个蕴涵项。该方法相对于非线性规划求解器被证明是完备且可靠的。
AI.result: 在非线性多智能体系统上的数值评估表明，该方法能够识别出精确连续重构方法失败的满意轨迹，并且比相同规范的混合整数公式更快。
AI.conclusion: 提出的无整数方法，通过排序蕴涵项和顺序非线性规划，是解决信号时序逻辑(STL)约束下非线性离散时间系统控制综合的有效且高效的方法，优于现有的精确连续和混合整数公式。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种在有限时间范围内，针对信号时序逻辑（STL）约束下的非线性离散时间系统进行控制综合的无整数方法。我们不引入整数变量，而是按排序顺序考虑规范的离散选择，并为每个选定的选择求解一个标准的非线性规划，直到找到一个满意的轨迹。我们首先将蕴涵项定义为一组定时原子约束，其联合满足足以满足规范。利用从STL鲁棒性平滑近似获得的参考轨迹来对这些蕴涵项进行排序。固定一个蕴涵项将问题转化为一个没有辅助权重或双线性项的标准非线性规划。如果解决方案不满足规范，则考虑下一个蕴涵项。我们证明了该方法相对于非线性规划求解器的完备性和可靠性。在非线性多智能体系统上的数值评估表明，我们提出的方法能够识别出精确连续重构方法失败的满意轨迹，并且比相同规范的混合整数公式更快。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种新颖的无整数控制综合方法，用于信号时序逻辑(STL)约束下的非线性离散时间系统。该方法通过对离散规范选择（蕴涵项）进行排序并求解顺序非线性规划来避免使用整数变量。该方法能够在连续重构方法失效的情况下找到满意轨迹，并且比混合整数公式更快。
AI.keywords: 无整数控制, 信号时序逻辑, 非线性控制, 排序蕴涵项, 控制综合
AI.comments: 创新点在于避免了通常计算成本高昂的混合整数规划中的整数变量。使用排序蕴涵项和顺序非线性规划是处理离散选择而不增加整数开销的巧妙方法。其性能的提升以及解决其他方法失败问题的能力凸显了其重要性。

title: When a robot can trust reversing wind to find an odour source
summary: A wind-derived heading can guide a robot towards an odour source even after the wind reverses, but its reliability depends on the plume's transport history. On a quadruped initially facing the source, holding the initial heading reached it in every reversing-wind trial, whereas comparison controllers never settled there. An exact geometric condition links heading correctness to net odour transport, and simulations separate sensing error from departures from nominal flow. Where the alternating wind directions are too close for reversal alone to produce wrong-side headings, the wrong-side rate rises from 1.0% under uniform transport to 4.7% in a stochastic flow. Re-acquiring headings from new odour contact improves simulated search when contact is intermittent. These results identify distinct requirements for wind-guided search: a heading supported by the transport geometry and sufficient intermittent contact to replace it.

AI.title_translation: 机器人何时能相信逆风来寻找气味源
AI.tldr: 机器人可以利用逆风导向寻找气味源，但其可靠性取决于气流传输历史，需要结合几何条件和间歇性气味接触来优化搜索。
AI.motivation: 研究机器人如何利用风向信息，即使在风向逆转的情况下，也能可靠地找到气味源，并探究其可靠性受气味羽流传输历史的影响。
AI.method: 1. 在四足机器人上进行实验，测试在逆风条件下保持初始方向的导航效果。 2. 建立精确的几何条件来关联方向正确性与净气味传输。 3. 通过模拟将传感误差与偏离标称流动的误差分开。 4. 模拟在不同风流（均匀传输、随机流）下，当交替风向接近时，错误方向的发生率。 5. 模拟间歇性气味接触下重新获取方向对搜索的改善。
AI.result: 1. 在逆风试验中，四足机器人保持初始方向总能到达气味源，而其他控制器则不能。 2. 几何条件将方向正确性与净气味传输联系起来。 3. 模拟区分了传感误差和偏离标称流动的误差。 4. 在交替风向接近时，随机流中的错误方向率（4.7%）高于均匀传输（1.0%）。 5. 当气味接触是间歇性时，重新获取方向可以改善模拟搜索。
AI.conclusion: 风引导搜索需要两个明确条件：一个由传输几何支持的方向，以及足够的间歇性气味接触来更新方向。
AI.translation: 风导向可以引导机器人找到气味源，即使在风向逆转之后，但其可靠性取决于气味羽流的传输历史。在一个最初面向气味源的四足机器人上，在每次逆风试验中，保持初始方向都能使其到达气味源，而对比控制器则从未稳定在那里。一个精确的几何条件将方向的正确性与净气味传输联系起来，并且模拟将传感误差与偏离标称流动的误差分开。当交替风向太接近以至于仅凭逆转无法产生错误方向时，在均匀传输下错误方向率从1.0%上升到随机流中的4.7%。当气味接触是间歇性时，从新的气味接触中重新获取方向可以改善模拟搜索。这些结果确定了风引导搜索的独特要求：一个由传输几何支持的方向，以及足够的间歇性接触来替换它。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了机器人在逆风条件下寻找气味源的可靠性。通过四足机器人实验和模拟，发现风导向的有效性依赖于气味羽流的传输历史。研究建立了方向正确性与净气味传输之间的几何条件，并量化了不同风流模式下的错误方向率。结果表明，保持由传输几何支持的方向，并结合间歇性气味接触来重新获取方向，是实现高效风引导搜索的关键。
AI.keywords: 机器人导航, 气味追踪, 逆风, 几何条件, 间歇性接触
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个几何条件来解释风导向在逆风条件下的可靠性，并通过实验和模拟验证了其有效性。它强调了气味羽流传输历史的重要性，并指出了在实际应用中，需要结合初始方向的保持和间歇性气味接触来优化搜索策略。这对于开发更鲁棒的自主气味追踪机器人具有重要意义。

title: PiCo: Physics-Informed Concept Probing for Geo-Foundation Models
summary: Geo-foundation models (GFMs) are typically evaluated by downstream task predictive performance, revealing little about which physical features they are sensitive to or use in prediction. This limits developers' ability to test hypotheses about model behaviour and users' ability to select models for new tasks. We propose Physics-Informed Concept Probing (PiCo), a post-hoc framework for explaining GFM predictions. PiCo identifies concept vectors in a GFM's embedding space by generating synthetic multispectral satellite observations from a 3D radiative transfer model coupled with a game engine. These vectors reveal physical sensitivities that inform domain-based hypotheses about downstream performance. Projecting embeddings onto these concept vectors produces low-dimensional representations for quantifying concept importance in making predictions. We evaluate PiCo on three GFMs with different input modalities using seven physical concepts covering forest leaf optics and canopy structure. In ground-cover estimation, RGB restriction reduces dry-matter sensitivity and disproportionately degrades predictions for dry vegetation and bare ground, supporting a hypothesis derived from sensitivity analysis. For hierarchical forest type and tree species classification, concept representations retain 70.0-93.8% of full-embedding accuracy. Models capture similar physical contrasts between classes, such as structural differences between broadleaf forest and cleared ground and leaf-water-content differences between oak and beech, yet differ in the strength of these contrasts and the concepts driving classification. PiCo thus provides a physical basis for hypothesis testing and model assessment, with potential applicability beyond Earth observation wherever forward models enable controlled simulation and pretrained embeddings are accessible for probing.

AI.title_translation: PiCo：地球基础模型的物理信息概念探测
AI.tldr: PiCo是一个后验框架，用于解释地球基础模型(GFMs)的预测。它通过合成数据识别GFM嵌入空间中的物理概念向量，从而揭示模型对物理特征的敏感性，支持假设检验和模型评估。
AI.motivation: 地球基础模型（GFMs）通常通过下游任务的预测性能进行评估，但很少揭示它们对哪些物理特征敏感或在预测中使用了哪些物理特征。这限制了开发者测试模型行为假设的能力，也限制了用户为新任务选择模型的能力。
AI.method: 本文提出了PiCo（Physics-Informed Concept Probing），一个用于解释GFM预测的后验框架。PiCo通过结合3D辐射传输模型和游戏引擎生成合成多光谱卫星观测数据，从而在GFM的嵌入空间中识别概念向量。这些向量揭示了物理敏感性，为基于领域的下游性能假设提供了信息。将嵌入投影到这些概念向量上，可以产生低维表示，用于量化概念在预测中的重要性。
AI.result: PiCo在三种不同输入模态的GFM上，使用七个涵盖森林叶片光学和冠层结构的物理概念进行了评估。在地表覆盖估计中，RGB限制降低了对干物质的敏感性，并导致对干燥植被和裸地的预测性能不成比例地下降，这支持了通过敏感性分析得出的假设。对于分层森林类型和树种分类，概念表示保留了全嵌入精度的70.0-93.8%。模型捕获了类别之间相似的物理对比，例如阔叶林与 cleared ground 之间的结构差异，以及橡树和山毛榉之间的叶片含水量差异，但在这些对比的强度和驱动分类的概念上有所不同。
AI.conclusion: PiCo为假设检验和模型评估提供了物理基础，并且在地球观测之外，只要正向模型能够实现受控模拟且预训练嵌入可用于探测，就具有潜在的适用性。
AI.translation: 地球基础模型（GFMs）通常通过下游任务的预测性能进行评估，这很少揭示它们对哪些物理特征敏感或在预测中使用了哪些物理特征。这限制了开发者测试模型行为假设的能力，也限制了用户为新任务选择模型的能力。我们提出了物理信息概念探测（PiCo），一个用于解释GFM预测的后验框架。PiCo通过结合3D辐射传输模型和游戏引擎生成合成多光谱卫星观测数据，从而在GFM的嵌入空间中识别概念向量。这些向量揭示了物理敏感性，为基于领域的下游性能假设提供了信息。将嵌入投影到这些概念向量上，可以产生低维表示，用于量化概念在预测中的重要性。我们使用涵盖森林叶片光学和冠层结构的七个物理概念，在三种不同输入模态的GFM上评估了PiCo。在地表覆盖估计中，RGB限制降低了对干物质的敏感性，并导致对干燥植被和裸地的预测性能不成比例地下降，这支持了通过敏感性分析得出的假设。对于分层森林类型和树种分类，概念表示保留了全嵌入精度的70.0-93.8%。模型捕获了类别之间相似的物理对比，例如阔叶林与 cleared ground 之间的结构差异，以及橡树和山毛榉之间的叶片含水量差异，但在这些对比的强度和驱动分类的概念上有所不同。因此，PiCo为假设检验和模型评估提供了物理基础，并且在地球观测之外，只要正向模型能够实现受控模拟且预训练嵌入可用于探测，就具有潜在的适用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PiCo（Physics-Informed Concept Probing），一个用于解释地球基础模型（GFMs）预测的后验框架。PiCo通过结合物理模型和游戏引擎生成合成卫星数据，以识别GFM嵌入空间中的物理概念向量，从而揭示模型对特定物理特征的敏感性。通过将嵌入投影到这些概念向量上，可以量化概念在预测中的重要性。实验证明，PiCo能够揭示模型在不同物理概念上的行为，例如RGB限制对干物质敏感性的影响，以及模型如何捕获不同森林类型和树种间的物理对比。PiCo为GFM的假设检验和模型评估提供了一个物理驱动的解释方法，并具有广泛的适用潜力。
AI.keywords: 地球基础模型, 可解释性AI, 物理信息, 概念探测, 遥感
AI.comments: PiCo提供了一种创新方法，通过引入物理信息概念探测来提高地球基础模型的可解释性。其核心创新在于利用物理模型和游戏引擎生成合成数据，从而在模型的嵌入空间中识别和量化物理概念的重要性。这对于理解模型的内部工作原理、测试领域假设以及在特定任务中选择最合适的模型至关重要。该方法的普适性也值得关注，因为它不仅限于地球观测领域，只要有正向模型和可访问的预训练嵌入，就可能适用。潜在的局限性可能在于合成数据生成的复杂性以及概念向量识别的鲁棒性。

title: How to Train Your Little Dragon: Teaching a Small Language Model to Construct and Refine GPU Optimization Scripts
summary: Compiler transformations interact, making GPU kernel optimization a search for combinations that preserve the computation while improving performance. We introduce HOW TO TRAIN YOUR LITTLE DRAGON, a training method that teaches a small language model both to construct complete optimization scripts and to improve existing ones. Instead of ranking candidates or generating kernel code, our model generates optimization scripts. We devise a compact, lossless representation whose deterministic decoding reconstructs the exact compiler trace, preserving its transformation parameters and dependencies. We use a compiler framework TVM MetaSchedule to build training data on 54,116 distinct workloads, and construct 108,594 examples in two training sets: 60,236 teach the model to generate an optimized script from an unoptimized kernel, while 48,358 teach it to produce a better script given the kernel and a somewhat optimized script. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to construct and improve optimization scripts from these search-derived examples. We then add reinforcement learning with a shaped reward that combines correctness with measured performance, awarding a latency-based bonus only to numerically correct kernels. We apply this training method to a model with 8 billion parameters. After supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, the model achieves per-attempt correctness of 91.27% for construction and 92.01% for refinement, while reinforcement learning produces faster kernels than supervised training on 88 of 102 construction tasks and 145 of 170 refinement prompts. With only 8B parameters, our LITTLE DRAGON achieves higher per-attempt correctness and better kernel performance than six frontier LLMs: GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5, Kimi-K3, and GLM-5.3 among them, each with hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters, for which task-specific training is unavailable or expensive.

AI.title_translation: 如何训练你的小龙：教小型语言模型构建和优化GPU优化脚本
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种训练小型语言模型（8B参数）的方法，使其能够构建和改进GPU优化脚本，并通过监督微调和强化学习，在正确性和性能上超越了参数量大得多的前沿大型语言模型。
AI.motivation: GPU内核优化是一个寻找既能保持计算正确性又能提高性能的组合的过程，因为编译器转换之间存在交互。传统方法可能侧重于排名候选或生成内核代码，而本文旨在让小型语言模型直接生成和改进优化脚本，以应对这一挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种名为“如何训练你的小龙”的训练方法。该方法教导一个小型语言模型（80亿参数）构建完整的优化脚本并改进现有脚本。它不排名候选或生成内核代码，而是生成优化脚本。研究人员设计了一种紧凑、无损的表示方法，可以确定性地重建精确的编译器轨迹，保留其转换参数和依赖关系。他们使用TVM MetaSchedule编译器框架，在54,116个不同工作负载上构建了训练数据，并创建了108,594个训练示例，分为两个训练集：60,236个用于从非优化内核生成优化脚本，48,358个用于在给定内核和部分优化脚本的情况下生成更好的脚本。首先进行监督微调，然后通过强化学习进行训练，其中奖励机制结合了正确性和测量性能，仅对数值正确的内核给予基于延迟的奖励。
AI.result: 经过监督微调和强化学习后，该模型在构建任务上的每次尝试正确性达到91.27%，在改进任务上达到92.01%。强化学习在102个构建任务中的88个和170个改进提示中的145个上比监督训练产生了更快的内核。该80亿参数的模型在每次尝试正确性和内核性能方面均优于GPT-6 Astra、Opus 5、Kimi-K3和GLM-5.3等六个前沿大型语言模型，这些模型的参数量从数千亿到数万亿不等，且通常无法进行特定任务训练或成本高昂。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功开发并验证了一种训练小型语言模型（8B参数）的方法，使其能够有效构建和改进GPU优化脚本。该模型在正确性和性能上均超越了大型语言模型，证明了通过特定任务训练，小型语言模型在复杂代码优化任务中具有巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 编译器转换相互作用，使得GPU内核优化成为寻找既能保持计算又能提高性能的组合的过程。我们引入了“如何训练你的小龙”，这是一种训练方法，它教导一个小型语言模型既能构建完整的优化脚本，又能改进现有的脚本。我们的模型不是对候选方案进行排名或生成内核代码，而是生成优化脚本。我们设计了一种紧凑、无损的表示方法，其确定性解码可以重建精确的编译器轨迹，保留其转换参数和依赖关系。我们使用编译器框架TVM MetaSchedule在54,116个不同的工作负载上构建训练数据，并构建了108,594个示例，分为两个训练集：60,236个示例教模型从非优化内核生成优化脚本，而48,358个示例教模型在给定内核和部分优化脚本的情况下生成更好的脚本。监督微调教导模型从这些搜索派生的示例中构建和改进优化脚本。然后，我们添加了强化学习，其奖励机制结合了正确性和测量性能，仅对数值正确的内核给予基于延迟的奖励。我们将这种训练方法应用于一个拥有80亿参数的模型。经过监督微调和强化学习后，该模型在构建任务上的每次尝试正确性达到91.27%，在改进任务上达到92.01%，而强化学习在102个构建任务中的88个和170个改进提示中的145个上比监督训练产生了更快的内核。我们的“小龙”仅凭80亿参数，就实现了比六个前沿大型语言模型（其中包括GPT-6 Astra、Opus 5、Kimi-K3和GLM-5.3，它们各自拥有数千亿到数万亿参数，且无法进行特定任务训练或成本高昂）更高的每次尝试正确性和更好的内核性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“如何训练你的小龙”的新型训练方法，旨在教导一个80亿参数的小型语言模型（SLM）构建和改进GPU优化脚本。该方法通过监督微调学习从非优化内核生成优化脚本，并改进现有脚本，随后利用结合正确性和性能的强化学习进行优化。研究团队开发了一种紧凑的表示方法来精确重建编译器轨迹。实验结果表明，该SLM在优化脚本的构建和改进任务上实现了高正确率（91.27%和92.01%），并且在性能上超越了多个参数量大得多的前沿大型语言模型。
AI.keywords: GPU优化, 小型语言模型, 强化学习, 编译器优化, 脚本生成
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于其独特的方法，即训练一个小型语言模型直接生成和改进GPU优化脚本，而非传统的代码生成或候选排名。通过结合监督微调和基于性能的强化学习，该模型不仅实现了高正确性，还在性能上显著超越了参数量更大的通用LLM，这表明了在特定领域通过高效训练可以使小型模型达到甚至超越大型模型的性能。这对于资源受限的场景和提高领域特定任务的效率具有重要意义。

title: Cyclotron: A Recurrence Language for Expressing Interprocessor Communication
summary: We present Cyclotron, a compiler that expresses streaming dataflow algorithms using recurrence equations, which are then compiled to distributed topologies of interlinked processors. Our compiler lowers a language of recurrences over logical iteration spaces into per-processor programs of sends, receives, and computations. In these recurrences, data accesses are not limited to external accesses to memory; data can live separately on the iteration space itself, allowing internal points to communicate values directly with other points. Users specify this communication directly in the recurrence language, which allows them to express various communication patterns such as a nearest-neighbor systolic exchange, a one-to-all broadcast, a bidirectional split ring, or an asymmetric and piecewise broadcast pattern, which are often not supported by standard distributed linear algebra libraries. These recurrences describe the algorithm and communication independently of how they map onto the hardware. A programmer then chooses which dimensions execute across processors and which execute over time, without rewriting the entire program. Users only specify data dependencies across the iteration space, and the compiler safely generates a program, per process, with correct placement of both communication and computational operators according to the chosen space--time mapping. We evaluate distributed matrix multiplication, TRSM, Cholesky, and fused Cholesky--TRSM on up to 16 CPU nodes and 16 GPUs, comparing against ScaLAPACK, SLATE, and cuSolverMp. Cyclotron is competitive with and often outperforms these hand-optimized libraries; for Cholesky, the best communication strategy changes with problem size and architecture.

AI.title_translation: Cyclotron：一种表达处理器间通信的循环语言
AI.tldr: Cyclotron是一个编译器，它使用循环方程来表达流式数据流算法，并将其编译为互连处理器的分布式拓扑。它允许用户直接在循环语言中指定各种通信模式，并能自动生成正确的通信和计算操作，在分布式矩阵乘法等任务上表现优于现有手优化库。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式线性代数库通常不支持复杂的通信模式，且程序员需要手动处理硬件映射和通信。Cyclotron旨在提供一种更高级、更灵活的方式来表达和编译分布式数据流算法，以实现高效的处理器间通信。
AI.method: Cyclotron是一个编译器，它将基于逻辑迭代空间的循环语言转换为每个处理器的发送、接收和计算程序。它允许数据在迭代空间内直接通信，用户通过循环语言直接指定通信模式。编译器根据用户选择的空时映射，安全地为每个进程生成带有正确通信和计算操作符的程序。
AI.result: Cyclotron在分布式矩阵乘法、TRSM、Cholesky和融合Cholesky-TRSM等任务上，在多达16个CPU节点和16个GPU上进行了评估，并与ScaLAPACK、SLATE和cuSolverMp进行了比较。结果显示，Cyclotron与这些手优化库具有竞争力，并且通常表现优于它们。对于Cholesky，最佳通信策略会随问题规模和架构而变化。
AI.conclusion: Cyclotron提供了一种有效且灵活的方式来表达和编译分布式数据流算法及其复杂的通信模式，其性能与现有手优化库相当甚至更优，证明了使用循环语言进行分布式编程的潜力。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了Cyclotron，这是一个编译器，它使用循环方程来表达流式数据流算法，然后将其编译成互连处理器的分布式拓扑。我们的编译器将基于逻辑迭代空间的循环语言转换为每个处理器的发送、接收和计算程序。在这些循环中，数据访问不限于对外部内存的访问；数据可以独立存在于迭代空间本身，允许内部点直接与其他点通信值。用户直接在循环语言中指定这种通信，这使他们能够表达各种通信模式，例如最近邻近的同步交换、一对多广播、双向环形分裂或不对称分段广播模式，这些模式通常不被标准分布式线性代数库支持。这些循环描述了算法和通信，而与它们如何映射到硬件无关。然后，程序员选择哪些维度在处理器之间执行，哪些维度随时间执行，而无需重写整个程序。用户只需指定迭代空间中的数据依赖性，编译器就会根据所选的空时映射，为每个进程安全地生成一个具有正确通信和计算操作符的程序。我们在多达16个CPU节点和16个GPU上评估了分布式矩阵乘法、TRSM、Cholesky和融合Cholesky-TRSM，并与ScaLAPACK、SLATE和cuSolverMp进行了比较。Cyclotron与这些手优化库具有竞争力，并且通常表现优于它们；对于Cholesky，最佳通信策略会随问题规模和架构而变化。
AI.summary: Cyclotron是一个创新的编译器，它使用循环方程来描述流式数据流算法和处理器间通信。它允许用户在高级语言中直接指定复杂的通信模式，并自动将这些描述编译成高效的分布式程序，无需手动管理硬件映射。在与现有手优化库的比较中，Cyclotron在分布式线性代数任务上表现出竞争性甚至更优的性能。
AI.keywords: 分布式计算, 循环语言, 编译器, 处理器间通信, 数据流算法
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提供了一种基于循环语言的高级抽象，用于表达复杂的分布式数据流算法和处理器间通信。它将通信和计算的描述与硬件映射解耦，并通过编译器自动生成高效的分布式代码，这大大简化了分布式编程的复杂性。其在性能上超越手优化库的结果，证明了这种方法的有效性和潜力。这种方法对于需要定制通信模式的分布式计算尤其重要，因为这些模式往往不被标准库支持。

title: Near-Linear Preprocessing for Range Weighted Longest Increasing Subsequence Queries
summary: We give a deterministic data structure for range weighted longest increasing subsequence (LIS) queries on $n$ values with positive weights. Preprocessing takes $O(n\log^2 n)$ time and space. Value queries take $O(\log n)$ time, and an optimal subsequence of $k$ elements can be reported in $O(k + \log n)$ time. This resolves an open question on truly subquadratic preprocessing with polylogarithmic query time. The key is a single-crossing property of envelopes for value-separated endpoint sets, enabling $O(\log n)$-time persistent merges. The bounds assume constant-time exact addition and comparison of weights.

AI.title_translation: 范围加权最长递增子序列查询的近线性预处理
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于范围加权最长递增子序列 (LIS) 查询的确定性数据结构，实现了近线性的预处理时间和多对数查询时间，解决了该领域的一个开放问题。
AI.motivation: 解决关于具有多对数查询时间的真正次二次预处理的开放问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种确定性数据结构。关键是利用值分离端点集包络线的单交叉特性，从而实现 $O(\log n)$ 时间的持久合并。该方法假设权重的精确加法和比较是常数时间。
AI.result: 预处理需要 $O(n\log^2 n)$ 的时间和空间。值查询需要 $O(\log n)$ 的时间。报告包含 $k$ 个元素的最优子序列需要 $O(k + \log n)$ 的时间。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提供一种高效的数据结构，成功解决了关于范围加权最长递增子序列查询中次二次预处理和多对数查询时间的开放问题。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种确定性数据结构，用于对具有正权重的 $n$ 个值进行范围加权最长递增子序列 (LIS) 查询。预处理需要 $O(n\log^2 n)$ 的时间和空间。值查询需要 $O(\log n)$ 的时间，并且可以在 $O(k + \log n)$ 的时间内报告包含 $k$ 个元素的最优子序列。这解决了关于具有多对数查询时间的真正次二次预处理的开放问题。关键是值分离端点集包络线的单交叉特性，这使得 $O(\log n)$ 时间的持久合并成为可能。这些界限假设权重的精确加法和比较是常数时间。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种用于范围加权最长递增子序列 (LIS) 查询的确定性数据结构。该结构实现了 $O(n\log^2 n)$ 的近线性预处理时间和空间，以及 $O(\log n)$ 的值查询时间，报告最优子序列的时间为 $O(k + \log n)$。这一成果成功解决了该领域中关于次二次预处理和多对数查询时间的开放问题，其核心在于利用了包络线的单交叉特性以实现高效的持久合并。
AI.keywords: 范围加权LIS, 数据结构, 预处理, 查询, 子序列
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于解决了范围加权 LIS 查询中高效预处理和查询时间这一长期存在的开放问题。其关键洞察是利用包络线的单交叉特性来实现高效的持久合并，这对于需要快速查询加权数据序列的应用具有重要实际意义。

title: Do As I Do, Not As I Say: On-Policy Distillation Inherits the Teacher in Vision-Language Models
summary: Improving the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) often relies on post-training with supervision from stronger models. Two common strategies are supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which trains on teacher-generated demonstrations, and on-policy distillation (OPD), which provides teacher feedback on trajectories generated by the student itself. While OPD can be more data-efficient by supervising student-generated trajectories, it is unclear how the teacher's supervision at each state affects the student's learned behavior. To study this question, we conduct a controlled comparison of OPD and filtered SFT across data budgets and tasks where the teacher exhibits different levels of reliability, and analyze how these differences shape student accuracy and completion behavior. Across the two tasks, we find that OPD is effective only when the teacher remains reliable on student-generated trajectories. On ChartQA, where the teacher completes 99% of its solutions, OPD trained on only 10% of the data comes within 1.4 accuracy points of full-data SFT. In contrast, on Geometry3K, where the teacher fails to complete 22% of its solutions, OPD underperforms SFT by 7.9 points, with most of the gap explained by incomplete responses. More strikingly, starting OPD from an SFT student reduces its completion rate from 76% to 62%, effectively erasing the completion behavior learned through SFT. Filtering teacher demonstrations for completeness alone recovers much of SFT's advantage. These results show that on-policy supervision can transfer not only teacher knowledge but also persistent failure modes on student-visited states. Code is available at https://github.com/ffy208/opd-inherits-teacher-vlm.

AI.title_translation: 照我做的做，不要照我说的做：策略蒸馏在视觉-语言模型中继承了教师的特性
AI.tldr: 本研究发现，策略蒸馏（OPD）在视觉-语言模型中，不仅能传递教师的知识，还会继承教师在学生生成轨迹上的失败模式，导致学生在教师不可靠时表现不佳，甚至降低已学习的完成率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的推理能力提升通常依赖于使用更强模型的监督进行后训练。策略蒸馏（OPD）通过对学生自身生成的轨迹提供教师反馈，虽然在数据效率上可能更高，但目前尚不清楚教师在每个状态下的监督如何影响学生的学习行为。
AI.method: 我们对策略蒸馏（OPD）和过滤后的监督微调（SFT）进行了受控比较，评估了不同数据预算和教师可靠性水平下的任务表现。我们分析了这些差异如何影响学生的准确性和完成行为。
AI.result: 研究发现，OPD仅在教师对学生生成的轨迹保持可靠时才有效。在ChartQA任务中（教师99%的解决方案是完整的），OPD使用10%的数据即可达到全数据SFT的1.4个准确率点以内。然而，在Geometry3K任务中（教师22%的解决方案不完整），OPD比SFT低7.9个点，主要差距在于不完整的响应。更显著的是，从SFT学生开始进行OPD训练，其完成率从76%降至62%，有效地抹去了SFT学到的完成行为。仅通过完整性过滤教师演示即可恢复SFT的大部分优势。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，策略监督不仅可以传递教师知识，还可以传递教师在学生访问状态上的持久性失败模式。
AI.translation: 提高视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的推理能力通常依赖于使用更强模型的监督进行后训练。两种常见的策略是监督微调（SFT），它根据教师生成的演示进行训练，以及策略蒸馏（OPD），它对学生自身生成的轨迹提供教师反馈。虽然OPD通过监督学生生成的轨迹可能更具数据效率，但目前尚不清楚教师在每个状态下的监督如何影响学生的学习行为。为了研究这个问题，我们对OPD和过滤后的SFT在不同的数据预算和任务中进行了受控比较，这些任务中教师表现出不同程度的可靠性，并分析了这些差异如何影响学生的准确性和完成行为。在两项任务中，我们发现OPD仅在教师对学生生成的轨迹保持可靠时才有效。在ChartQA上，教师完成了99%的解决方案，OPD仅使用10%的数据就能达到全数据SFT的1.4个准确率点以内。相比之下，在Geometry3K上，教师未能完成22%的解决方案，OPD比SFT低7.9个点，其中大部分差距是由不完整响应造成的。更引人注目的是，从SFT学生开始进行OPD训练，其完成率从76%降至62%，有效地抹去了通过SFT学到的完成行为。仅通过完整性过滤教师演示即可恢复SFT的大部分优势。这些结果表明，策略监督不仅可以传递教师知识，还可以传递教师在学生访问状态上的持久性失败模式。代码可在https://github.com/ffy208/opd-inherits-teacher-vlm获取。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了视觉-语言模型中策略蒸馏（OPD）和监督微调（SFT）在教师可靠性不同时的表现。结果显示，OPD仅在教师对学生轨迹可靠时有效，否则会继承教师的失败模式，甚至降低学生的完成率。研究强调了在策略监督中教师质量的重要性，并指出过滤教师演示可以缓解OPD的缺点。
AI.keywords: 策略蒸馏, 视觉-语言模型, 教师可靠性, 失败模式, 监督微调
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了策略蒸馏（OPD）的一个重要但常被忽视的局限性：它不仅能传递教师的知识，还会将教师在特定状态下的失败模式传递给学生。这一发现对于理解和改进基于教师监督的强化学习和模型蒸馏方法具有重要意义。创新之处在于通过受控实验量化了这种“继承”效应，并明确指出教师的可靠性，特别是其完成行为，对学生学习效果的关键影响。这对于未来设计更鲁棒的蒸馏策略，例如结合教师行为过滤或更精细的反馈机制，提供了宝贵的指导。

title: DeSpatial: The devil of Agentic Spatial Reasoning Lies in 3D Itself
summary: Spatial agents have access to reconstruction and segmentation tools, yet inconsistent predictions and fragmented object identities can prevent their outputs from becoming reliable 3D scene information. A simple oracle experiment exposes this perception bottleneck: replacing tool-predicted perception with ground-truth 3D bounding boxes raises an agent to nearly full score across five object-centric VSI-Bench tasks, while retaining the same reasoning tools. Motivated by this finding, we believe the devil of spatial reasoning lies in 3D itself, and introduce DeSpatial(Devil of Spatial), which explicitly decomposes spatial understanding into perception and reasoning. DeSpatial has a shared 3D perception tool to reconcile independent perception outputs into a unified, metric, gravity-aligned 3D scene. This perception tool has two core components: a) a joint segmentation--depth co-refinement module that consolidates masks of the same object and removes projection artifacts caused by inconsistent segmentation and depth within a single frame; b) a cross-view instance fusion module that consolidate voxel-overlapping instances but not allowed to merge same-frame instances. This fusion module additionally fuses spatially disjoint fragments caused by insufficient multi-view observations, by checking their 3D structure and source mask appearance. After receiving the complete and unified 3D scene information, the agent chooses reasoning or computational tools to solve the spatial problem. DeSpatial achieves leading performance on VSI-Bench, MindCube-Tiny, and ViewSpatial, with additional long-video results on VSI-SUPER, revealing the bottleneck of spatial understanding lies in a precise 3D perception itself.

AI.title_translation: DeSpatial：代理空间推理的症结在于3D本身
AI.tldr: 代理空间推理的瓶颈在于3D感知不准确。DeSpatial通过解耦感知和推理，并引入统一的3D感知工具，显著提升了在多个基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间代理工具因预测不一致和对象身份碎片化，导致3D场景信息不可靠。一个简单的oracle实验表明，用真实的3D边界框替换工具预测的感知信息，可以使代理在任务中获得近乎满分，揭示了感知是瓶颈。
AI.method: 本文引入了DeSpatial框架，明确地将空间理解分解为感知和推理。DeSpatial包含一个共享的3D感知工具，用于将独立的感知输出协调为统一的、度量的、与重力对齐的3D场景。该感知工具包含两个核心组件：a) 联合分割-深度协同细化模块，用于整合同一对象的掩码并去除由不一致分割和深度引起的投影伪影；b) 跨视图实例融合模块，用于整合体素重叠的实例，并融合因多视图观测不足导致的在空间上不连贯的片段。在获得完整的3D场景信息后，代理选择推理或计算工具来解决空间问题。
AI.result: DeSpatial在VSI-Bench、MindCube-Tiny和ViewSpatial上取得了领先性能，并在VSI-SUPER上获得了长视频结果。
AI.conclusion: 空间理解的瓶颈在于精确的3D感知本身。
AI.translation: 空间代理可以访问重建和分割工具，但预测不一致和对象身份碎片化会阻止它们的输出成为可靠的3D场景信息。一个简单的oracle实验揭示了这一感知瓶颈：用真实3D边界框替换工具预测的感知信息，可以在保留相同推理工具的情况下，使代理在五个以对象为中心的VSI-Bench任务中获得近乎满分。受此发现的启发，我们认为空间推理的症结在于3D本身，并引入了DeSpatial（Devil of Spatial），它明确地将空间理解分解为感知和推理。DeSpatial拥有一个共享的3D感知工具，用于将独立的感知输出协调为统一的、度量的、与重力对齐的3D场景。这个感知工具有两个核心组件：a) 一个联合分割-深度协同细化模块，用于整合同一对象的掩码并消除由单一帧内不一致的分割和深度引起的投影伪影；b) 一个跨视图实例融合模块，用于整合体素重叠的实例，但不允许合并同一帧内的实例。该融合模块还通过检查其3D结构和源掩码外观，融合因多视图观测不足而导致的在空间上不连贯的片段。在接收到完整统一的3D场景信息后，代理选择推理或计算工具来解决空间问题。DeSpatial在VSI-Bench、MindCube-Tiny和ViewSpatial上取得了领先性能，并在VSI-SUPER上获得了额外的长视频结果，揭示了空间理解的瓶颈在于精确的3D感知本身。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DeSpatial框架，旨在解决代理空间推理中3D感知不准确的问题。通过将空间理解解耦为感知和推理，并引入一个统一的3D感知工具，DeSpatial能够整合不一致的感知输出，形成精确的3D场景信息。该感知工具包含联合分割-深度协同细化和跨视图实例融合模块，有效解决了投影伪影和实例碎片化问题。实验结果表明，DeSpatial在多个基准测试中表现出色，强调了精确3D感知在空间理解中的关键作用。
AI.keywords: 空间推理, 3D感知, DeSpatial, 具身智能, 场景理解
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于明确指出了3D感知在代理空间推理中的核心瓶颈，并通过DeSpatial框架提供了一个系统性的解决方案。其方法通过解耦感知和推理，并专注于构建一个鲁棒的3D感知工具，有效地解决了现有方法中常见的碎片化和不一致问题。这项工作对于提升具身智能和3D场景理解的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: One Bias Score, Two Factors: How Mitigations Affect Option Bias in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Reordering multiple-choice options can change a model's answer, an effect studied as selection bias (a preference for certain option letters) and as order sensitivity (changes in answers across option orderings). We connect these perspectives through the pooled selection-rate standard deviation (pooled SD), which measures how unevenly option letters are selected across questions and orderings. When every option of each question appears equally often at each position, the pooled SD is exactly the product of two label-free factors: the flip rate and the positional skew. The flip rate is the fraction of questions whose chosen option changes across orderings; the positional skew is the standard deviation of option-letter selection rates among those questions. Across 41 checkpoints and 12 benchmarks, the flip rate tracks accuracy and output uncertainty, while the positional skew tracks the estimated option-symbol prior. Prior correction for selection bias mainly reduces the positional skew. Aggregating each ordering with its reversal, a mitigation for order sensitivity, mainly reduces the flip rate. Both reduce the range of accuracy across correct-answer letters by similar amounts, but aggregation leaves fewer model-rank reversals. Applying prior correction before aggregation reduces both factors and further narrows this accuracy range. However, aggregation lowers the flip rate partly by settling questions on the same wrong option. We therefore recommend reporting both factors to distinguish mitigation effects, alongside accuracy to distinguish stability from correctness.

title: The Komlós Problem in Matrix-Multiplication Time
summary: We give a randomized algorithm that, for an $m\times n$ matrix whose columns have Euclidean norm at most one, finds a signing with discrepancy below $99$ in expected $\widetilde O(L_{\mathrm{in}}+n^ω)$ bit operations, where $L_{\mathrm{in}}$ is the input encoding length and $ω$ is the exponent of matrix multiplication. The previous fastest algorithm with a constant discrepancy bound, due to Li, is deterministic and uses $O(mn+n^{ω+2}\log^3 n)$ arithmetic operations. We build on the spectral signing framework of Guo, Fang, and Lu and of Li, which rounds a single fractional coloring while one spectral potential controls every row. Li's potential tracks a top eigenvalue, and the gap below that eigenvalue, which can be of order $1/n$, limits the length of every step. We replace it with a resolvent potential that is smooth without any gap condition, and we draw step signs at random, so that the potential only needs to be concave while progress is measured separately. Our key insight is to reuse a single subspace of directions throughout a batch of steps, thereby using only one spectral computation, so that the more expensive linear algebraic operations are paid for only polylogarithmically often at each scale. Within a batch, we sample directions from a Gaussian completion matrix whose inverse we maintain under rank-one row replacements. Finally, we use a finite-precision analysis to prove stability of the algorithm and attain the bit-complexity bound.

title: Halve-Then-Greedy: Adaptive Sampling for Posterior Success with Near-Optimal Instance Dependence
summary: We study fixed-budget adaptive experimentation aimed at maximizing the probability of obtaining sufficient posterior evidence that a recommended design's mean performance exceeds a target. Unlike best-arm identification, this objective does not require finding the best design. For Gaussian bandits with a Gaussian prior, we propose \emph{Halve-Then-Greedy} (HTG), which combines a large initial balanced allocation, successive halving, and posterior-greedy sampling. We prove instance-dependent, finite-budget exponential bounds on posterior-failure probability that capture both separation from unfavorable arms and the presence of multiple favorable arms. On one-positive-arm families, we establish an asymptotic sample-complexity lower bound that HTG matches up to a logarithmic factor. We further analyze uniform sampling and sequential halving, revealing regimes where they require more samples than HTG by linear and logarithmic factors, respectively. Simulations illustrate HTG's sample-efficiency advantages and their dependence on instance structure.

title: MoCaP: Mobile Code-as-Policies for Zero-Shot Mobile Manipulation from Passive Human Videos
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://mocap-7.github.io/MoCAP-page/
summary: Passive human videos of everyday activity offer robots access to a massive amount of human experience without requiring a demonstration for each task. However, using this experience requires recovering knowledge from unstructured video recordings and adapting it to a different body (i.e., the robot). To overcome these challenges, we present mobile code-as-policy (MoCaP), an agentic framework that turns passive human video recordings into guidance for an end-to-end mobile manipulation policy. MoCaP extracts spatial memory and cues of how people prepare to interact with objects, which inform navigation and the search for a manipulation-ready configuration. Guided by passive human experience and current observations, MoCaP uses a closed-loop code-as-policy to coordinate planning and tool use primitives to solve motions under the robot's geometry and kinematic constraints. On a real mobile manipulator, MoCaP achieves 80% success on each of two mobile manipulation tasks in an indoor environment whereas existing approaches cannot succeed at the task. Video-derived spatial memory improves object-navigation success from 70% to 100%, and human approach prior raises the rate of finding a reachable base pose from 0% to 100% at an unfavorable start location. Videos and code are available on the project website: https://mocap-7.github.io/MoCAP-page/.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://mocap-7.github.io/MoCAP-page/

title: EigDiff: Eigensample Diffusion - or how to significantly reduce training dataset size with marginal performance variation?
summary: Diffusion models are notoriously expensive to train, requiring large-scale datasets to learn how to gradually reverse the noise from images over multiple small denoising steps. Current approaches focus on distilling the number of diffusion steps, neglecting potential redundancies of the training data. In this paper, we explore the potential of harnessing eigensamples to train diffusion models on significantly smaller datasets, while preserving model performance. To mitigate the sensitivity to affine transformations of eigenimages, we harness the latent space of a pre-trained CLIP model. We next compute latent eigenvectors by performing principal component analysis (PCA) in CLIP space. Further, we employ eigenvectors as reference points to guide the selection of a representative training set comprising comprising both exemplars (images whose embeddings are closest to eigenvectors) and diverse images. Our comprehensive experiments with different diffusion models applied on multiple datasets indicate that our approach (EigDiff) can reduce training data by up to 14x and accelerate subset selection by up to 1607x, with marginal performance differences.

title: Imperfect Is Perfect: Learned Column Prefilling for Branch-Price-and-Cut
summary: Column generation folklore warns that initial columns hurt: a warm start may bias the dual and slow the root of branch-price-and-cut. We show the opposite once the columns are imperfect in the right way. Preloading the support of the optimal root LP, the best columns one could know in advance, fails to finish on half of our hardest instances; a pool of ordinary routes that need not belong to any optimal solution, held outside the master and priced at the current smoothed dual, speeds the root up. Because the columns need not be optimal, producing them becomes a learning task: a neural edge scorer guides a constructive generator that builds the pool in seconds. A second network predicts the initial center of Wentges smoothing from the instance file, and with it the direction of the smoothed pricing queries; the solver's own updates run unchanged. With prefill and center in place, exact pricing dominates root pricing time, so we rebuild bucket-graph labeling around its dominance test for the GPU and certify on the CPU. Inside RouteOpt, the state-of-the-art exact solver for capacitated vehicle routing, the pipeline reaches the same certified root bound in 13.2% of vanilla RouteOpt's root pricing time over 95 instances with 300 to 1000 customers, prefill alone in 26.1%, and 17.5 times faster in the best case. In an exact branch-price-and-cut solver for unrelated parallel machine scheduling, prefill with smoothing and the learned center certifies all 25 benchmark instances, 12 times faster than the solver's own column generation, which certifies 20 of them.

title: Can LLMs Anticipate Their Cruxes?
summary: To use language models to help us make decisions we would like to understand the rationale behind the language model's outputs. In principle, the language model provides its rationale as part of its text output. However, the sheer volume of text makes this hard to use in practice. In this paper, we are interested in extracting the cruxes that lead a model to recommend one action over another. We take a crux to be a sub-question that a model's rollouts disagree on, where changing its value may have altered the conclusion. A crux is therefore a property of the distribution of a model's rollouts, not of any one rollout. We consider three strategies of increasing computational cost. First, we just ask a model to identify, a priori, what the cruxes of a decision will be. Second, we have the model actually go through the process of generating a response and then extract the cruxes that arose in its reasoning. Finally, we generate many responses and extract the cruxes by comparing the reasoning across the rollouts. We make this last procedure computationally tractable with cheap calls to a reranker, an estimated 86 times less compute than a judge. We then conduct an extensive empirical evaluation to assess whether the computationally inexpensive options are sufficient. They are not. Across domains and models, we find that a model's a priori assessment of the cruxes has little relation to the factors that are actually identified as important a posteriori. Using a single rollout helps, but is still inadequate for identifying the full set of cruxes. Accordingly, for high-stakes decisions (and to understand the space of language model decision making) the many rollout procedure is unavoidable.

title: Mind the Tail: Data Selection Through Sparse Concepts
summary: Data selection reallocates training support across visual concepts, including objects, attributes, color, texture, and backgrounds. Different allocation strategies may produce varied downstream model behavior, especially for tail concepts supported by only a few samples. Discarding them can hurt test-time robustness, while overemphasizing samples lying on category boundaries may introduce unstable training signals. This work explicitly investigates this relationship across fine-grained, spurious-correlation, and general image classification, as well as multimodal pretraining. Specifically, we use sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to extract concept activations from individual images. During selection, we accumulate the dataset-level concept support for each added sample. Applying diminishing returns to this distribution down-weights well-represented concepts and shifts the focus to the distribution tail. We then incorporate local support to find samples that reliably strengthen under-supported concepts. Empirical results show consistent improvements over strong data selection baselines across all benchmarks. We also reveal the connection between concepts our method enhances and the induced behavioral changes, including improved robustness against out-of-distribution and spurious contexts. This work establishes concept support, beyond individual sample importance, as a useful principle for data-efficient and robust learning.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for HPC Job Scheduling: A Statistical Evaluation
comments: 17 pages, 9 Tables, Accepted for Online Proceedings at SACAIR 2026 Conference
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers learned job selection for High-Performance Computing (HPC), but performance against heuristics alone does not establish value beyond action masking. Six DRL treatments are compared: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C), and Deep Q-Network (DQN), each with and without masking. Three heuristics and a seed-paired masked uniform random control provide baselines across ten seeds on two real Slurm (Simple Linux Utility for Resource Management) workload traces, one homogeneous and one heterogeneous, under a common non-parametric framework. All masked treatments complete evaluation, whereas unmasked treatments are truncated. On the homogeneous trace, no masked DRL treatment significantly improves average waiting time or average and maximum bounded slowdown over the control. On the heterogeneous trace, MaskablePPO improves all three metrics relative to the control. Its average waiting time is equivalent to that of the three heuristics within a 10% margin, and its maximum bounded slowdown is 22% lower than that of Last-Come, First-Served (LCFS). MaskablePPO has the leading average waiting-time rank among complete treatments on both traces, but Nemenyi comparisons detect no significant difference from MaskableA2C. Among masked variants, MaskablePPO has the lowest recorded mean training time, while MaskableDQN has the lowest mean decision latency. These findings distinguish completion from baseline-specific scheduling gains and support including a masked random control when assessing the value of learned selection.
comment: 17 pages, 9 Tables, Accepted for Online Proceedings at SACAIR 2026 Conference

title: Audio-Visual Dog Identification and Tracking in Real-World Videos
summary: Identifying individual dogs from barks in real-world videos remains challenging and largely unexplored. Solving this problem would enable long-term behavioral analysis, veterinary monitoring, and animal welfare monitoring by attributing vocalizations and behaviors to the correct individual. Real-world videos are challenging because multiple dogs may bark simultaneously, become occluded, or move in and out of view. Prior studies show that canine vocalizations and visual appearance contain discriminative identity information, but these modalities have largely been studied independently. We present a multimodal dog-fingerprinting framework combining visual identification, multiple-object tracking, and canine vocal fingerprinting to associate bark events with individual dogs while maintaining persistent profiles. The framework synchronizes bark events with tracked dogs and updates profiles using visual appearance and vocal characteristics, enabling identification despite occlusion, overlapping vocalizations, and off-screen barking. We also introduce a benchmark of 46 real-world videos containing 213 manually annotated bark events. Our framework correctly localizes the active visible dog in 61.83% of visible events at IoU $\geq 0.30$ and achieves a 91.33% F1 score for visible versus off-screen barking detection.

title: LWM-TF: A Wireless Foundation Model on 5G NR Time-Frequency Resource Grids
summary: Received OFDM grids preserve both pilot and payload observations, yet wireless foundation models are rarely pre-trained on them. We introduce LWM-TF, a 9.58M-parameter factorized masked autoencoder pre-trained on complex 5G NR uplink grids taken after the FFT and before channel estimation. Each block attends first across OFDM symbols and then across resource blocks and receive antennas, and the mask follows the same two axes. Because the payload phase is unpredictable, the model reconstructs the normalized log-power of each masked token and predicts its scale separately; ablations show that the two terms are complementary and that this target outperforms complex-signal reconstruction. The encoder is pre-trained on 850,496 physical uplink shared channel (PUSCH) slots from a 10^6-slot dataset simulated with the NR transmit chain under various channel conditions. With the encoder frozen, linear probes classify modulation, predict CRC success, and detect UE mobility. On a separately generated test set, 16 labeled slots per class give 0.85 modulation accuracy, 0.82 CRC area under the ROC curve (AUROC), and 0.73 mobility AUROC, ahead of a supervised CNN on every paired draw. With 10,000 labels the probes reach 0.94, 0.96, and 0.92, well above engineered receiver statistics, and detect mobility where the CNN stays at chance. Without any impairment labels, distances in the frozen feature space flag unseen waveform impairments with 0.78 macro AUROC, against 0.68 for receiver statistics. A single pre-trained encoder thus provides receiver features that transfer across tasks, most strongly when labels are scarce.

title: CausalEvo: Causal Skill Self-Evolution for Health LLM Agents
comments: GenAI for Health Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026, Sydney
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents for health can accumulate reusable textual skills from task feedback, such as calculation criteria, measurement time points, and formula units. Deciding which skills to retain is consequential: useful rules improve later answers, while faulty generalizations propagate errors. We propose CausalEvo, a method for causal skill self-evolution that estimates the relative effects of deliberately changed skill sets while holding the model weights, feedback cases, and rule count fixed. At each evolution step, a frozen LLM proposes candidate rules, which are pooled with the incumbent skills so that the current skill set remains a feasible choice. Paired skill replacements against shared background rules are scored on the same feedback cases; least squares converts the score differences into relative skill values, and the top-ranked rules are retained, favoring incumbents on ties. A decision-loss bound separates candidate support, approximation, and estimation errors. On six MedCalc-Bench-Verified tasks with 120 held-out cases, CausalEvo achieves 60.00% accuracy, compared with 55.83% for SkillOpt and 51.67% without skills. Across the recorded training configurations, which use different optimization budgets, it consumes 55.6% fewer training tokens than SkillOpt. Gains concentrate in particular calculations alongside regressions on others, and paired accuracy intervals include zero. CausalEvo turns task feedback into controlled decisions about skill retention and replacement. Project repository: https://github.com/txbrook/CausalEvo
comment: GenAI for Health Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026, Sydney

title: Failure Is the Mother of Success: Recovering Supervision with Grounding Hindsight
summary: When every rollout for a problem fails, GRPO receives neither a successful exemplar nor a nonzero group-relative advantage, so it learns nothing from exactly the problems it most needs to learn. The failed reasoning can nevertheless suggest what to try next. We present Replay-Selected Hindsight Distillation (RSHD), which turns failed attempts into an additional, tested source of supervision during GRPO training. The policy writes a corrective note about each failed attempt without seeing a reference answer or solution, then re-solves the problem with the note in context. A note is admitted only if its replays succeed more often than the original group did, after screening for notes that state the answer, and an admitted replay is distilled into the plain-prompt policy. Because admission is decided by fresh successes rather than by the failed rollout itself, the procedure can recover supervision from groups in which every attempt failed, and it applies equally to failures in mixed groups. Only the policy is trained, the only judge is the outcome verifier, and deployment requires no notes or extra inference. Across model families and sizes and two training domains, RSHD consistently improves over GRPO on in-domain benchmarks, and the gains carry over to out-of-domain evaluation sets.

title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
comments: NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text, 51 pages total. Code: https://github.com/hematteo/learning-to-read-out
summary: When does a language model acquire a capability? Developmental studies usually answer this by tracking when models start producing the correct token. But that prediction passes through the unembedding matrix, or readout, which is itself still being learned during pretraining. We show that a model's hidden states can encode task information before its own readout expresses it, so timelines read from outputs conflate what the model encodes with what its readout expresses. To track the readout directly, we introduce parameter-trajectory crosscoding, which fits one sparse dictionary to every token's readout row at every checkpoint. Unlike crosscoders on activations, it needs only checkpoint weights. We use it to locate a narrow early window, 0.4-1.1% of the way through Pythia's pretraining, in which the readout reorganizes and WordNet word categories become decodable from its rows. By then, linear probes on the hidden states already decode task information that the model's own outputs do not yet show. To test whether such gaps depend on how fast the readout learns, we pretrain small models from scratch that differ only in the readout's learning rate. We find that raising it makes the readout develop earlier and the gap close sooner, with little effect on final loss. Together, these results imply that early in training, where many developmental transitions are dated, a behavioral date can reflect when the readout learns to express task information and not when the model learns it.
