title: Approaching Backpropagation Accuracy with Weight Perturbation on MNIST
summary: Weight perturbation (WP) estimates learning directions from random parameter perturbations and a scalar change in loss, without backpropagating derivatives. We examine how batch size, training duration, and estimator stabilization affect its attainable accuracy in fully connected MNIST networks. In the shallow configuration, large-batch training reaches approximately 97\% test accuracy, compared with an early backpropagation (BP) reference near 97.5--98\%. The same comparison exposes a substantial efficiency gap: under a ten-epoch budget, shallow WP reaches 90.2\%, whereas the reported BP reference reaches 97.4\%. Epoch-indexed curves show diminishing returns from increasing batch size beyond 4,000. Learning-rate reduction and averaging independent perturbation-based updates also stabilize deeper networks, although their recorded results do not establish BP-level accuracy. We distinguish these empirical findings from a finite-horizon approximation argument: under stated regularity conditions, population WP can approximate a fixed gradient-descent trajectory arbitrarily closely at any fixed finite depth. Positive classification margins then suffice to preserve the reference predictions on a finite test set with arbitrarily high probability. Together, the results identify near-BP accuracy as a configuration- and budget-dependent possibility, rather than evidence of equal efficiency or an unconditional accuracy guarantee across depth.

title: Diffeomorphic Hidden-State Steering: Improving Imitation Learning Policy Robustness through Expert Hidden-State Geometry
summary: Small observation or action errors can compound during closed-loop execution and disrupt a trained imitation learning policy. We study whether the original expert demonstrations can improve robustness through test-time hidden-state steering without additional demonstrations or policy retraining. Our analysis of a trained policy finds that expert hidden-state variation is concentrated in relatively few dimensions, while the directions capturing this variation differ across regions. Motivated by this geometry, we propose Diffeomorphic Hidden-State Steering (DHS), which learns an invertible nonlinear coordinate map from expert hidden states obtained by replaying the demonstrations through the frozen policy. DHS attenuates coordinates with low expert variance more strongly than those with high variance, then maps the modified coordinates back to hidden-state space. This allows steering directions to vary with the current hidden state while retaining every coordinate. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, DHS improves mean success under observation noise over the unmodified Transformer policies. Controlled comparisons yield higher mean success with learned nonlinear coordinates than with linear coordinates under both hard projection and full-rank rescaling. Combining DHS with action smoothing improves mean success rate under observation noise in certain tasks compared with action smoothing alone.

title: FusionAudit: Pathway-Conditioned Robustness Auditing for Native Multimodal Models
summary: As vision-language models (VLMs) transition from frozen-encoder pipelines to native multimodal architectures, the visual channel increasingly serves as both a perceptual input and a carrier of rendered text that competes with user prompts. Current single-attack, pixel-centric evaluations fail to capture this complexity: they collapse distinct visual attack surfaces into a single scalar and ignore how architectural shifts alter vulnerability. We introduce PaRMA, an evidence-based auditing framework that defines pathway-conditioned risk over two primary image-level interventions: pixel perturbation and rendered-text insertion. Instead of arbitrary attack enumeration, PaRMA uses pathway-specific diagnostics to expose architecture-specific blind spots. Notably, we uncover a see-but-not-deceived signature where native VLMs attend heavily to typographic overlays but visually reject them, and we identify an objective mismatch between encoder-level and answer-level attacks in deep-fusion models. To exploit these findings, we instantiate FusionAudit, introducing two diagnostic-motivated attacks: MANTIS (margin-aware pixel perturbation) and Nat-Evid (host-congruent semantic insertion). Evaluating 18 open-weight VLMs across a novel nativeness taxonomy, we demonstrate that legacy single-attack rankings (e.g., PGD) are unstable for native models. Our diagnostic-driven attacks substantially raise the estimated residual risk, showing that PaRMA provides a falsifiable, evidence-driven auditing methodology for uncovering vulnerabilities missed by standard benchmarks.

title: Edit4D: Editable 4D Scene Generation with Textual Control
summary: We introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D scene generation framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background and dynamic character representations. Recent advances in generative models have enabled text-driven dynamic scene synthesis, but editable 4D scene generation remains challenging due to the need to preserve spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically generate holistic scene videos, where the background and dynamic characters are coupled, making object-level editing and flexible camera control difficult. Edit4D addresses these limitations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and scene-character composition. Using these prompts, we synthesize multi-view scene images with text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors and reconstruct a background 3D Gaussian splatting representation. We then generate a character image, animate it with an image-conditioned video prior, reconstruct a 4D mesh, and bind Gaussian primitives to obtain a character representation. Finally, both components are composed through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization. A global scene refinement is then performed to improve harmonization and rendering consistency. By integrating stage-specific components, Edit4D enables controllable camera motion, flexible object-level editing, and the practical construction of editable 4D scenes. Project page: https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/

title: Enhancing Multimodal RLVR with Pairwise Token Contrast and Adaptive Trajectory Confidence
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves multimodal reasoning, but group-relative policy optimization broadcasts a single sequence-level advantage to every token of a response, although errors usually localize to a few decisive steps. Recent self-distilled variants refine credit with a teacher--student likelihood gap. However, this signal cannot tell whether it relies on the image or on a language shortcut, and is applied uniformly even when the teacher is uninformative. To address this, we propose Pairwise token contrast and Adaptive trajectory ConfidencE (PACE). Pairwise token contrast scores each response under four teacher views, crossing a correct or incorrect answer hint with the image present or removed, and compares the two hints for every token, which cancels shifts shared by both hints and reveals whether the token's support relies on the image. Adaptive trajectory confidence measures how well the teacher predicts each response given the correct hint and the image, normalizes this score within the batch, and uses it to set how far the token contrast redistributes credit within that response. PACE achieves the best average accuracy on three backbones and ranks first on all evaluated multimodal reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Experiments show that both components matter: replacing pairwise token contrast with a single-view signal underperforms our method, while adaptive trajectory confidence adds further improvement.

title: Diffusion Language Models as Open Quantum Systems
summary: Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a $τ$-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experiments with pretrained diffusion language models show that superposition-based generation can retain information from conditioning components not selected at the final measurement, while QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality when applied at an appropriate stage of generation.

title: Classical methods for modern applications: synthetic tabular data generation using lightweight discrete response continuous latent variable model
summary: In this paper, we present a lightweight algorithm for modelling tabular data containing both continuous and discrete variables. The method uses empirical marginal distributions and a selected quantile function to transform the data into a continuous latent space, where a distribution of choice, e.g. a multivariate Gaussian, can be efficiently estimated and applied. While this approach is closely related to classical well-established machine learning methods, we present a novel adaptation that fits well within the contemporary computational ecosystem. Unlike in the case of deep architectures, it results in a simple implementation with few dependencies, robust training/estimation, as well as efficient sampling. The transformation preserves complex marginal distributions and correlations, providing high-fidelity models, especially for data with unimodal distributions. One of the key characteristics of the proposed approach is its continuous representation of discrete variables. While highly desirable, this introduces a significant challenge, since a single observation corresponds to a region rather than a point in the latent space. We show that this ambiguity naturally leads to a Monte Carlo expectation-maximisation (MCEM) formulation, whose auxiliary objective can be expressed as a weighted latent-space likelihood. This, in turn, allows conventional maximum-likelihood estimators to be used within an efficient and robust optimisation procedure.

title: ConStore: Search-Overlapped Prefetch and Co-Retrieval-Aware Content Storage for Disk-Based ANNS
summary:
Disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) supports retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), search, recommendation, and advertising over corpora that exceed memory capacity. Existing ANNS research often focuses on vector search at small top-K, whereas industrial-scale applications require larger retrieval sets. Fetching the corresponding content from storage remains comparatively underexplored. Our profiling across million- to billion-vector corpora shows that, at large K, content fetch latency can match or exceed vector-search latency and cannot be ignored in end-to-end retrieval.
  We present ConStore, a content storage engine combining two complementary techniques to reduce end-to-end retrieval latency. Speculative Inline Content Prefetch (SICP) commonly abstracts graph-based and cluster-based ANNS as progressive SSD I/O that refines an in-flight candidate queue. It prefetches content for stable leading candidates under a bounded I/O budget, overlapping content reads with search without changing the final top-K results. Co-Retrieval-Pattern-Aware Grouping (RPAG) uses query logs to place frequently co-retrieved documents in contiguous segments. Workload-Adaptive Segment Reorganization (WASR) adapts this layout to workload shifts by selectively regrouping segments under a bounded rewrite budget. Group Content Fetch (GCF) exploits this layout to coalesce per-document random reads into batched, page-aware I/O requests. SICP works independently of the content layout, while RPAG and GCF reduce fetch cost even without prefetching.
  Across three multi-hop QA workloads with K from 10 to 1600, ConStore reduces end-to-end retrieval latency over the best per-document-read baseline by up to 48% on DiskANN and 25% on SPANN. Separate experiments on 100M- and billion-vector indexes demonstrate SICP's applicability at larger scales.

title: No Single Tokenizer Feature Reliably Predicts Downstream Language Model Performance
comments: 10 pages, accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Tokenization is a critical component of the language modeling pipeline, but it is poorly understood. Tokenizers can impact downstream performance, but there is currently mixed evidence about which tokenizer features predict a better language model without requiring a full training run. In this paper, we analyze approximately 200 language models trained on nine different languages. We evaluate both models and their tokenizers and test whether there is a relationship between any proposed intrinsic tokenizer evaluations and model performance, as measured by a wide variety of benchmarks. Despite the quantity and variety of proposed intrinsic tokenizer metrics, we find that none consistently predicts downstream performance across model families, tasks, and languages. This motivates the need for novel tokenizer evaluation metrics and approaches. We propose novel linguistically grounded metric introduced in this work shows that new metrics can capture aspects of tokenizer quality that existing metrics miss, though their predictive power is likely to vary across model families, languages, and tasks.
comment: 10 pages, accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026

title: Projection-Based Parareal for Nonlinear Initial-Value Problems
summary: Parareal is a parallel-in-time method for initial-value problems that has found extensive applications and given rise to many variants. Krylov-enhanced parareal is a variant of parareal that uses projection techniques to accelerate convergence substantially for linear problems. In this paper, we study a projection-based parareal algorithm for nonlinear initial-value problems with a modified iteration scheme and an arbitrary orthogonal projection. For a general nonlinear problem, we prove a convergence estimate for each iteration step on a fixed time grid. We analyze the errors of the modified scheme and the scheme of Krylov-enhanced parareal relative to the old error as the coarse grid is refined. For a coarse solver of order $p$ and step size $h$, we prove error bounds of $O(h^{p+1})$ for the modified scheme and $O(h)$ for that of Krylov-enhanced parareal at the first potentially inexact time point under mild assumptions. Numerical experiments on two nonlinear problems are consistent with the theoretical analysis.

title: Data Strategies for Large Language Models: A Unified Perspective on the Training Lifecycle
summary: Data strategy plays a central role in training large language models (LLMs). It governs the selection, weighting, and scheduling of training data, thereby determining the capabilities a model can acquire from a fixed data budget. We treat high-quality data as having high training-dependent utility, which depends on the target objective, the model, and its training state rather than on the text alone. Research in this area now spans pretraining and post-training, but related ideas use inconsistent terminology and evaluation protocols. This work reviews data strategies across the training lifecycle and formulates them as policies that allocate a training budget over candidate examples. We organise methods by their decision granularity, model dependence, and temporal adaptivity, then compare their computational requirements and empirical support. Fine-grained or state-dependent policies offer more control but incur additional scoring, search, or rollout costs. Evidence for transfer across model scales and comparable end-to-end cost remains limited. A continuously updated list of papers, along with their public implementations, is available at https://github.com/xuyj233/data_strategy_survey.

title: Router Drift Control: Mitigating Off-Policy Degradation in Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch, mini-batch updates, and asynchronous training.The resulting mismatch is especially harmful in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where rollout--training discrepancies can change routing decisions and lead to router drift. Rollout Routing Replay (R3) mitigates this mismatch by reusing expert selections from the rollout stage during training. Our analysis shows that routing replay introduces gradient bias by losing contributions from experts selected by the training router but not the rollout router. To address this, we propose Router Drift Control (RDC), which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as a signal of off-policy staleness and selectively rejects high-drift responses. The sequence-level filtering avoids gradient bias introduced by replay while preserving native expert selection and the associated learning signals for retained responses. Experiments show that RDC achieves larger gains as policy staleness increases and remains effective in asynchronous RL. In asynchronous training, RDC combined with Truncated Importance Sampling (TIS) improves the average peak validation accuracy across AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 by 5.5 points over TIS and 4.5 points over R3.

title: MARS: A Momentum-Aware Adaptive Rating System for Personalized Assessment
summary: Adaptive assessment systems personalize learning by estimating learner proficiency and recommending suitable questions. However, many existing approaches rely on fixed difficulty labels, static rating updates, or black-box prediction models that provide limited control over rating stability, interpretability, and time-constrained routing. This paper proposes MARS, a Momentum-Aware Adaptive Rating System for interpretable adaptive assessment. MARS represents the question bank as a directed weighted knowledge graph and updates learner proficiency using dynamic rating sensitivity, response quality, and momentum-aware learner velocity. We also formulate a time-budgeted mark-maximization objective in which the policy selects questions within a fixed test duration under negative marking. Experiments on ASSISTments 2009 and MARS-SimExam evaluate MARS for prediction, rating stability, and adaptive routing. Results show that MARS provides smoother rating updates than Fixed Elo and achieves the highest score under time-budgeted negative-marking routing, improving the total score by 8.09 over the strongest baseline and reducing overtime violations from 50% to 5.6%. These results suggest that MARS is suitable for real-time, interpretable, and deployment-friendly adaptive assessment.

title: MAIA: Anticipating Interaction Anomalies in Contact-Rich Manipulation via Multimodal World Models
summary: Reliable contact-rich manipulation requires detecting execution deviations early enough for corrective action. Yet most monitoring methods are reactive, identifying anomalies only after they become observable. Anticipating such anomalies is challenging because visual observations only partially reveal physical interaction, while planned actions describe intended motion rather than their actual physical consequences. We address this problem with MAIA, a multimodal framework for anomaly anticipation. Its vision-action-force world model learns nominal interaction dynamics and predicts the visual and force responses of planned actions, while a lightweight anomaly head predicts impending interaction anomalies. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce CRIA, a real-world multimodal dataset of 2,852 trajectories spanning 18 contact-rich manipulation tasks, with frame-level annotations of anomaly onset and evolution. Experiments on both seen and novel tasks show that MAIA achieves more accurate anomaly discrimination than representative baselines while providing earlier warnings, with bACC scores of 0.765 and 0.710 and median anticipation lead times of 28.0 and 25.1 steps, respectively. Moreover, using these predictions for anomaly-aware action selection improves end-to-end task success from 52.6% to 61.5% without retraining the underlying manipulation policy. These results highlight the value of modeling future physical consequences for proactive anomaly anticipation.

title: Abstracts or full text? Evaluating input scope and computational efficiency in biomedical lay summarization
summary: Biomedical research articles are mainly written for experts and often contain terms that are difficult for the general public to understand. Automated lay summarization has become a solution to make biomedical knowledge easier for patients and the public to understand. However, generating lay summaries from full-text articles requires more computing power because the articles are long and costly to process. Fine-tuning large language models for this task also requires substantial resources. This study asks two questions: (1) whether abstracts contain enough information to produce lay summaries as good as those based on full-text articles, and (2) whether few-shot learning performs as well as task-specific fine-tuning. The study used two public biomedical lay summarization datasets and two recent models, evaluated for readability, factual consistency, semantic similarity, and runtime efficiency. Results show that abstract-based summarization performs better overall. Across both datasets and models, abstract fine-tuning is 4.70 times faster, while abstract zero- and few-shot prompting is 5.31 times faster than full-text methods. These results show that abstract-based prompting reduces runtime cost while maintaining lay summary quality.

AI.title_translation: 摘要还是全文？评估生物医学通俗化摘要中的输入范围和计算效率
AI.tldr: 本研究发现，在生物医学通俗化摘要任务中，仅使用摘要作为输入比使用全文更快，且能保持摘要质量，同时少样本学习也能有效。
AI.motivation: 生物医学研究文章对公众来说难以理解，自动化通俗化摘要是解决方案，但处理全文计算成本高昂。本研究旨在探讨摘要是否足以生成高质量通俗化摘要，以及少样本学习能否替代任务特定微调以降低成本。
AI.method: 研究使用了两个公共生物医学通俗化摘要数据集和两个最新模型，评估了摘要的可读性、事实一致性、语义相似性和运行时效率。比较了基于摘要和基于全文的摘要生成方法，以及少样本学习和任务特定微调的表现。
AI.result: 结果显示，基于摘要的摘要生成总体表现更好。在两个数据集和模型中，基于摘要的微调比基于全文的方法快4.70倍，而基于摘要的零样本和少样本提示比基于全文的方法快5.31倍，同时保持了摘要质量。
AI.conclusion: 基于摘要的提示方法在显著降低运行时成本的同时，保持了生物医学通俗化摘要的质量。
AI.translation: 生物医学研究文章主要为专家撰写，通常包含普通大众难以理解的术语。自动化通俗化摘要已成为使生物医学知识更容易被患者和公众理解的解决方案。然而，从全文文章生成通俗化摘要需要更多的计算能力，因为文章很长且处理成本高昂。为此任务微调大型语言模型也需要大量资源。本研究提出了两个问题：（1）摘要是否包含足够的信息来生成与基于全文文章一样好的通俗化摘要，以及（2）少样本学习是否能与特定任务微调表现一样好。该研究使用了两个公共生物医学通俗化摘要数据集和两个最新模型，并评估了可读性、事实一致性、语义相似性和运行时效率。结果表明，基于摘要的摘要生成总体表现更好。在两个数据集和模型中，基于摘要的微调比基于全文的方法快4.70倍，而基于摘要的零样本和少样本提示比基于全文的方法快5.31倍。这些结果表明，基于摘要的提示在降低运行时成本的同时保持了通俗化摘要的质量。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在生物医学通俗化摘要任务中，仅使用文章摘要作为输入是否能达到与使用全文相当的质量，以及少样本学习是否能像微调一样有效，从而降低计算成本。研究通过使用两个数据集和模型发现，基于摘要的摘要生成总体表现更优，并且比基于全文的方法快4.70至5.31倍，同时保持了摘要质量。
AI.keywords: 生物医学通俗化摘要, 基于摘要的摘要, 计算效率, 少样本学习, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文为生物医学通俗化摘要任务提供了一个实用的解决方案，通过证明仅使用摘要作为输入的有效性来显著降低计算成本。其关于基于摘要的提示和少样本学习效率的发现，对于资源受限的应用以及在医疗保健交流中更广泛地采用大型语言模型具有重要意义。

title: Policy-Gradient Transfer under a Shared State Estimator
summary: This paper considers the problem of policy-gradient transfer from a simulator to a physical plant when both are controlled through the same fixed state estimator. The plant and the simulator are partially observed nonlinear systems with additive Gaussian noise of common known covariance whose dynamics and observation models differ, and the controller is a squashed Gaussian policy with uniformly bounded latent mean and first two parameter derivatives. We derive a bound on the difference between the plant and simulator policy gradients that is linear in the noise-weighted model error and requires no estimator-accuracy guarantee, because the shared estimator is a common post-processing of the measurements and the data-processing inequality compares the trajectory laws without an estimation-error term. Based on this bound, we derive an occupancy-weighted refinement, a sufficient condition for the simulator gradient to be an ascent direction for the plant, and a bound on the expected squared plant gradient at a random iterate of a finite simulator-training run with optimization, truncation and model-error terms. Simulation results on a scalar system and a pendulum are presented to validate the theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 共享状态估计器下的策略梯度迁移
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在共享状态估计器下，从模拟器到物理设备的策略梯度迁移问题，推导了策略梯度差异的边界，并提供了模拟器梯度作为物理设备上升方向的充分条件，并通过仿真验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: 解决在共享固定状态估计器下，从模拟器到物理设备的策略梯度迁移问题，其中物理设备和模拟器是具有共同已知协方差的附加高斯噪声的部分观测非线性系统。
AI.method: 本文理论推导了物理设备和模拟器策略梯度之间差异的边界，该边界与噪声加权模型误差呈线性关系，且无需估计器精度保证。在此基础上，进一步推导了占用加权细化、模拟器梯度作为物理设备上升方向的充分条件，以及在具有优化、截断和模型误差项的有限模拟器训练运行的随机迭代中，预期平方物理梯度的边界。
AI.result: 推导出了物理设备和模拟器策略梯度差异的边界，该边界与噪声加权模型误差呈线性关系，且无需估计器精度保证。还得到了占用加权细化、模拟器梯度作为物理设备上升方向的充分条件，以及在有限模拟器训练运行中预期平方物理梯度的边界。仿真结果在标量系统和摆锤上验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功推导了共享状态估计器下策略梯度迁移的关键理论结果，并通过仿真验证了其有效性，为从模拟器到物理设备的策略迁移提供了理论支持和实用条件。
AI.translation: 本文研究了在共享相同固定状态估计器的情况下，从模拟器到物理设备进行策略梯度迁移的问题。该物理设备和模拟器是部分观测的非线性系统，具有共同已知协方差的附加高斯噪声，其动力学和观测模型不同，且控制器是具有均匀有界潜在均值和前两个参数导数的压缩高斯策略。我们推导了物理设备和模拟器策略梯度之间差异的边界，该边界与噪声加权模型误差呈线性关系，并且不需要估计器精度保证，因为共享估计器是测量的共同后处理，并且数据处理不等式比较了轨迹定律，而没有估计误差项。基于此边界，我们推导了占用加权细化、模拟器梯度作为物理设备上升方向的充分条件，以及在具有优化、截断和模型误差项的有限模拟器训练运行的随机迭代中，预期平方物理梯度的边界。在标量系统和摆锤上的仿真结果验证了理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在共享固定状态估计器下，从模拟器到物理设备的策略梯度迁移问题。研究对象是具有不同动力学和观测模型的局部观测非线性系统，并采用压缩高斯策略作为控制器。作者推导了一个关于物理设备和模拟器策略梯度差异的边界，该边界与噪声加权模型误差呈线性关系，且无需估计器精度保证。在此基础上，进一步推导了占用加权细化、模拟器梯度作为物理设备上升方向的充分条件，以及有限模拟器训练运行中预期平方物理梯度的边界。理论结果通过标量系统和摆锤的仿真得到验证。
AI.keywords: 策略梯度迁移, 共享状态估计器, 模型误差, Sim-to-Real, 策略梯度边界
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过理论推导，为在共享状态估计器设置下进行策略梯度迁移提供了坚实的数学基础。其创新之处在于证明了在共享估计器下，策略梯度差异边界无需估计器精度保证，这简化了从模拟器到真实世界系统迁移的复杂性。提出的占用加权细化和上升方向条件对于实际应用具有重要指导意义，有助于在仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）迁移中提高策略的可靠性和效率。

title: ShiftQAT: Quantization-Aware Training for the Numerical Contract of a Fixed-Function Edge CNN Accelerator
summary: Fixed-function CNN accelerators make edge inference fast and energy-efficient, but they execute only networks that obey a precise numerical contract. On the MAX7800x family, this contract requires power-of-two, per-tensor, symmetric scales, 8-bit activations and biases, integer-only arithmetic, and one statically configured shift per layer. We present ShiftQAT, the quantization-aware training (QAT) flow we developed for this family, which produces networks satisfying the contract by construction. It is the default training path of ai8x-training, the family's open-source training toolchain. ShiftQAT resolves residual, concatenation, and weight-sharing dependencies so that activation scales propagate statically and each layer's requantization reduces to one offline-configured shift. It also trains weights and biases on a joint power-of-two grid that fits the 8-bit bias budget. Among the compared methods, only ShiftQAT satisfies all of the contract's scaling constraints, including signed 8-bit activation storage. Even so, on ImageNet it matches the W8A8 accuracy drop of less constrained QAT methods and stays within 2.9 percentage points of FP32 at W4A8. On MAX78002 silicon, ShiftQAT-trained MobileNetV2 and ResNet-18 classify ImageNet images in 14.6 and 8.4 ms at 5.1 and 2.8 mJ per inference.

AI.title_translation: ShiftQAT：面向固定功能边缘CNN加速器数值契约的量化感知训练
AI.tldr: ShiftQAT是一种为MAX7800x系列固定功能边缘CNN加速器设计的量化感知训练（QAT）流程，它能生成满足严格数值契约的网络，并在ImageNet上保持高精度，同时实现快速、节能的推理。
AI.motivation: 固定功能CNN加速器在边缘推理中提供了高速和高能效，但它们要求网络遵守精确的数值契约。MAX7800x系列加速器有严格的数值契约，包括幂次方的、逐张量的、对称的尺度，8位激活和偏置，纯整数运算，以及每层一个静态配置的移位。开发ShiftQAT是为了生成满足这些特定硬件约束的网络。
AI.method: ShiftQAT是为MAX7800x系列开发的量化感知训练（QAT）流程。它通过设计确保生成的网络满足数值契约。它解决了残差、连接和权重共享依赖关系，使得激活尺度能够静态传播，并将每层的再量化简化为一次离线配置的移位。ShiftQAT还在一个联合的2的幂次网格上训练权重和偏置，以适应8位偏置预算。
AI.result: 在所有比较方法中，只有ShiftQAT满足了契约的所有缩放约束，包括有符号8位激活存储。在ImageNet上，它与约束较少的QAT方法在W8A8精度下降方面相匹配，并且在W4A8时与FP32的精度差距保持在2.9个百分点以内。在MAX78002芯片上，经过ShiftQAT训练的MobileNetV2和ResNet-18在ImageNet图像分类中分别实现了14.6毫秒和8.4毫秒的推理时间，以及5.1毫焦和2.8毫焦的每次推理能耗。
AI.conclusion: ShiftQAT成功地为固定功能边缘CNN加速器（MAX7800x系列）提供了一种量化感知训练方案，该方案能够生成严格遵守硬件数值契约的网络，同时在保持高精度的前提下，实现了卓越的推理速度和能效。
AI.translation: 固定功能CNN加速器使边缘推理快速且节能，但它们只执行遵守精确数值契约的网络。在MAX7800x系列上，此契约要求2的幂次方、逐张量的、对称的尺度，8位激活和偏置，纯整数运算，以及每层一个静态配置的移位。我们提出了ShiftQAT，这是我们为该系列开发的量化感知训练（QAT）流程，它通过设计生成满足契约的网络。它是该系列开源训练工具链ai8x-training的默认训练路径。ShiftQAT解决了残差、连接和权重共享依赖关系，使得激活尺度能够静态传播，并且每层的再量化简化为一次离线配置的移位。它还在一个联合的2的幂次网格上训练权重和偏置，以适应8位偏置预算。在所比较的方法中，只有ShiftQAT满足了契约的所有缩放约束，包括有符号8位激活存储。即便如此，在ImageNet上，它与约束较少的QAT方法在W8A8精度下降方面相匹配，并且在W4A8时与FP32的精度差距保持在2.9个百分点以内。在MAX78002芯片上，经过ShiftQAT训练的MobileNetV2和ResNet-18在14.6毫秒和8.4毫秒内分类ImageNet图像，每次推理能耗分别为5.1毫焦和2.8毫焦。
AI.summary: 本论文介绍了ShiftQAT，一种专为MAX7800x系列固定功能边缘CNN加速器设计的量化感知训练（QAT）流程。该方法能够生成完全符合硬件严格数值契约（包括2的幂次方尺度、8位激活和纯整数运算等）的网络。ShiftQAT通过解决残差、连接和权重共享依赖关系，并优化权重偏置训练，确保了量化操作的效率和硬件兼容性。实验结果表明，ShiftQAT不仅满足了所有契约约束，而且在ImageNet上保持了与约束较少QAT方法相当的精度，并实现了极低的推理延迟和能耗。
AI.keywords: 量化感知训练, 边缘AI, CNN加速器, 固定功能, MAX7800x
AI.comments: ShiftQAT的创新之处在于它能够为具有极其严格数值契约的固定功能边缘CNN加速器提供有效的量化感知训练方案。它巧妙地通过设计解决了硬件限制，如静态移位和8位偏置预算，同时保持了高精度。这对于在资源受限的边缘设备上部署高性能深度学习模型具有重要意义，展示了在严格硬件约束下实现高效AI推理的潜力。

title: Bridging the Markerless Tracking Validation Gap: Intraoperative X-ray Workflow Integration
comments: This version was submitted to MICCAI 2026 for review, see journal reference for published version
summary: Markerless intraoperative tracking of spinal anatomy via RGB-D sensors is a promising alternative to invasive bone-anchored fiducials, yet no existing clinical dataset provides independent subsurface ground truth for validating these methods. We address this gap with a clinically viable pipeline that derives per-vertebra 6-DoF pose from routine intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy, co-registered to the RGB-D camera frame through a multimodal fiducial array detectable in both imaging modalities. Critically, the pipeline requires no additional radiation, instrumentation, or deviation from standard surgical workflows, relying solely on the fluoroscopic images already acquired during routine level checks. A calibrated transform chain links the vertebral pose recovered via multi-view 2D-3D CT-to-fluoroscopy registration to the RGB-D coordinate frame, enabling direct comparison of any markerless registration estimate against a subsurface reference. Ex vivo validation against optically tracked ovine vertebrae confirms end-to-end accuracy of 2.06 +- 0.29 mm and 3.35 +- 0.93 degrees, sufficient to serve as independent ground truth for methods with substantially larger errors. We demonstrate the pipeline's utility by evaluating two markerless registration strategies on clinical data spanning 11 vertebrae across 1,500 frames from three surgical sequences: the first such evaluation against an independent subsurface reference in a clinical setting. The proposed framework provides reusable infrastructure for benchmarking emerging markerless tracking methods on real surgical data.

AI.title_translation: 弥合无标记跟踪验证鸿沟：术中X射线工作流程整合
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种临床可行的管道，利用常规术中C臂透视，为无标记脊柱跟踪提供独立的地下真实姿态，无需额外辐射或改变手术流程，并验证了其高精度，为新兴的无标记跟踪方法提供了基准。
AI.motivation: 无标记术中脊柱解剖跟踪是侵入性骨锚定标记的替代方案，但现有临床数据集缺乏独立的地下真实值来验证这些方法。
AI.method: 该方法通过一个多模态标记阵列将C臂透视图像与RGB-D相机帧共同配准，从常规术中C臂透视中获取每个椎骨的6自由度姿态。通过校准的变换链，将多视图2D-3D CT到透视配准恢复的椎骨姿态链接到RGB-D坐标系，从而直接比较无标记配准估计与地下参考。该管道不增加辐射、器械或改变标准手术流程，仅依赖于常规水平检查已获取的透视图像。
AI.result: 离体验证显示，端到端精度为2.06 ± 0.29 mm和3.35 ± 0.93 度，足以作为误差更大的方法的独立真值。在临床数据上评估了两种无标记配准策略，涵盖11个椎骨和1500帧，这是首次在临床环境中针对独立地下参考进行此类评估。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架为在真实手术数据上基准测试新兴无标记跟踪方法提供了可重用的基础设施。
AI.translation: 无标记术中通过RGB-D传感器跟踪脊柱解剖结构是一种有前景的替代侵入性骨锚定标记的方法，但现有临床数据集无法提供独立的地下真实值来验证这些方法。我们通过一个临床可行的管道解决了这一空白，该管道通过在两种成像模式下均可检测到的多模态标记阵列，将常规术中C臂透视图像与RGB-D相机帧共同配准，从而从常规术中C臂透视中获取每个椎骨的6自由度姿态。关键是，该管道无需额外辐射、器械或偏离标准手术流程，仅依赖于常规水平检查期间已获取的透视图像。校准的变换链将通过多视图2D-3D CT到透视配准恢复的椎骨姿态链接到RGB-D坐标系，从而能够直接比较任何无标记配准估计与地下参考。离体对光学跟踪的绵羊椎骨进行验证，确认端到端精度为2.06 ± 0.29 mm和3.35 ± 0.93 度，足以作为误差更大的方法的独立真值。我们通过评估两种无标记配准策略在临床数据上的效用，展示了该管道的实用性，这些数据涵盖来自三个手术序列的11个椎骨和1500帧：这是首次在临床环境中针对独立地下参考进行此类评估。所提出的框架为在真实手术数据上基准测试新兴无标记跟踪方法提供了可重用的基础设施。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新性的临床管道，旨在弥补无标记脊柱跟踪验证中缺乏独立地下真实值的空白。该管道利用常规术中C臂透视，结合多模态标记阵列，无需额外辐射或改变手术流程，即可为每个椎骨提供高精度的6自由度姿态。通过离体验证和临床数据评估，证明了其作为独立真值的有效性，为新兴的无标记跟踪方法提供了重要的基准测试工具。
AI.keywords: 无标记跟踪, 术中X射线, 脊柱解剖, 地下真实值, C臂透视
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其提出了一种无需额外辐射或改变现有手术流程，即可为无标记术中脊柱跟踪提供独立地下真实值的方法。这解决了当前验证无标记跟踪技术的一个关键瓶颈，具有重要的临床应用价值。其高精度验证结果和在临床数据上的首次评估，进一步证实了其潜力和实用性。

title: Mixture of Multi-Sequence Feature Difference for Contrast-Enhanced MRI Synthesis
summary: Contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI) is crucial for accurately diagnosing and segmenting brain tumors. However, the acquisition of CE-MRI requires injecting contrast agents, which poses potential health risks and increases scan costs. Here, we propose a CE-MRI synthesis method from non-contrast sequences, reducing both risk and cost. Unlike existing methods that rely on channel-wise concatenation to fuse multi-sequence information for synthesis, we introduce a Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD) module. The proposed module uses a dynamic weighting strategy to adaptively select and aggregate informative features from both individual source sequences and explicit differences among them. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms baselines in terms of image fidelity and perceptual quality on the UCSF-PDGM and UPenn-GBM datasets. Our method successfully reconstructs tumor regions and achieves segmentation performance comparable to that obtained with real CE-MRI. Our ablation studies show that although adversarial learning improves perceptual quality, a regression-based variant of our method achieves higher structural fidelity.

AI.title_translation: 对比增强MRI合成中的多序列特征差异混合
AI.tldr: 提出一种从非对比序列合成CE-MRI的方法，通过Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD)模块融合特征，提高了图像质量和肿瘤分割性能，降低了风险和成本。
AI.motivation: CE-MRI对脑肿瘤诊断和分割至关重要，但需要注射对比剂，存在健康风险和高成本。因此，需要一种从非对比序列合成CE-MRI的方法来降低风险和成本。
AI.method: 提出Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD)模块，该模块使用动态加权策略自适应地选择和聚合来自单个源序列及其之间显式差异的信息特征，用于从非对比序列合成CE-MRI。
AI.result: 在UCSF-PDGM和UPenn-GBM数据集上，所提出的方法在图像保真度和感知质量方面优于基线。该方法成功重建肿瘤区域，并实现了与真实CE-MRI相当的分割性能。消融研究表明，对抗学习提高了感知质量，而基于回归的变体实现了更高的结构保真度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的CE-MRI合成方法通过Mixture of Multi-Sequence Feature Difference模块，有效降低了CE-MRI的风险和成本，并在图像质量和肿瘤分割性能上表现出色，达到甚至超越了现有方法的水平。
AI.translation: 对比增强磁共振成像（CE-MRI）对于准确诊断和分割脑肿瘤至关重要。然而，CE-MRI的采集需要注射对比剂，这带来了潜在的健康风险并增加了扫描成本。本文提出了一种从非对比序列合成CE-MRI的方法，从而降低了风险和成本。与现有依赖通道级拼接融合多序列信息进行合成的方法不同，我们引入了多序列特征差异混合（Mixture of Feature Difference, MoFD）模块。所提出的模块采用动态加权策略，自适应地选择和聚合来自单个源序列以及它们之间显式差异的信息特征。定量和定性评估表明，在UCSF-PDGM和UPenn-GBM数据集上，我们提出的方法在图像保真度和感知质量方面优于基线。我们的方法成功重建了肿瘤区域，并取得了与真实CE-MRI相当的分割性能。我们的消融研究表明，尽管对抗学习提高了感知质量，但我们方法的基于回归的变体实现了更高的结构保真度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的CE-MRI合成方法，通过Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD)模块从非对比序列生成CE-MRI，旨在规避对比剂带来的健康风险和高成本。MoFD模块采用动态加权策略，有效融合来自多序列和序列间差异的特征。实验结果表明，该方法在图像质量和肿瘤分割性能上优于现有方法，并能成功重建肿瘤区域，达到与真实CE-MRI相当的分割效果。
AI.keywords: CE-MRI合成, 特征差异混合, 脑肿瘤, 动态加权, 非对比序列
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD)模块，通过动态加权策略更有效地融合多序列特征及其差异，解决了传统方法简单拼接的局限性。其重要性在于提供了一种无创、低成本的CE-MRI替代方案，对脑肿瘤的诊断和治疗具有潜在的积极影响。消融研究揭示了不同学习策略对图像质量和结构保真度的影响，为未来的研究提供了方向。

title: Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures
summary: When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at a definite residual-stream depth, with site and dose chosen on training data, and random directions under the same procedure flip at most one episode. Second, over-asking has two mechanistic signatures: in four families the model demonstrably knows the request is unambiguous (the belief is decodable, causally inert and orthogonal to the decision) and asks anyway; in the fifth, the rare over-asks track different world-representations. Third, steering gated on a probe readout removes most of the simulated oversight burden while legitimate questions survive (bootstrap 95% intervals exclude zero); a prompt instruction makes it worse. Fourth, consolidating the fix into the weights yields a map, not a rule: on one model a LoRA confined to the causal band passes every criterion fixed in advance while behavior cloning on identical data breaks retention; on three families the reverse holds; on the fifth the outcome crosses the boundary across seeds. A geometric rule written down in advance to predict the regime failed on two out-of-family tests; we report the failure and stop rather than fit a replacement.

AI.title_translation: 人类干预作为标签：定位、引导和（有时）编辑大型语言模型智能体失败背后的计算
AI.tldr: 研究将人类对LLM智能体失败的干预视为标签，用于定位、引导和编辑导致失败的内部计算，以减少过度提问。
AI.motivation: 当大型语言模型（LLM）智能体行为不当时，人类的干预通常被丢弃或仅作为训练数据重放。本文旨在利用这些干预作为“测量”或“标签”，指向失败的内部计算，从而更好地理解和修复LLM智能体的错误行为，特别是过度提问的问题。
AI.method: 本研究将人类对LLM智能体故障的干预视为指向失败内部计算的标签。在一个受控智能体环境中，研究了一个特定故障模式：当请求已明确时却询问澄清问题（过度提问）。标签由规则型监督者提供并经盲人判断验证。研究测试了13个LLM模型，其中5个符合条件。通过干预标签学习方向来定位“询问 vs. 行动”决策的因果关系，并分析了过度提问的机制签名。此外，研究还通过探针读数引导来减少监督负担，并比较了LoRA和行为克隆两种方法将修复固化到模型权重中的效果。
AI.result: 1. “询问 vs. 行动”决策在所有符合条件的模型家族中都是因果可定位的，干预标签学到的方向在特定残差流深度翻转了72-100%的过度提问。2. 过度提问有两种机制签名：在四个家族中，模型知道请求明确但仍提问；在第五个家族中，过度提问与不同世界表征相关。3. 基于探针读数的引导可消除大部分模拟监督负担，同时保留合法问题，而提示指令则会使其恶化。4. 将修复固化到权重中的效果因模型和方法而异，LoRA在某些模型上表现优于行为克隆，反之亦然，且结果存在跨种子差异。预设的几何规则在外部测试中失败。
AI.conclusion: 人类干预可以有效地作为标签来定位和引导LLM智能体内部的失败计算，特别是在处理过度提问问题上。修复方案的固化效果因模型而异，且不能通过简单的通用规则普遍预测。
AI.translation: 当大型语言模型（LLM）智能体行为不当时，人类会介入，而这种干预通常被丢弃或仅作为训练数据重放。我们反而将其视为一种测量：一个指向失败内部计算的标签。我们在一个受控的智能体环境中研究了它，针对一种失败模式（当请求已经明确时却询问澄清问题），并使用经过盲人判断验证的基于规则的监督者提供的标签。研究涵盖了符合条件的模型，这些模型既会过度提问，有时也会根据匹配的明确请求采取行动：13个模型中有5个符合条件（Qwen2.5-3B、gemma-2-2b、OLMo-3-7B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、Phi-4）。有四个发现。首先，“询问与行动”决策在每个符合条件的家族中都是因果可定位的：从干预标签学到的方向在明确的残差流深度翻转了72-100%的保留过度提问，其位置和剂量在训练数据上选择，而相同程序下的随机方向最多翻转一个情景。其次，过度提问有两种机制签名：在四个家族中，模型可证明地知道请求是明确的（这种信念是可解码的，因果惰性且与决策正交），但仍然提问；在第五个家族中，罕见的过度提问追踪不同的世界表征。第三，基于探测器读数的引导可以消除大部分模拟的监督负担，同时合法问题得以保留（自举95%置信区间排除零）；而提示指令反而会使其恶化。第四，将修复固化到权重中会产生一张图，而不是一个规则：在一个模型上，限制在因果带内的LoRA通过了所有预先设定的标准，而基于相同数据的行为克隆却破坏了保留；在三个家族中，情况正好相反；在第五个家族中，结果跨越了不同种子的边界。预先写好的预测机制的几何规则在两次家族外测试中失败；我们报告了失败并停止，而不是拟合替代方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出将人类对LLM智能体失败的干预视为内部计算失败的标签，以实现对这些失败的定位、引导和（有时）编辑。研究在一个受控环境中，针对LLM智能体在明确请求下过度提问的问题进行了深入分析。结果表明，过度提问的决策是因果可定位的，且存在两种不同的机制签名。通过探测器读数进行引导能有效减少监督负担。然而，将修复固化到模型权重中的效果因模型和方法而异，并且不能通过简单的通用规则来预测。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 人类干预, 内部计算, 故障定位, 引导, 过度提问
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过将人类干预转化为可操作的内部计算标签，为理解和修复大型语言模型智能体的故障提供了一种新颖且有前景的方法。其创新之处在于将通常被丢弃的干预信息转化为结构化的诊断工具，并深入探究了LLM内部决策的因果机制。然而，研究结果也表明，将修复固化到权重中的复杂性，以及不同模型间行为和修复效果的差异，提示了在泛化和实现鲁棒性修复方面的挑战。

title: How language model agents reshape price competition
summary: Repeated Bertrand competition is a stringent benchmark for algorithmic pricing: in homogeneous-goods markets, standard learning procedures typically select the stage-game Nash outcome with prices near marginal cost. We show that LLM pricing agents can escape this benchmark, depending on deployment decisions. LLMs outperform standard online learners through faster adaptation, but this advantage largely disappears against full-information learners. An extracted surrogate algorithm illustrates how LLMs in specific deployments profit from regularly undercutting slower learners. Agents that post one price every period from raw market histories that include rival prices can sustain supracompetitive regimes in self-play. Agents that periodically emit probability distributions from summarized histories of their own profits instead move toward the competitive region in self-play. Markets mixing these interfaces can generate dynamic regimes in which LLMs establish a high-price anchor and regularly undercut it to capture demand. These regimes can keep both competitors' prices above marginal cost. Deployment choices shape these outcomes, shifting the focus from stationary equilibria to dynamic pricing regimes.

AI.title_translation: 语言模型代理如何重塑价格竞争
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）定价代理在重复伯特兰竞争中可以超越传统算法，通过特定的部署策略维持超竞争性价格，而不是趋向边际成本。部署方式决定了市场结果，从静态均衡转向动态定价机制。
AI.motivation: 传统的伯特兰竞争模型中，标准学习算法通常会将价格推向边际成本的纳什均衡。本文的动机是探索语言模型（LLM）定价代理是否能打破这一基准，以及它们如何影响价格竞争结果。
AI.method: 研究通过部署不同类型的LLM定价代理进行重复伯特兰竞争，并与标准在线学习器和全信息学习器进行比较。具体方法包括：1. 评估LLM在不同部署决策下的表现。2. 提取代理算法以说明LLM如何通过削价获利。3. 比较两种主要部署方式：从原始市场历史中发布价格的代理，以及从自身利润历史中周期性发出概率分布的代理。4. 分析混合接口市场中的动态定价机制。
AI.result: 1. LLM定价代理在重复伯特兰竞争中可以摆脱传统基准，其表现取决于部署决策。2. LLM在适应速度上优于标准在线学习器，但面对全信息学习器时优势不明显。3. 提取的代理算法显示，特定部署下的LLM通过定期削价慢速学习者来获利。4. 从包含竞争对手价格的原始市场历史中发布价格的代理，在自博弈中可以维持超竞争性机制。5. 周期性从自身利润摘要历史中发出概率分布的代理，在自博弈中趋向竞争区域。6. 混合这些接口的市场可以产生动态机制，其中LLM建立高价锚点并定期削价以捕获需求，使双方价格保持在边际成本之上。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型定价代理能够重塑价格竞争，使其脱离传统的边际成本基准。部署决策是关键因素，决定了市场结果是从静态均衡转向动态定价机制，并可能维持超竞争性价格。
AI.translation: 重复的伯特兰竞争是算法定价的一个严格基准：在同质商品市场中，标准学习程序通常会选择价格接近边际成本的阶段博弈纳什结果。我们表明，LLM定价代理可以摆脱这个基准，这取决于部署决策。LLM通过更快的适应能力优于标准在线学习器，但这种优势在与全信息学习器对抗时基本消失。一个提取的代理算法说明了特定部署中的LLM如何通过定期削价慢速学习者来获利。从包含竞争对手价格的原始市场历史中每期发布一个价格的代理，在自博弈中可以维持超竞争性机制。而那些周期性地从自身利润摘要历史中发出概率分布的代理，在自博弈中则趋向竞争区域。混合这些接口的市场可以产生动态机制，其中LLM建立高价锚点并定期削价以捕获需求。这些机制可以使两个竞争对手的价格都保持在边际成本之上。部署选择塑造了这些结果，将焦点从静态均衡转向动态定价机制。
AI.summary: 本文研究了语言模型（LLM）定价代理如何影响重复伯特兰竞争。研究发现，LLM代理在特定部署下能够超越传统学习算法，避免价格趋向边际成本，并维持超竞争性价格。具体而言，从原始市场历史发布价格的LLM代理在自博弈中能维持高价，而基于自身利润摘要的代理则趋向竞争区域。部署决策是关键，决定了市场结果是动态定价机制而非静态均衡。
AI.keywords: 语言模型代理, 价格竞争, 伯特兰竞争, 动态定价, 部署决策
AI.comments: 本文探讨了LLM在经济学和博弈论中的潜在应用，特别是在价格竞争领域。其创新之处在于揭示了LLM代理通过其独特的学习和适应能力，能够打破传统算法定价的基准，可能导致市场结构和竞争动态的根本性变化。这对于理解未来AI驱动的市场行为具有重要意义，并强调了部署策略在塑造经济结果中的关键作用。局限性可能在于其模型是否能完全捕捉真实市场复杂性，以及LLM的“黑箱”特性如何影响其策略的可解释性和可控性。

title: Encoded but Exposed: Language Embeddings can Reveal More Than They Should in Recommender Systems
summary: Language embeddings are increasingly used in recommenders to represent item content, but their privacy risks remain poorly understood. We study whether item embeddings can reveal item identities when an adversary has access to auxiliary item text from external sources. We show that a simple cosine-similarity attack can recover item identities with high mean reciprocal rank across language models and candidate-set settings on two real-world datasets. Leakage is strongest when the adversary's partial information overlaps with the victim representation, but it also persists through semantic alignment between independently sourced descriptions. We further show that item leakage can propagate to user re-identification from sparse ratings. Finally, we evaluate obfuscated descriptions as a mitigation and find a clear leakage-utility tradeoff.

AI.title_translation: 编码但暴露：语言嵌入在推荐系统中可能泄露过多信息
AI.tldr: 推荐系统中的语言嵌入存在隐私风险，简单攻击即可通过物品文本识别物品身份，甚至导致用户再识别。缓解措施存在泄露与实用性的权衡。
AI.motivation: 语言嵌入在推荐系统中日益用于表示物品内容，但其隐私风险仍知之甚少。
AI.method: 研究人员通过一个简单的余弦相似度攻击来尝试恢复物品身份，并在两种真实世界数据集上进行测试。他们还研究了物品泄露如何传播到用户再识别，并评估了混淆描述作为一种缓解措施。
AI.result: 简单的余弦相似度攻击可以在两种真实世界数据集上，跨语言模型和候选集设置，以高平均倒数排名恢复物品身份。当攻击者的部分信息与受害者表示重叠时，泄露最强，但它也通过独立来源描述之间的语义对齐而持续存在。物品泄露可以从稀疏评分传播到用户再识别。同时，存在明显的泄露-实用性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 语言嵌入在推荐系统中存在显著的隐私风险，可能泄露物品身份并导致用户再识别。虽然混淆描述可以作为缓解措施，但存在隐私泄露和系统实用性之间的权衡。
AI.translation: 语言嵌入在推荐系统中日益用于表示物品内容，但其隐私风险仍知之甚少。我们研究当攻击者可以从外部来源获取辅助物品文本时，物品嵌入是否能揭示物品身份。我们展示，一个简单的余弦相似度攻击可以在两种真实世界数据集上，跨语言模型和候选集设置，以高平均倒数排名恢复物品身份。当攻击者的部分信息与受害者表示重叠时，泄露最强，但它也通过独立来源描述之间的语义对齐而持续存在。我们进一步展示，物品泄露可以从稀疏评分传播到用户再识别。最后，我们评估了混淆描述作为一种缓解措施，并发现了一个明显的泄露-实用性权衡。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了推荐系统中语言嵌入的隐私风险。研究表明，即使攻击者仅拥有部分或独立来源的辅助文本，通过简单的余弦相似度攻击也能高精度地恢复物品身份。此外，物品信息的泄露还可能从稀疏评分传播到用户再识别。尽管混淆描述可以作为一种缓解策略，但研究发现隐私泄露与系统实用性之间存在明显的权衡。
AI.keywords: 语言嵌入, 推荐系统, 隐私风险, 物品身份泄露, 用户再识别
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了现代推荐系统在使用语言嵌入时一个关键且常被忽视的隐私漏洞。发现即使是独立来源描述之间的语义对齐也能导致泄露，这一点尤其有见地。物品泄露传播到用户再识别进一步强调了问题的严重性。对缓解策略中泄露-实用性权衡的识别对未来的研究和实际系统设计至关重要。

title: Realization Divergence in Multi-Provider Quantum Computing: A Pre-Registered Study of What Survives Measurement
comments: 36 pages. Submitted to Software Quality Journal. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22471564
summary: Quantum programs pass through compilers, transpilers and vendor services before execution. However, the distance between what was written and what runs is rarely measured. We call this distance realization divergence: the observable difference in how an identical source circuit is realized and behaves across quantum software stacks. We report a hardware study across three vendors and four devices, combining pre-registered predictions with explicitly identified exploratory analyses and amendments. In a compilation experiment with assigned placement policies, embedding radius correlates with two-qubit overhead at Spearman 0.805, against 0.492 for circuit size. Under a fixed lowest-index policy, an eight-qubit Bernstein-Vazirani circuit exhibits greater execution divergence than a twelve-qubit circuit on IQM Emerald. The opposite ordering occurs on IQM Garnet. Both comparisons replicate across two repetitions with disjoint confidence intervals. These results support a placement-dependent explanation, without isolating individual hardware noise mechanisms. The same ordering inversion is absent on the all-to-all IonQ control. On Rigetti Cepheus, a follow-up using topology-aware native placement found no consistent advantage in correct-answer probability for either submission track, but did not establish equivalence between the tracks. Structural comparisons depend on metric weighting, placement and device generation. Provider interfaces also limit observability: Rigetti's supported-operation list remained unchanged across a device generation that replaced the native entangler. We classify silent interface failures in composed toolchains and identify checks at toolchain boundaries, connecting valid cross-provider comparisons with concrete software-quality practices.

AI.title_translation: 多供应商量子计算中的实现差异：一项关于测量结果存活的预注册研究
AI.tldr: 研究了量子程序在不同供应商硬件上运行时的差异（实现差异），发现编译和执行结果受放置策略、设备和供应商接口影响，并提出了软件质量实践。
AI.motivation: 量子程序在编译器、转译器和供应商服务后执行，但“所写”与“所运行”之间的距离很少被衡量。本文旨在衡量这种“实现差异”。
AI.method: 进行了一项跨三个供应商和四个设备的硬件研究，结合预注册预测与探索性分析。实验包括编译实验（分配放置策略）和执行实验（固定最低索引策略，以及拓扑感知原生放置）。
AI.result: 在编译实验中，嵌入半径与双量子比特开销相关性（Spearman 0.805）高于与电路大小（0.492）。在IQM Emerald上，八量子比特Bernstein-Vazirani电路比十二量子比特电路表现出更大的执行差异；在IQM Garnet上则相反，且这些结果在两次重复中具有不相交的置信区间。这种排序反转在全连接的IonQ控制上不存在。在Rigetti Cepheus上，拓扑感知原生放置未发现任一提交轨迹在正确答案概率上有一致优势，但未确定轨迹之间的等效性。结构比较取决于度量权重、放置和设备代。供应商接口限制了可观察性：Rigetti的受支持操作列表在一个替换了原生纠缠器的设备代中保持不变。识别了组合工具链中的静默接口故障以及工具链边界的检查。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持放置依赖的解释，但未隔离单个硬件噪声机制。结构比较受度量权重、放置和设备代影响。通过识别工具链边界的检查和分类静默接口故障，可以连接有效的跨供应商比较与具体的软件质量实践。
AI.translation: 量子程序在执行前会经过编译器、转译器和供应商服务。然而，“所写”与“所运行”之间的距离却很少被衡量。我们称这种距离为实现差异：即在不同量子软件堆栈中，相同源电路如何实现和行为上的可观察差异。我们报告了一项跨三个供应商和四个设备的硬件研究，将预注册的预测与明确识别的探索性分析和修正相结合。在一个分配了放置策略的编译实验中，嵌入半径与双量子比特开销的相关性为 Spearman 0.805，而与电路大小的相关性为 0.492。在固定的最低索引策略下，一个八量子比特的Bernstein-Vazirani电路在IQM Emerald上表现出比十二量子比特电路更大的执行差异。在IQM Garnet上则出现相反的顺序。两次重复的比较结果具有不相交的置信区间。这些结果支持一种放置依赖的解释，但并未隔离单独的硬件噪声机制。在全连接的IonQ控制上，这种顺序反转不存在。在Rigetti Cepheus上，一项使用拓扑感知原生放置的后续研究发现，两种提交轨迹在正确答案概率上均无一致优势，但并未建立轨迹之间的等效性。结构比较取决于度量权重、放置和设备代。供应商接口也限制了可观察性：Rigetti的受支持操作列表在一个替换了原生纠缠器的设备代中保持不变。我们对组合工具链中的静默接口故障进行了分类，并确定了工具链边界处的检查，从而将有效的跨供应商比较与具体的软件质量实践联系起来。
AI.summary: 本文研究了量子程序在不同供应商硬件上执行时存在的“实现差异”，即相同源电路在不同量子软件栈中实现和行为上的可观察差异。通过对三个供应商、四个设备的硬件研究，发现编译和执行结果受到量子比特放置策略、设备特性和设备代的影响。例如，嵌入半径与双量子比特开销高度相关，且不同设备上特定电路的执行差异表现出不同的排序。研究还指出供应商接口限制了可观察性，并提出了通过识别静默接口故障和工具链边界检查来改进跨供应商比较和软件质量实践。
AI.keywords: 量子计算, 实现差异, 供应商, 放置策略, 软件质量
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过实证研究揭示了多供应商量子计算中“所写即所运行”的挑战，即量子程序在不同硬件平台上的实现差异。其创新之处在于提出了“实现差异”这一概念并对其进行了量化分析，特别是在预注册研究框架下进行，增加了结果的可靠性。研究结果强调了放置策略、设备特性和供应商接口对量子程序性能的关键影响，为量子软件开发和平台提供商提供了重要的反馈。论文还强调了软件质量实践在跨平台比较中的重要性，具有很强的实践指导意义。

title: The $L\log L$-Luxemburg Discrepancy for Nonnegative Weights Suffers from the Curse of Dimensionality
summary: We study the normalized discrepancy in the Luxemburg norm generated by $Φ(s)=s\log(1+s)$. For arbitrary nonnegative quadrature weights, we prove that the associated information complexity suffers from the curse of dimensionality: for every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, there exist constants $c_\varepsilon>0$ and $d_0=d_0(\varepsilon)\in\mathbb{N}$ such that \[N_{Φ,+}(\varepsilon,d)\ge c_{\varepsilon} d^{-1}(1.07735\ldots)^d \qquad \mbox{for all } d\ge d_0. \] The result therefore also applies to equal-weight quasi-Monte Carlo rules.

AI.title_translation: $L\log L$-卢森堡范数下非负权重的偏差受到维度灾难的影响
AI.tldr: 对于非负权重，$L\log L$-卢森堡偏差的信息复杂性受到维度灾难的影响，呈指数增长。
AI.motivation: 研究由 $Φ(s)=s\log(1+s)$ 生成的卢森堡范数下的归一化偏差，并分析其信息复杂性。
AI.method: 通过理论证明，推导出信息复杂性的下界，从而证明维度灾难的存在。
AI.result: 证明了对于任意非负求积权重，信息复杂性 $N_{Φ,+}(\varepsilon,d)$ 存在一个下界 $N_{Φ,+}(\varepsilon,d)\ge c_{\varepsilon} d^{-1}(1.07735\ldots)^d$ (对于所有 $d\ge d_0$)，表明其随维度 $d$ 指数增长。此结果也适用于等权重准蒙特卡洛规则。
AI.conclusion: 由 $Φ(s)=s\log(1+s)$ 生成的卢森堡范数下，对于非负求积权重，归一化偏差的信息复杂性受到维度灾难的影响。
AI.translation: 我们研究了由 $Φ(s)=s\log(1+s)$ 生成的卢森堡范数下的归一化偏差。对于任意非负求积权重，我们证明了相关的信息复杂性受到维度灾难的影响：对于每一个 $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$，存在常数 $c_\varepsilon>0$ 和 $d_0=d_0(\varepsilon)\in\mathbb{N}$，使得当 $d\ge d_0$ 时，\[N_{Φ,+}(\varepsilon,d)\ge c_{\varepsilon} d^{-1}(1.07735\ldots)^d。\] 因此，该结果也适用于等权重准蒙特卡洛规则。
AI.summary: 本文研究了由 $Φ(s)=s\log(1+s)$ 定义的卢森堡范数下，非负求积权重的归一化偏差。研究结果表明，这种偏差的信息复杂性受到维度灾难的影响，具体表现为存在一个指数级的下界，即 $N_{Φ,+}(\varepsilon,d)\ge c_{\varepsilon} d^{-1}(1.07735\ldots)^d$。该结论同样适用于等权重准蒙特卡洛规则，揭示了高维情况下数值积分的基本限制。
AI.keywords: 卢森堡偏差, 维度灾难, 非负权重, 信息复杂性, 准蒙特卡洛
AI.comments: 该论文通过严格的理论证明，量化了特定卢森堡范数下偏差的信息复杂性所受到的维度灾难。这一发现对于理解和设计高维数值积分和准蒙特卡洛方法具有重要意义，揭示了这些方法在高维问题中的内在局限性。

title: International Multi-Centre Validation of Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Precise Discrimination between Normal and Abnormal Retinal Development
comments: Submitted to Nature Medicine. 38 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary material includes 3 figures and 3 tables
summary: Arrested retinal development can cause childhood visual impairment, but grading optical coherence tomography scans is difficult to standardise across devices and centres. We developed and evaluated an unsupervised domain adaptation model to classify normal and abnormal retinal development across different OCT systems. This retrospective multicentre study used OCT scans from five centres in four countries and the UK Biobank. Data covered four OCT devices, including table mounted and handheld systems. A ResNet50 based Domain Adversarial Neural Network was trained using labelled images from a source device and unlabelled images from a target device. We evaluated six source to target pairings and compared model performance with seven clinician graders. A separate Heidelberg Spectralis dataset was reserved for external evaluation. Across validation sets, accuracy ranged from 87.75% to 96.06%, sensitivity from 88.68% to 98.38%, and specificity from 78.00% to 98.02%. The best performing model, adapted from TM OCT1 to HH OCT1, achieved 96.06% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.994, with a 95% confidence interval from 0.981 to 0.999. Several models also maintained discrimination on the unseen Heidelberg device. Unsupervised domain adaptation enabled OCT classification across devices without labelled target device data. The approach may support more consistent assessment of retinal development and large scale analysis of existing imaging datasets.
