title: Path Planning on Multi-level Point Cloud with a Weighted Traversability Graph
comments: Updated the author order to match the published version
summary: This article proposes a new path planning method for addressing multi-level terrain situations. The proposed method includes innovations in three aspects: 1) the pre-processing of point cloud maps with a multi-level skip-list structure and data-slimming algorithm for well-organized and simplified map formalization and management, 2) the direct acquisition of local traversability indexes through vehicle and point cloud interaction analysis, which saves work in surface fitting, and 3) the assignment of traversability indexes on a multi-level connectivity graph to generate a weighted traversability graph for generally search-based path planning. The A* algorithm is modified to utilize the traversability graph to generate a short and safe path. The effectiveness and reliability of the proposed method are verified through indoor and outdoor experiments conducted in various environments, including multi-floor buildings, woodland, and rugged mountainous regions. The results demonstrate that the proposed method can properly address 3D path planning problems for ground vehicles in a wide range of situations.
comment: Updated the author order to match the published version

AI.title_translation: 带有加权可遍历图的多层点云路径规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的路径规划方法，通过改进点云预处理、可遍历性索引直接获取以及构建加权可遍历图，解决了多层地形中地面车辆的3D路径规划问题，并利用修改后的A*算法生成短且安全的路径。
AI.motivation: 解决多层地形情况下的路径规划问题。
AI.method: 1) 使用多级跳表结构和数据精简算法对点云地图进行预处理，实现地图的组织和简化。2) 通过车辆与点云交互分析直接获取局部可遍历性索引，避免表面拟合。3) 在多级连通图上分配可遍历性索引，生成加权可遍历图。4) 修改A*算法，利用加权可遍历图生成短且安全的路径。
AI.result: 通过在多层建筑、林地和崎岖山区等多种环境进行的室内外实验，验证了该方法的有效性和可靠性。结果表明，该方法能够妥善解决地面车辆在各种情况下的3D路径规划问题。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够妥善解决地面车辆在各种复杂地形情况下的3D路径规划问题，并生成短且安全的路径。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新的路径规划方法，用于解决多层地形情况。所提出的方法在三个方面进行了创新：1）使用多级跳表结构和数据精简算法对点云地图进行预处理，以实现组织良好和简化的地图形式化和管理；2）通过车辆与点云交互分析直接获取局部可遍历性索引，从而节省了表面拟合的工作；3）在多级连通图上分配可遍历性索引，以生成用于通用搜索路径规划的加权可遍历图。A*算法经过修改，利用该可遍历图生成短且安全的路径。通过在各种环境（包括多层建筑、林地和崎岖山区）中进行的室内外实验，验证了所提出方法的有效性和可靠性。结果表明，所提出的方法可以妥善解决地面车辆在各种情况下的3D路径规划问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对多层地形的路径规划新方法。该方法通过改进点云预处理（采用多级跳表和数据精简）、直接获取局部可遍历性索引（通过车辆与点云交互）以及在多级连通图上构建加权可遍历图，实现了地图的有效管理和路径规划。A*算法被修改以利用此加权图生成短而安全的路径。实验验证了该方法在多种复杂环境（如多层建筑、林地和山区）中对地面车辆3D路径规划问题的有效性和可靠性。
AI.keywords: 路径规划, 多层点云, 加权可遍历图, A*算法, 地面车辆
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于其多方面的综合方法，包括高效的点云预处理、直接的可遍历性评估以及将这些信息整合到加权图中的策略。通过避免耗时的表面拟合，提高了效率。该方法在处理复杂多层地形方面具有重要意义，对地面车辆的自主导航具有实际应用价值。

title: KnowEEG: Explainable Knowledge Driven EEG Classification
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) classification has shown significant promise in applications ranging from neurodegenerative disease detection to brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). Whilst deep learning methods have increasingly dominated the research landscape in recent years; these models remain largely opaque 'black boxes' with limited interpretability. In this paper, we revisit the utility of feature-based classification via a systematic pipeline designed to integrate per-electrode signal statistics with cross-brain connectivity metrics. The proposed "KnowEEG" pipeline extracts 783 per-electrode statistical features alongside between-electrode connectivity statistics, utilizing a balanced sampling strategy between high-dimensional per electrode features and connectivity. This feature-based pipeline achieves performance comparable to or exceeding state-of-the-art deep learning models across five diverse classification tasks: emotion detection, mental workload classification, eyes open/closed detection, abnormal EEG classification, and event detection. This performance is achieved without the need for Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) resources. Furthermore, the pipeline provides inherent explainability through feature importance rankings. We demonstrate via the eyes open/closed task that this explainability identifies discriminative biomarkers in the occipital region that are consistent with established neuroscience literature. These results suggest that despite significant advances in deep learning, structured feature engineering remains a high performance and interpretable method for EEG classification.

AI.title_translation: KnowEEG：可解释的知识驱动型脑电图分类
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为KnowEEG的可解释知识驱动型EEG分类流水线，它结合了电极信号统计与脑连接特征，无需GPU即可实现与顶尖深度学习媲美的性能，并具备天然的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 当前的深度学习方法在脑电图（EEG）分类中虽然占据主导地位，但它们通常是缺乏可解释性的“黑箱”模型。为了解决这一局限性，论文旨在重新评估基于特征的分类方法的效用，开发一种既高性能又具备可解释性的系统化流水线。
AI.method: 提出“KnowEEG”流水线，提取783个每电极统计特征以及电极间的连接统计特征，在每电极高维特征与连接性特征之间采用平衡采样策略，并利用特征重要性排序提供内在的可解释性。
AI.result: 在五个不同的分类任务（情感检测、心理工作负荷分类、闭眼睁眼检测、异常EEG分类和事件检测）中，所提出的基于特征的流水线实现了与当前最先进的深度学习模型相当或更优的性能，且无需GPU资源；同时，通过特征重要性排序在闭眼睁眼任务中成功识别出与神经科学文献一致的枕叶区域判别性生物标志物。
AI.conclusion: 尽管深度学习在EEG分类中占据主导地位，但结构化的特征工程（如KnowEEG管道）依然是一种高性能且具可解释性的有效方法，无需GPU即可媲美甚至超越复杂的深度学习模型。
AI.translation: 脑电图（EEG）分类在从神经退行性疾病检测到脑机接口（BCI）的应用中展现出巨大前景。虽然近年来深度学习方法在研究领域日益占主导地位，但这些模型在很大程度上仍然是不透明的“黑箱”，具有有限的可解释性。在本文中，我们重新审视了基于特征的分类的效用，通过一个系统化的管道，旨在将每个电极的信号统计量与全脑连接度量相结合。所提出的“KnowEEG”管道提取了783个每电极统计特征以及电极间连接统计特征，并在每电极高维特征与连接性之间利用了平衡采样策略。这个基于特征的管道在五个不同的分类任务（情绪检测、心理工作负荷分类、闭眼/睁眼检测、异常EEG分类和事件检测）中实现了可与最先进的深度学习模型相媲美或超越的性能。这一性能的实现不需要图形处理单元（GPU）资源。此外，该管道通过特征重要性排名提供了固有的可解释性。我们通过闭眼/睁眼任务证明，这种可解释性识别出了枕叶区域中与既定神经科学文献一致的判别性生物标志物。这些结果表明，尽管深度学习取得了重大进展，但结构化特征工程仍然是EEG分类的高性能且具可解释性的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了KnowEEG，一个可解释的知识驱动型脑电图（EEG）分类流水线。它通过整合每电极信号统计量与跨脑连接指标，在无需GPU的情况下，于五项多样化分类任务中达到了媲美甚至超越最先进深度学习模型的性能，并通过特征重要性排序提供了符合神经科学的内在可解释性。
AI.keywords: EEG分类, 可解释性, 特征工程, 脑连接, 深度学习替代方案
AI.comments: 该论文通过重新审视基于特征的分类方法，提出了一种名为KnowEEG的可解释、知识驱动的EEG分类流水线。其创新之处在于结合了电极内统计特征与跨脑连接度量，在无需GPU的情况下达到了甚至超越当前最先进深度学习模型的性能，同时具备天然的可解释性，能够识别出符合神经科学文献的生物标志物。

title: Towards Accurate State Estimation: Motion Dynamics Kalman Filter for 3D Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Robust 3D state estimation in multi-object tracking is crucial for object localization in self-driving vehicles. Misalignment between the Kalman filter (KF) motion model and an object's motion can cause state drift, particularly in distant and occlusion cases. The static motion model assumption in the conventional KF is widely used in 3D MOT due to its low latency; however, its estimation accuracy degrades as the object's motion disaligns with the chosen model due to traffic. Although recent work introduces a multimodel KF that runs multiple motion models simultaneously to improve state robustness, it incurs significant computational overhead, so many studies still favor the constant-motion KF to maintain efficiency. This work addresses this trade-off by introducing a motion dynamics Kalman filter (MD-KF) that accounts for motion variation through temporal modeling of object motion and adaptively scales the contribution of the motion components in the motion model to correct state-prediction drift caused by this variation, while maintaining computational efficiency by retaining a single-model structure. Evaluations on KITTI and the Waymo Open Dataset, complemented by vehicle experiments, show that MD-KF achieves tracking performance comparable to multimodel KF with an average 1.72x speedup, while outperforming it in handling highly distant and prolonged occluded objects.

AI.title_translation: 迈向精确的状态估计：用于3D多目标跟踪的运动动力学卡尔曼滤波
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新型运动动力学卡尔曼滤波（MD-KF），在3D多目标跟踪中兼顾了高计算效率和优异的状态估计精度。
AI.motivation: 传统3D多目标跟踪中的卡尔曼滤波常采用静态运动模型以保证低延迟，但当物体运动与模型不一致时会导致状态漂移（尤其在远距离和遮挡情况下）；而多模型卡尔曼滤波虽能提高鲁棒性，但计算开销巨大。因此，需要在计算效率和估计精度之间找到平衡。
AI.method: 提出了一种运动动力学卡尔曼滤波（MD-KF），通过对物体运动进行时间建模并自适应缩放运动模型中各运动分量的贡献，来纠正由运动变化引起的状态预测漂移，同时保持单模型结构以确保计算效率。
AI.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上的评估及实车实验表明，MD-KF实现了与多模型卡尔曼滤波相当的跟踪性能，平均提速1.72倍，且在处理高难度远距离和长时间遮挡物体时表现更佳。
AI.conclusion: MD-KF通过时间建模和自适应运动分量缩放，成功平衡了3D多目标跟踪中的计算效率与估计精度，在处理复杂遮挡和远距离目标时表现优异。
AI.translation: 多目标跟踪中稳健的3D状态估计对于自动驾驶车辆的目标定位至关重要。卡尔曼滤波（KF）运动模型与物体运动之间的错位会导致状态漂移，特别是在远距离和遮挡情况下。传统KF中的静态运动模型由于低延迟在3D MOT中被广泛使用；然而，由于交通状况导致物体的运动与所选模型不一致时，其估计精度会下降。尽管最近的研究引入了同时运行多个运动模型的多模型KF以提高状态鲁棒性，但它会产生显著的计算开销，因此许多研究为了保持效率仍偏爱恒定运动KF。本工作通过引入运动动力学卡尔曼滤波（MD-KF）来解决这一权衡问题，该滤波器通过对物体运动进行时间建模来考虑运动变化，并自适应地缩放运动模型中运动分量的贡献，以纠正由这种变化引起的状态预测漂移，同时通过保留单模型结构来保持计算效率。在KITTI和Waymo开放数据集上的评估以及车辆实验表明，MD-KF实现了与多模型KF相当的跟踪性能，平均加速1.72倍，同时在处理高距离和长时间遮挡物体方面表现优于多模型KF。
AI.summary: 论文提出了运动动力学卡尔曼滤波（MD-KF），用于解决自动驾驶3D多目标跟踪中的状态估计漂移问题。该方法通过时间建模和自适应运动分量调整，在保持单模型高效计算的同时，显著提升了处理远距离和遮挡物体的跟踪精度和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 3D多目标跟踪, 状态估计, 卡尔曼滤波, 运动动力学, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该论文针对自动驾驶中3D多目标跟踪的状态估计问题，创新性地提出了一种运动动力学卡尔曼滤波（MD-KF），在保持单模型计算效率的同时，通过时间建模和自适应权重调整有效解决了传统卡尔曼滤波在运动突变、遮挡及远距离情况下的状态漂移问题，具有很高的实用价值和性能优势。

title: GoLeash: Mitigating Golang Software Supply Chain Attacks with Runtime Policy Enforcement
summary: Modern software supply chain attacks consist of introducing new, malicious capabilities into trusted third-party software components, in order to propagate to a victim through a package dependency chain. These attacks are especially concerning for the Go language ecosystem, which is extensively used in critical cloud infrastructures. We present GoLeash, a novel system that applies the principle of least privilege at the package-level granularity, by enforcing distinct security policies for each package in the supply chain. This finer granularity enables GoLeash to detect malicious packages more precisely than traditional sandboxing that handles security policies at process- or container-level. Moreover, GoLeash remains effective under obfuscation, can overcome the limitations of static analysis, and incurs acceptable runtime overhead.

AI.title_translation: GoLeash：通过运行时策略强制缓解 Golang 软件供应链攻击
AI.tldr: GoLeash 是一种新颖的系统，通过在包级别细粒度上实施最小权限原则和独立的安全策略，有效缓解 Golang 软件供应链攻击，比传统沙箱更精确，并能应对混淆和静态分析的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现代软件供应链攻击通过在受信任的第三方软件组件中引入恶意功能，通过包依赖链传播到受害者。这些攻击对广泛用于关键云基础设施的 Go 语言生态系统尤其令人担忧。
AI.method: 提出 GoLeash 系统，它在包级别粒度上应用最小权限原则，为供应链中的每个包强制执行不同的安全策略。
AI.result: GoLeash 能够比传统在进程或容器级别处理安全策略的沙箱更精确地检测恶意包。此外，GoLeash 在混淆下仍然有效，可以克服静态分析的局限性，并产生可接受的运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: GoLeash 通过在包级别强制执行运行时策略，提供了一种有效且精确的方法来缓解 Golang 软件供应链攻击，同时克服了现有方法的局限性并保持了良好的性能。
AI.translation: 现代软件供应链攻击包括在受信任的第三方软件组件中引入新的恶意功能，以通过包依赖链传播到受害者。这些攻击对于广泛用于关键云基础设施的 Go 语言生态系统尤其令人担忧。我们提出了 GoLeash，一个新颖的系统，它在包级别粒度上应用最小权限原则，通过对供应链中的每个包强制执行不同的安全策略。这种更精细的粒度使 GoLeash 能够比传统在进程或容器级别处理安全策略的沙箱更精确地检测恶意包。此外，GoLeash 在混淆下仍然有效，可以克服静态分析的局限性，并产生可接受的运行时开销。
AI.summary: GoLeash 是一个旨在缓解 Golang 软件供应链攻击的新系统。它通过在包级别应用最小权限原则和实施独立的运行时安全策略来工作，从而比传统的进程或容器级沙箱更精确地检测恶意包。该系统在混淆环境下有效，克服了静态分析的局限性，并具有可接受的运行时开销。
AI.keywords: Golang, 软件供应链攻击, 运行时策略, 最小权限, 包级别安全
AI.comments: GoLeash 的创新之处在于其在包级别应用最小权限原则，提供了比传统沙箱更精细和精确的防御机制。这对于 Go 语言生态系统中的关键基础设施尤其重要。其能够应对混淆和静态分析局限性的能力，也增加了其实用性。

title: ZenFlow: Enabling Stall-Free Offloading for LLM Training
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) often exceeds GPU memory limits, prompting systems to offload model states to CPU memory. However, existing offloaded training frameworks like ZeRO-Offload treat all parameters equally and update the full model on the CPU, causing severe GPU stalls, where fast, expensive GPUs sit idle, waiting for slow CPU updates and limited-bandwidth PCIe transfers. We present ZenFlow, a new offloaded training framework that decouples updates between GPU and CPU by prioritizing important gradients. ZenFlow performs in-place updates of important gradients on GPU while offloading and accumulating less important ones on CPU without blocking training iterations, fully overlapping CPU work with GPU computation. To make this importance-aware design scalable, ZenFlow leverages a novel spatio-temporal locality of important gradients, concentrated in specific positions that remain stable across iterations, to make important gradient identification efficient and lightweight while preserving fidelity. Evaluation shows that ZenFlow achieves up to 5x end-to-end speedup, 2x lower PCIe traffic, 85% less GPU stalls, and up to 72% lower cloud GPU cost, all while preserving accuracy.

AI.title_translation: ZenFlow：实现LLM训练的无停顿卸载
AI.tldr: ZenFlow通过区分重要梯度并将其在GPU上更新，同时在CPU上异步处理不重要梯度，解决了LLM训练中因内存限制导致的GPU停顿问题，显著提高了训练速度和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM离线训练框架（如ZeRO-Offload）将所有参数一视同仁，并在CPU上更新整个模型，导致GPU严重停顿，因为GPU需要等待慢速CPU更新和有限带宽的PCIe传输。
AI.method: ZenFlow通过优先处理重要梯度来解耦GPU和CPU之间的更新。它在GPU上就地更新重要梯度，同时将不重要的梯度卸载到CPU上进行累积，且不阻塞训练迭代，从而完全重叠CPU工作与GPU计算。为实现重要性感知设计的可扩展性，ZenFlow利用重要梯度的新型时空局部性（集中在特定位置并跨迭代保持稳定），以实现高效轻量级的重要梯度识别，同时保持保真度。
AI.result: ZenFlow实现了高达5倍的端到端加速，降低2倍的PCIe流量，减少85%的GPU停顿，以及降低高达72%的云GPU成本，同时保持了准确性。
AI.conclusion: ZenFlow通过重要性感知的设计和高效的梯度识别，显著提高了LLM离线训练的效率，减少了GPU停顿，并在保持准确性的同时降低了成本。
AI.translation: 微调大型语言模型（LLMs）通常会超出GPU内存限制，这促使系统将模型状态卸载到CPU内存中。然而，现有离线训练框架（如ZeRO-Offload）对所有参数一视同仁，并在CPU上更新整个模型，导致GPU严重停顿，即快速昂贵的GPU闲置，等待缓慢的CPU更新和有限带宽的PCIe传输。我们提出了ZenFlow，一个新的离线训练框架，它通过优先处理重要梯度来解耦GPU和CPU之间的更新。ZenFlow在GPU上就地更新重要梯度，同时将不重要的梯度卸载到CPU上累积，且不阻塞训练迭代，从而完全重叠CPU工作与GPU计算。为了使这种重要性感知设计具有可扩展性，ZenFlow利用重要梯度的新型时空局部性（集中在特定位置且在迭代中保持稳定），以实现高效轻量级的重要梯度识别，同时保持保真度。评估显示，ZenFlow实现了高达5倍的端到端加速，降低2倍的PCIe流量，减少85%的GPU停顿，以及降低高达72%的云GPU成本，同时保持了准确性。
AI.summary: ZenFlow是一个针对大型语言模型（LLMs）离线训练的新框架，旨在解决现有方法中因CPU更新和PCIe传输导致的GPU停顿问题。它通过识别并优先在GPU上就地更新重要梯度，同时将不重要梯度异步卸载到CPU处理，从而实现GPU和CPU工作完全重叠。ZenFlow利用重要梯度的时空局部性实现高效识别。实验证明，ZenFlow能显著提高训练速度、降低PCIe流量和GPU停顿，并减少云GPU成本，同时保持模型准确性。
AI.keywords: LLM训练, 离线训练, GPU停顿, 梯度优化, ZenFlow
AI.comments: ZenFlow的创新在于其重要性感知的设计，打破了传统离线训练框架中所有参数一视同仁的模式。通过将梯度更新解耦并利用重要梯度的时空局部性，它有效地解决了GPU停顿这一核心问题，显著提升了LLM训练的效率和成本效益。这种方法为未来大规模模型训练的优化提供了新的思路。

title: Parallel Layer Normalization for Universal Approximation
comments: 34 pages, 11 figures. Revised theoretical analysis, proofs, and experiments
summary: Layer Normalization (LN) is usually studied for its role in optimization, but it also acts as a multivariate nonlinearity between affine layers. We investigate how grouping LN units affects the approximation power of neural networks as width grows. In Parallel Layer Normalization networks (PLN-Nets), fixed-dimensional LN units are applied independently to groups between two affine layers. We prove that a shallow LN-Net with one LN unit is non-universal regardless of width, whereas PLN-Nets become universal as the number of parallel groups grows. The mechanism extends to deep networks, Root Mean Square Normalization (RMSNorm) variants, position-wise feed-forward networks, and convolutional networks under suitable grouping structures. Controlled MLP and physics-informed neural network (PINN) experiments support PLN's practical viability, while CNN and ViT experiments show that group count shapes the finite-sample fitting envelope but does not act alone: the grouped axes, replacement site, and label structure lead to distinct fitting and generalization behavior.
comment: 34 pages, 11 figures. Revised theoretical analysis, proofs, and experiments

AI.title_translation: 面向通用逼近的并行层归一化
AI.tldr: 研究证明单层LN无法实现通用逼近，而采用固定维度的并行层归一化（PLN）可随组数增加恢复通用逼近性，并在多种深度架构中展现出良好的表达与拟合能力。
AI.motivation: 层归一化通常被视作优化与稳定训练的工具，但其在仿射层之间同时充当多元非线性映射。现有研究尚不清楚改变LN单元的分组结构如何随着网络宽度扩展而影响网络的函数逼近能力。
AI.method: 提出并行层归一化网络（PLN-Nets），在两个仿射层之间将固定维度的LN单元独立应用于不同分组；通过理论推导证明其逼近性质，并将该分组机制推广至深度网络、RMSNorm变体、逐位置前馈网络以及卷积网络架构。
AI.result: 理论证明浅层单LN单元网络无论宽度多大均不具备通用逼近能力，而PLN-Nets随并行组数增加可实现通用逼近；受控MLP与PINN实验验证了PLN的实用性；CNN与ViT实验进一步表明分组数量、分组轴、替换位置与标签结构共同决定了拟合与泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 单一全局LN网络不具备通用逼近性，而通过引入多组固定维度的并行层归一化（PLN），网络能够随组数增加恢复通用逼近能力；合理的分组机制是发挥归一化层表征潜力的关键。
AI.translation: 层归一化（LN）通常因其在优化中的作用而被研究，但它在仿射层之间也扮演着多元非线性映射的角色。我们研究了随着宽度增加，LN单元的分组如何影响神经网络的逼近能力。在并行层归一化网络（PLN-Nets）中，固定维度的LN单元被独立应用于两个仿射层之间的各个分组。我们证明，无论宽度如何，仅包含一个LN单元的浅层LN网络都不具备通用逼近能力，而PLN-Nets随着并行分组数量的增加而具备通用逼近能力。该机制在合适的分组结构下可拓展至深度网络、均方根归一化（RMSNorm）变体、逐位置前馈网络以及卷积网络。受控的MLP和物理信息神经网络（PINN）实验支持了PLN的实际可行性，而CNN和ViT实验表明，分组数量决定了有限样本拟合包络，但并非单独起作用：分组轴、替换位置和标签结构会导致不同的拟合与泛化行为。
AI.summary: 本文从非线性逼近角度研究了层归一化，证明了单LN浅层网络无法通用逼近，提出了通过将固定维度LN单元并行分组的PLN网络，证明了其随组数增加具备通用逼近能力，并在多种网络架构及实验中验证了该机制的有效性与表征特性。
AI.keywords: 层归一化, 通用逼近, 并行层归一化, RMSNorm, 神经网络表征
AI.comments: 该研究从函数逼近论这一新颖视角审视了层归一化（LN），揭示了LN作为多元非线性的本质，指出了单一全局LN在逼近能力上的根本缺陷，具有重要的理论创新性。其提出的并行分组机制（PLN）既保证了通用逼近性，又能推广到RMSNorm、Transformer和CNN等主流架构。局限性在于实际视觉和复杂任务中，分组数与分组轴、替换位置等相互作用较复杂，最佳结构配置仍需依赖经验设计。

title: An Empirical Analysis of EOS Blockchain: Architecture, Contract, and Security
summary: With the rapid development of blockchain technology, various blockchain systems are exhibiting vitality and potential. As a representative of Blockchain 3.0, the EOS blockchain has been regarded as a strong competitor to Ethereum. Nevertheless, compared with Bitcoin and Ethereum, academic research and in-depth analyses of EOS remain scarce. To address this gap, this study conducts a comprehensive investigation of the EOS blockchain from five key dimensions: system architecture, decentralization, performance, smart contracts, and behavioral security. The architectural analysis focuses on six core components of the EOS system, detailing their functionalities and operational workflows. The decentralization and performance evaluations, based on data from the XBlock data-sharing platform, reveal several critical issues: low account activity, limited participation in the supernode election process, minimal variation in the set of block producers, and a substantial gap between actual throughput and the claimed million-level performance. Five types of contract vulnerabilities are identified in the smart contract dimension, and four mainstream vulnerability detection platforms are introduced and comparatively analyzed. In terms of behavioral security, four real-world attacks targeting the structural characteristics of EOS are summarized. This study contributes to the ongoing development of the EOS blockchain and provides valuable insights for enhancing the security and regulatory mechanisms of blockchain ecosystems.

AI.title_translation: EOS区块链的实证分析：架构、合约与安全
AI.tldr: 本研究对EOS区块链进行了全面的实证分析，涵盖系统架构、去中心化、性能、智能合约和行为安全，揭示了其在去中心化和性能方面的问题，并识别了合约漏洞和安全攻击。
AI.motivation: 尽管EOS区块链作为区块链3.0的代表和以太坊的强大竞争者，但对其的学术研究和深入分析相对稀缺。本研究旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 本研究从系统架构、去中心化、性能、智能合约和行为安全五个关键维度对EOS区块链进行了全面调查。架构分析侧重于EOS系统的六个核心组件。去中心化和性能评估基于XBlock数据共享平台的数据。智能合约方面识别了五种漏洞类型，并比较分析了四种主流漏洞检测平台。行为安全方面总结了四种针对EOS结构特征的真实攻击。
AI.result: 去中心化和性能评估揭示了：账户活跃度低、超级节点选举参与度有限、区块生产者集合变化小、实际吞吐量与声称的百万级性能存在巨大差距。智能合约方面识别了五种合约漏洞。行为安全方面总结了四种针对EOS结构特征的真实攻击。
AI.conclusion: 本研究有助于EOS区块链的持续发展，并为增强区块链生态系统的安全和监管机制提供了宝贵见解。
AI.translation: 随着区块链技术的快速发展，各种区块链系统展现出活力和潜力。作为区块链3.0的代表，EOS区块链被视为以太坊的有力竞争者。然而，与比特币和以太坊相比，关于EOS的学术研究和深入分析仍然稀缺。为了弥补这一空白，本研究从系统架构、去中心化、性能、智能合约和行为安全五个关键维度对EOS区块链进行了全面调查。架构分析侧重于EOS系统的六个核心组件，详细阐述了它们的功能和操作流程。基于XBlock数据共享平台的数据，去中心化和性能评估揭示了几个关键问题：账户活跃度低、超级节点选举过程参与度有限、区块生产者集合变化最小，以及实际吞吐量与声称的百万级性能之间存在巨大差距。在智能合约维度，识别了五种合约漏洞，并介绍和比较分析了四种主流漏洞检测平台。在行为安全方面，总结了四种针对EOS结构特征的真实攻击。本研究有助于EOS区块链的持续发展，并为增强区块链生态系统的安全和监管机制提供了宝贵见解。
AI.summary: 本研究对EOS区块链进行了全面的实证分析，涵盖系统架构、去中心化、性能、智能合约和行为安全。研究发现EOS在去中心化和实际性能方面存在显著问题，如账户活跃度低、超级节点选举参与度有限、区块生产者集合变化小以及实际吞吐量远低于宣传。此外，还识别了多种智能合约漏洞并总结了针对EOS结构特征的真实攻击。本研究旨在弥补EOS研究的不足，并为区块链安全和监管提供见解。
AI.keywords: EOS区块链, 系统架构, 智能合约, 安全, 去中心化
AI.comments: 本文对EOS区块链进行了多维度的深入实证分析，填补了EOS研究领域的空白。其创新之处在于结合了系统架构、链上数据分析、智能合约漏洞识别和真实攻击案例总结，全面揭示了EOS在去中心化、性能和安全方面的潜在问题。研究结果对理解EOS的实际运行状况及其面临的挑战具有重要意义，并为未来区块链系统的设计、安全增强和监管提供了宝贵的实证依据。

title: RUSplatting: Robust 3D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Underwater Scene Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing high-fidelity underwater scenes remains a challenging task due to light absorption, scattering, and limited visibility inherent in aquatic environments. This paper presents an enhanced Gaussian Splatting-based framework that improves both the visual quality and geometric accuracy of deep underwater rendering. We propose decoupled learning for RGB channels, guided by the physics of underwater attenuation, to enable more accurate colour restoration. To address sparse-view limitations and improve view consistency, we introduce a frame interpolation strategy with a novel adaptive weighting scheme. Additionally, we introduce a new loss function aimed at reducing noise while preserving edges, which is essential for deep-sea content. We also release a newly collected dataset, Submerged3D, captured specifically in deep-sea environments. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods with PSNR gains up to 1.90dB, delivering superior perceptual quality and robustness, and offering promising directions for marine robotics and underwater visual analytics. The code of RUSplatting is available at https://github.com/theflash987/RUSplatting and the dataset Submerged3D can be downloaded at https://zenodo.org/records/15482420.

AI.title_translation: RUSplatting：用于稀疏视角水下场景重建的稳健 3D 高斯溅射
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 RUSplatting 框架，通过物理引导的解耦学习、帧插值策略和新型损失函数，实现了稀疏视角下高质量的深海场景 3D 高斯溅射重建。
AI.motivation: 由于水下环境中存在光吸收、散射和可见度受限等问题，高保真水下场景重建极具挑战性；此外，现有方法在稀疏视角和深海环境下的重建质量和几何精度往往不足。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于高斯溅射的增强框架，包括：1) 受水下衰减物理学启发、针对RGB通道的解耦学习；2) 具有新颖自适应加权方案的帧插值策略；3) 旨在减少噪声同时保持边缘的新型损失函数。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架在稀疏视角水下场景重建中持续优于当前最先进的方法，实现了高达 1.90dB 的 PSNR 增益，并展现出优越的感知质量和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RUSplatting 框架通过物理引导的色彩恢复、帧插值策略和优化的损失函数，在稀疏视角水下场景重建中展现出卓越的性能、鲁棒性和视觉质量，超越了现有最先进的方法。
AI.translation: 由于水力环境中固有的光吸收、散射和有限的可见性，重建高保真水下场景仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。本文提出了一种增强的基于高斯溅射的框架，该框架改善了深水渲染的视觉质量和几何精度。我们提出了受水下衰减物理学启发的 RGB 通道解耦学习，以实现更准确的色彩恢复。为了解决稀疏视角的局限性并提高视角一致性，我们引入了一种具有新颖自适应加权方案的帧插值策略。此外，我们引入了一种旨在减少噪声同时保持边缘的新损失函数，这对于深海内容至关重要。我们还发布了一个新收集的数据集 Submerged3D，专门在深海环境中捕获。实验结果表明，我们的框架在 PSNR 增益高达 1.90dB 的情况下，持续优于最先进的方法，提供了卓越的感知质量和鲁棒性，并为海洋机器人和水下视觉分析提供了有前景的方向。RUSplatting 的代码可在 https://github.com/theflash987/RUSplatting 获取，Submerged3D 数据集可在 https://zenodo.org/records/15482420 下载。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 RUSplatting，一种用于稀疏视角水下场景重建的稳健 3D 高斯溅射框架。通过物理引导的 RGB 解耦学习、自适应权重的帧插值策略以及优化的损失函数，显著提升了深海环境下的色彩恢复、几何精度和视点一致性，并在新收集的 Submerged3D 数据集上验证了其卓越性能。
AI.keywords: 3D Gaussian Splatting, Underwater Scene Reconstruction, Sparse-View, Physics-Guided Learning
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将物理引导的解耦学习、自适应权重的帧插值策略以及保边去噪损失函数相结合，有效解决了稀疏视角水下场景重建的难题。不仅提升了水下图像重建的视觉质量与几何精度，还贡献了一个全新的深海数据集 Submerged3D，对海洋机器人和水下视觉分析领域具有重要推动作用。

title: Password Strength Detection via Machine Learning: Analysis, Modeling, and Evaluation
summary: As network security issues continue gaining prominence, password security has become crucial in safeguarding personal information and network systems. This study first introduces various methods for system password cracking, outlines password defense strategies, and discusses the application of machine learning in the realm of password security. Subsequently, we conduct a detailed public password database analysis, uncovering standard features and patterns among passwords. We extract multiple characteristics of passwords, including length, the number of digits, the number of uppercase and lowercase letters, and the number of special characters. We then experiment with six different machine learning algorithms: support vector machines, logistic regression, neural networks, decision trees, random forests, and stacked models, evaluating each model's performance based on various metrics, including accuracy, recall, and F1 score through model validation and hyperparameter tuning. The evaluation results on the test set indicate that decision trees and stacked models excel in accuracy, recall, and F1 score, making them a practical option for the strong and weak password classification task.

AI.title_translation: 基于机器学习的密码强度检测：分析、建模与评估
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了使用机器学习进行密码强度检测，通过分析公共密码数据库并提取特征，比较了六种机器学习算法，发现决策树和堆叠模型在准确性、召回率和F1分数方面表现最佳，适用于强弱密码分类任务。
AI.motivation: 随着网络安全问题日益突出，密码安全在保护个人信息和网络系统方面变得至关重要。本研究旨在通过机器学习方法，有效检测密码强度，以应对这一挑战。
AI.method: 研究首先介绍了系统密码破解方法和防御策略，并讨论了机器学习在密码安全领域的应用。随后，详细分析了公共密码数据库，提取了包括长度、数字、大小写字母和特殊字符数量等密码特征。实验中使用了支持向量机、逻辑回归、神经网络、决策树、随机森林和堆叠模型六种机器学习算法，并通过模型验证和超参数调优，评估了各模型在准确性、召回率和F1分数等指标上的性能。
AI.result: 在测试集上的评估结果表明，决策树和堆叠模型在准确性、召回率和F1分数方面表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 决策树和堆叠模型是强弱密码分类任务的实用选择。
AI.translation: 随着网络安全问题日益突出，密码安全在保护个人信息和网络系统方面变得至关重要。本研究首先介绍了各种系统密码破解方法，概述了密码防御策略，并讨论了机器学习在密码安全领域的应用。随后，我们进行了详细的公共密码数据库分析，揭示了密码的标准特征和模式。我们提取了密码的多个特征，包括长度、数字数量、大小写字母数量以及特殊字符数量。然后，我们实验了六种不同的机器学习算法：支持向量机、逻辑回归、神经网络、决策树、随机森林和堆叠模型，通过模型验证和超参数调优，评估了每种模型在准确性、召回率和F1分数等各种指标上的性能。测试集上的评估结果表明，决策树和堆叠模型在准确性、召回率和F1分数方面表现出色，使其成为强弱密码分类任务的实用选择。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在通过机器学习方法检测密码强度，以应对日益增长的网络安全挑战。文章分析了密码破解与防御策略，并深入探究了公共密码数据库，提取了多种密码特征。研究比较了支持向量机、逻辑回归、神经网络、决策树、随机森林和堆叠模型六种机器学习算法在强弱密码分类任务上的性能。结果显示，决策树和堆叠模型在准确性、召回率和F1分数上表现卓越，被认为是该任务的有效实用方案。
AI.keywords: 密码强度检测, 机器学习, 网络安全, 强弱密码分类, 模型评估
AI.comments: 这篇论文在网络安全领域具有实际应用价值，特别是其对多种机器学习算法在密码强度检测上的比较分析，为选择合适的模型提供了数据支持。通过对公共密码数据库的深入分析和特征提取，论文展现了扎实的研究基础。其创新点在于系统性地评估了不同ML模型在特定任务上的性能，并明确指出了最优选择。未来的工作可以考虑引入更复杂的特征工程或深度学习模型以进一步提升性能。

title: HERO: Preserving Structure and Semantics in Heterogeneous Continual Graph Learning
summary: Machine learning on heterogeneous graphs has advanced rapidly, driven by the diverse entities, relations, and semantics inherent in real-world data. However, most existing studies assume static graphs, whereas real-world graph data are often continuously updated. Continual learning in this setting is particularly challenging because historical knowledge is encoded not only in target-node representations, but also in their heterogeneous structural contexts and relation-dependent semantic responses. To this end, we introduce HERO, a heterogeneous continual graph learning framework that preserves historical knowledge at both structural and semantic levels while adapting to incoming tasks. We analyze experience replay as an approximation to the unavailable historical gradient and decompose its error into target-selection and context-reconstruction terms. This analysis shows that replaying target nodes alone is generally insufficient for relation-sensitive HGNNs, as removing typed neighborhood context can alter both representations and historical gradients. Motivated by this, HERO employs DiSCo to select representative target nodes and reconstruct compact heterogeneous contexts through relation-aware multi-type neighbor expansion. To further preserve knowledge that cannot be captured by replayed subgraphs alone, HERO aligns task-conditioned predictions and heterogeneous semantic responses through multi-level knowledge distillation. A lightweight look-ahead adaptation step is additionally used to improve plasticity on incoming tasks. Experiments on four datasets with three HGNN backbones show that HERO achieves the best or tied-best average performance among state-of-the-art baselines, while maintaining competitive forgetting. Our code is available at https://github.com/gqBond/HCGL.

AI.title_translation: HERO：在异构持续图学习中保留结构和语义
AI.tldr: HERO是一个异构持续图学习框架，旨在通过保留结构和语义层面的历史知识来解决异构图数据持续更新的挑战，并在四个数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有异构图机器学习研究大多假设图是静态的，而现实世界的图数据是持续更新的。在这种持续学习设置中，历史知识不仅编码在目标节点表示中，还编码在它们的异构结构上下文和依赖关系的语义响应中，这使得持续学习极具挑战性。
AI.method: HERO框架通过以下方法实现：1. 采用DiSCo选择代表性目标节点，并通过关系感知多类型邻居扩展重建紧凑的异构上下文。2. 通过多级知识蒸馏对任务条件预测和异构语义响应进行对齐，以保留仅通过重放子图无法捕获的知识。3. 使用轻量级前瞻适应步骤来提高对传入任务的可塑性。该方法还分析了经验回放的误差，并分解为目标选择和上下文重建项。
AI.result: 在四个数据集和三个异构图神经网络骨干上的实验表明，HERO在最先进的基线中取得了最佳或并列最佳的平均性能，同时保持了有竞争力的遗忘率。
AI.conclusion: HERO框架通过有效保留结构和语义层面的历史知识，成功解决了异构持续图学习的挑战，并在性能和遗忘率之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.translation: 异构图上的机器学习发展迅速，这得益于现实世界数据中固有的多样实体、关系和语义。然而，大多数现有研究假设图是静态的，而现实世界的图数据通常是持续更新的。在这种设置下的持续学习特别具有挑战性，因为历史知识不仅编码在目标节点表示中，还编码在它们的异构结构上下文和依赖关系的语义响应中。为此，我们引入了HERO，一个异构持续图学习框架，它在结构和语义层面保留历史知识，同时适应传入任务。我们分析了经验回放作为不可用历史梯度的近似，并将其误差分解为目标选择和上下文重建项。该分析表明，仅重放目标节点对于关系敏感的异构图神经网络通常是不够的，因为移除类型化的邻域上下文可以改变表示和历史梯度。受此启发，HERO采用DiSCo选择代表性目标节点，并通过关系感知多类型邻居扩展重建紧凑的异构上下文。为了进一步保留仅通过重放子图无法捕获的知识，HERO通过多级知识蒸馏对任务条件预测和异构语义响应进行对齐。此外，还使用了一个轻量级的前瞻适应步骤来提高对传入任务的可塑性。在四个数据集和三个异构图神经网络骨干上的实验表明，HERO在最先进的基线中取得了最佳或并列最佳的平均性能，同时保持了有竞争力的遗忘率。我们的代码可在https://github.com/gqBond/HCGL获取。
AI.summary: HERO是一个针对异构持续图学习的框架，旨在解决现实世界中图数据不断更新带来的挑战。针对现有方法在静态图假设下的局限性，HERO通过在结构和语义层面保留历史知识来适应新任务。该框架分析了经验回放的误差来源，并引入了DiSCo进行节点选择和上下文重建，同时利用多级知识蒸馏和前瞻适应来增强知识保留和模型可塑性。实验证明HERO在多个数据集上表现优异，并有效控制了遗忘。
AI.keywords: 异构图学习, 持续学习, 知识保留, 图神经网络, 经验回放
AI.comments: HERO的创新之处在于其对异构持续图学习中历史知识保留的全面考虑，不仅关注节点表示，还深入到异构结构上下文和关系依赖的语义响应。通过分解经验回放误差并引入DiSCo、多级知识蒸馏和前瞻适应等模块，该方法提供了一个鲁棒的解决方案。其对结构和语义的显式处理对于处理复杂异构图的动态变化至关重要。

title: HonestFace: Towards Honest Face Restoration with One-Step Diffusion Model
summary: Face restoration has achieved significant advancements through the years of development. However, maintaining high fidelity and authenticity while avoiding artifacts remains challenging, especially in extreme degradation scenarios. This highlights the need for models that are more ``honest'' in their reconstruction from low-quality inputs, accurately reflecting original characteristics. In this work, we propose HonestFace, a novel approach for honest face restoration with identity consistency and realistic textures. To achieve this, HonestFace incorporates several key components. First, we propose an identity embedder to effectively capture and preserve crucial identity features from both the low-quality input and multiple reference faces. Second, a masked face alignment method is presented to enhance fine-grained details and textural authenticity. Furthermore, we present a new real-world reference-based face restoration dataset, \textbf{MultiRefCeleb-Test}, with multiple high-quality references and low-quality inputs. Leveraging these contributions within a one-step diffusion model framework, HonestFace delivers excellent restoration results in terms of facial fidelity and realism. Experiments demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior performance in both visual quality and quantitative assessments. The code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/jkwang28/HonestFace .

AI.title_translation: HonestFace：迈向一步扩散模型的诚实人脸修复
AI.tldr: 提出HonestFace，一个基于一步扩散模型的诚实人脸修复方法，通过身份嵌入器和掩码人脸对齐实现身份一致性和真实纹理，并引入新数据集，在人脸修复方面超越现有技术。
AI.motivation: 尽管人脸修复取得了显著进展，但在极端退化场景下，保持高保真度、真实性并避免伪影仍然具有挑战性，这突出表明需要模型能更“诚实”地从低质量输入中重建，准确反映原始特征。
AI.method: 本文提出了HonestFace，一种新颖的诚实人脸修复方法，旨在实现身份一致性和真实纹理。它整合了几个关键组件：首先，一个身份嵌入器用于有效捕获并保留来自低质量输入和多个参考人脸的关键身份特征；其次，提出了一种掩码人脸对齐方法以增强细粒度细节和纹理真实性。此外，还提出了一个新的真实世界参考人脸修复数据集MultiRefCeleb-Test，包含多个高质量参考和低质量输入。HonestFace在一个一步扩散模型框架中利用这些贡献。
AI.result: HonestFace在面部保真度和真实感方面提供了出色的修复结果。实验表明，该方法超越了最先进的方法，在视觉质量和定量评估方面均取得了卓越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的HonestFace通过其创新的组件（身份嵌入器、掩码人脸对齐）和新数据集，结合一步扩散模型，成功实现了高保真、身份一致且真实的“诚实”人脸修复，并在性能上超越了现有技术。
AI.translation: 人脸修复经过多年的发展取得了显著进步。然而，在保持高保真度和真实性的同时避免伪影仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在极端退化场景中。这突出表明需要模型能更“诚实”地从低质量输入中重建，准确反映原始特征。在这项工作中，我们提出了HonestFace，一种新颖的诚实人脸修复方法，具有身份一致性和真实纹理。为实现这一目标，HonestFace整合了几个关键组件。首先，我们提出了一个身份嵌入器，以有效捕获并保留来自低质量输入和多个参考人脸的关键身份特征。其次，提出了一种掩码人脸对齐方法，以增强细粒度细节和纹理真实性。此外，我们提出了一个新的真实世界参考人脸修复数据集MultiRefCeleb-Test，包含多个高质量参考和低质量输入。HonestFace在一个一步扩散模型框架中利用这些贡献，在面部保真度和真实感方面提供了出色的修复结果。实验表明，我们的方法超越了最先进的方法，在视觉质量和定量评估方面均取得了卓越的性能。代码和预训练模型可在https://github.com/jkwang28/HonestFace 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HonestFace，一个基于一步扩散模型的诚实人脸修复方法，旨在解决极端退化场景下人脸修复中保真度和真实性难以保持的问题。HonestFace通过引入身份嵌入器来捕捉身份特征，采用掩码人脸对齐增强细节和纹理，并构建了新的MultiRefCeleb-Test数据集。实验证明，HonestFace在面部保真度和真实感方面表现出色，并超越了现有最先进的方法。
AI.keywords: 人脸修复, 扩散模型, 身份一致性, 真实纹理, 数据集
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了“诚实”人脸修复的概念，强调在重建时准确反映原始特征，避免伪影。通过结合身份嵌入器、掩码人脸对齐和新的参考数据集，并在一步扩散模型框架下工作，HonestFace有效地解决了极端退化场景下人脸修复的挑战，实现了高保真和身份一致性。其超越SOTA的性能表明了该方法的有效性和重要性。

title: IKMo: Image-Keyframed Motion Generation with Trajectory-Pose Conditioned Motion Diffusion Model
comments: 6 pages; accepted to ICME 2026 (Spotlight). Camera-ready version with updated author list and abstract
summary: While text-to-motion generation is mainstream, integrating explicit spatial constraints has become a standard solution for precise animation. Existing state-of-the-art models are tailored for professional workflows, effectively processing high-quality, pre-aligned 3D inputs via unified conditioning mechanisms. However, this strictly aligned setting restricts accessibility for general users who rely on unaligned, in-the-wild 2D reference images. This accessible scenario introduces a fundamental conflict: heterogeneous geometric constraints, where user-defined global trajectories clash with local image-derived poses. To resolve this coordinate mismatch, we propose TPMDM, a diffusion model featuring a decoupled parallel control strategy that explicitly isolates and aligns these divergent signals. Furthermore, we introduce IKMo, a holistic framework that synergizes TPMDM with a VLM-powered multi-agent system. By bridging the semantic-geometric gap, IKMo translates user-friendly inputs into explicit motion constraints to drive the diffusion backbone. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate that our method establishes a new state-of-the-art in the task of generating motions under heterogeneous trajectory and keyframe pose constraints.
comment: 6 pages; accepted to ICME 2026 (Spotlight). Camera-ready version with updated author list and abstract

AI.title_translation: IKMo：图像关键帧运动生成与轨迹-姿态条件运动扩散模型
AI.tldr: IKMo提出了一种新的扩散模型（TPMDM）和框架，通过解耦并行控制策略和VLM驱动的多智能体系统，解决了在非对齐2D参考图像下，用户定义全局轨迹与局部图像姿态之间异构几何约束的运动生成问题，并在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上达到了SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的运动生成模型专为专业工作流程设计，处理高质量、预对齐的3D输入。然而，这种严格对齐的设置限制了普通用户使用非对齐、野外2D参考图像的便捷性。这种场景引入了一个根本性冲突：用户定义的全局轨迹与局部图像派生姿态之间的异构几何约束，即坐标不匹配问题。
AI.method: 为解决坐标不匹配问题，本文提出了TPMDM，一个具有解耦并行控制策略的扩散模型，它明确地隔离并对齐这些不同的信号。此外，本文引入了IKMo，一个将TPMDM与VLM驱动的多智能体系统协同作用的整体框架。IKMo通过弥合语义-几何鸿沟，将用户友好的输入转换为明确的运动约束，以驱动扩散骨干。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上的实验表明，该方法在异构轨迹和关键帧姿态约束下的运动生成任务中达到了新的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: IKMo通过提出TPMDM扩散模型和VLM驱动的多智能体系统框架，成功解决了图像关键帧运动生成中轨迹与姿态异构约束的坐标不匹配问题，显著提高了普通用户生成精确动画的便捷性和效果。
AI.translation: 虽然文本到运动生成是主流，但集成明确的空间约束已成为精确动画的标准解决方案。现有最先进的模型专为专业工作流程量身定制，通过统一的条件机制有效处理高质量、预对齐的3D输入。然而，这种严格对齐的设置限制了依赖未对齐、野外2D参考图像的普通用户的可访问性。这种可访问的场景引入了一个根本性冲突：异构几何约束，即用户定义的全局轨迹与局部图像派生姿态之间的冲突。为了解决这种坐标不匹配问题，我们提出了TPMDM，一个具有解耦并行控制策略的扩散模型，它明确地隔离并对齐这些不同的信号。此外，我们引入了IKMo，一个将TPMDM与VLM驱动的多智能体系统协同作用的整体框架。通过弥合语义-几何鸿沟，IKMo将用户友好的输入转换为明确的运动约束，以驱动扩散骨干。在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上的实验表明，我们的方法在异构轨迹和关键帧姿态约束下的运动生成任务中建立了新的最先进水平。
AI.summary: 本文提出了IKMo，一个用于图像关键帧运动生成的整体框架，旨在解决普通用户使用非对齐2D参考图像时遇到的异构几何约束问题。该框架核心是TPMDM扩散模型，它采用解耦并行控制策略来解决用户定义全局轨迹与局部图像姿态之间的坐标不匹配。IKMo进一步整合了VLM驱动的多智能体系统，将用户输入转化为明确的运动约束。实验证明，IKMo在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上，在处理异构轨迹和关键帧姿态约束的运动生成任务中达到了SOTA。
AI.keywords: 图像关键帧运动生成, 扩散模型, 轨迹-姿态条件, 异构几何约束, VLM
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地解决了图像关键帧运动生成中，2D参考图像带来的异构几何约束难题，特别是全局轨迹与局部姿态的坐标不匹配问题。通过引入TPMDM解耦并行控制策略和VLM驱动的多智能体系统，IKMo极大地提升了普通用户利用非专业输入生成精确动画的能力，降低了专业动画制作的门槛，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Reweighted Spectral Partitioning Works: A Simple Algorithm for Vertex Separators in Special Graph Classes
summary:
We establish that a practical polynomial-time algorithm obtains near-optimal $\frac23$-balanced vertex separators for a number of graph classes, including genus-$g$ graphs, $K_h$-minor-free graphs, and geometric graphs. For many of these classes, our polynomial-time separator bounds improve on previous work. Moreover, unlike previous work, all these separators are produced by a single unified algorithm that has no specialization for the graph class, and this algorithm admits a scalable implementation with good empirical results. Furthermore, our approach is robust to graphs falling just outside these classes, making it appropriate for practical applications like road networks.
  A key distinction of our approach, compared to previous work, is the disentanglement of our algorithm and its analysis for specific graph classes. Our algorithm is based on a newly improved form of a recent Cheeger-style inequality relating the value of a special semidefinite program to vertex expansion. Our analysis then only has to directly bound the value of this semidefinite program for each graph class, and constructions for these bounds need not be algorithmic. Finally, we obtain several results of independent interest. These include an improved (existential) separator theorem for intersection graphs of $k$-ply $d$-dimensional balls, an improved bound on the Fiedler value of genus-$g$ graphs, and a complete spectral proof of the planar separator theorem.

title: AI Knows Where You Are: Exposure, Bias, and Inference in Multimodal Geolocation with KoreaGEO
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled accurate image-based geolocation, raising serious concerns about location privacy risks in everyday social media posts. Yet, a systematic evaluation of such risks is still lacking: existing benchmarks show coarse granularity, linguistic bias, and a neglect of multimodal privacy risks. To address these gaps, we introduce KoreaGEO, the first fine-grained, multimodal, and privacy-aware benchmark for geolocation, built on Korean street views. The benchmark covers four socio-spatial clusters and nine place types with rich contextual annotations and two captioning styles that simulate real-world privacy exposure. To evaluate mainstream VLMs, we design a three-path protocol spanning image-only, functional-caption, and high-risk-caption inputs, enabling systematic analysis of localization accuracy, spatial bias, and reasoning behavior. Results show that input modality exerts a stronger influence on localization precision and privacy exposure than model scale or architecture, with high-risk captions substantially boosting accuracy. Moreover, they highlight structural prediction biases toward core cities.

title: Differentially Private Distribution Release of Gaussian Mixture Models via KL-Divergence Minimization
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) are widely used statistical models for representing multi-modal data distributions, with numerous applications in data mining, pattern recognition, data simulation, and machine learning. However, recent research has shown that releasing GMM parameters poses significant privacy risks, potentially exposing sensitive information about the underlying data. In this paper, we address the challenge of releasing GMM parameters while ensuring differential privacy (DP) guarantees. Specifically, we focus on the privacy protection of mixture weights, component means, and covariance matrices. We propose to use Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as a utility metric to assess the accuracy of the released GMM, as it captures the joint impact of noise perturbation on all the model parameters. We develop a KL-divergence-driven optimization framework for differentially private GMM release that jointly designs privacy-budget allocation and parameter perturbations. Through theoretical analysis, we quantify the effects of privacy budget allocation and perturbation statistics on the DP guarantee, and derive a tractable expression for evaluating KL divergence. We formulate and solve an optimization problem to minimize the KL divergence between the released and fitted non-private models, subject to a given $(ε, δ)$-DP constraint. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves strong privacy guarantees while maintaining high utility.

title: Infinite lexicographic products of positional objectives
summary: This paper contributes to the study of positional determinacy of infinite duration games played on potentially infinite graphs with neutral transitions. Recently, [Ohlmann, TheoretiCS 2023] established that positionality of prefix-independent objectives is preserved by finite lexicographic products. We propose two different notions of infinite lexicographic products indexed by arbitrary ordinals, and extend Ohlmann's result by proving that they also preserve positionality. In the context of one-player positionality, this extends positional determinacy results of [Grädel and Walukiewicz, Logical Methods in Computer Science 2006] to edge-labelled games and arbitrarily many priorities for both Max-Parity and Min-Parity. Moreover, we show that the Max-Parity objectives over countable ordinals are complete for the infinite levels of the difference hierarchy over $Σ^0_2$ and that Min-Parity is complete for the class $Σ^0_3$. We obtain therefore positional languages that are complete for all those levels, as well as new insights about closure under unions and neutral letters.

title: An Introduction to Zero-Order Optimization Techniques for Robotics
summary: Zero-order optimization techniques are becoming increasingly popular in robotics due to their ability to handle non-differentiable functions and escape local minima. These advantages make them particularly useful for trajectory optimization and policy optimization. In this work, we propose a mathematical tutorial on random search. It offers a simple and unifying perspective for understanding a wide range of algorithms commonly used in robotics. Leveraging this viewpoint, we classify many trajectory optimization methods under a common framework and derive novel competitive RL algorithms.

title: Tourist arrival forecasting with game-theoretic social influence weighting and deep learning
summary: In the era of Industry 5.0, data-driven decision-making has become indispensable for planning in service systems such as tourism. This paper proposes a non-linear hybrid approach for forecasting tourist arrivals to Hong Kong from five major source markets before COVID-19 and to Sanya, China, through the COVID-19 shock. The method integrates multiple sources of Internet big data and employs a cooperative game-theoretic algorithm to identify coalitions of opinion leaders on social media, whose content then receives larger weights. The Empirical Wavelet Transform (EWT), applied causally, manages nonstationary attributes, and a Stacked Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Stacked BiLSTM) network tuned by Bayesian optimization generates the forecasts. We prove that the Shapley values of the underlying trust-weighted coverage game have a closed form and that the coalition of maximal synergy can be found exactly in polynomial time. Relative to the same network fed only with past arrivals, Internet big data reduce the one-step-ahead root mean squared error by 4.1-41.7% across the Hong Kong markets and opinion-leader weighting by a further 10.1-49.4%, against 5.3% and 8.7% for Sanya. The approach compares favorably with published benchmarks and remains robust under volatile conditions, which suggests uses in logistics, supply chains and production planning.

title: Stabilizing the Modality Gap: Null-Space Projected Continual Learning for Vision-Language Models
summary: The modality gap is intrinsic to multimodal alignment, where embeddings from different modalities remain partially separated in a shared representation space. In continual learning, CLIP-based vision-language models (VLMs) not only suffer catastrophic forgetting but also experience modality gap drift that disrupts the shared embedding geometry. Such drift degrades cross-modal alignment and generalization. We propose FPCD, an efficient framework combining Fast Null-space Projection (FNP) and Contrastive Distillation (CD). FNP accumulates compact Gram matrices of previous tasks' activations and projects gradients onto layer-adaptive approximate null spaces to reduce interference with learned representations. By replacing singular value decomposition with symmetric eigendecomposition, FNP accelerates projection-basis construction by a factor of 5-9. CD uses a small reference set to align the bidirectional image-to-text and text-to-image similarity distributions of the fine-tuned model with CLIP, thereby preserving pretrained cross-modal relations. On the 11-task MTIL benchmark, FPCD achieves 87.6% Last, 76.4% Average, and 65.2% Transfer. It also maintains more stable modality gaps and stronger zero-shot retrieval performance on COCO Captions and Flickr30k than competing methods. These results highlight the importance of controlling modality gap drift during continual adaptation of VLMs.

title: Ternary Binomial and Trinomial Bent Functions in the Completed Maiorana-McFarland Class
summary: Two classes of ternary (vectorial) bent functions of degree four with two and three terms in the univariate representation that belong to the completed Maiorana-McFarland original class are found. Binomials are mappings $\F_{3^{4k}}\mapsto\fthreek$ given by $\Tr^{4k}_k\big(a_1 x^{2(3^k+1)}+a_2 x^{(3^k+1)^2}\big)$, where $a_1$ is a nonsquare in $\F_{3^{4k}}$ and $a_2$ is defined explicitly by $a_1$. Particular subclass of such binomial vectorial bent function is represented by the exceptional polynomials over $\fthreek$. Bent trinomials are mappings $\F_{3^{2k}}\mapsto\fthree$ given by $\Tr_{2k}\big(a_1 x^{2(3^k+2)} + a_2 x^{3^k+5} + a_3 x^2\big)$ with $k>1$ not divisible by four and coefficients explicitly defined depending on the parity of $k$. The proof is based on new criterion that allows checking bentness by analyzing the first-order derivatives of $f$ in the direction of a chosen $n/2$-dimensional subspace ($n$ is the degree of the domain of $f$ over $\fp$).

title: Adaptive Duration Model for Text Speech Alignment

summary: Speech-to-text alignment is a critical component of neural text to speech (TTS) models. Autoregressive TTS models typically use an attention mechanism to learn these alignments on-line, while non-autoregressive end to end TTS models rely on durations extracted from external sources. In this paper, we propose a novel duration prediction framework that can give promising phoneme-level duration distribution with given text. In our experiments, the proposed duration model has more precise prediction and adaptation ability to conditions, compared to previous baseline models. Specifically, it makes a considerable improvement on phoneme-level alignment accuracy and makes the performance of zero-shot TTS models more robust to the mismatch between prompt audio and input audio.

title: AI Scientists for Building Virtual-Cell Models
summary: Autonomous agents, from virtual laboratories to biological data-analysis agents and co-scientists, have begun to turn scientific goals into hypotheses. Whether they can go further and convert real, noisy and complex biological data into executable model hypotheses and architectures that encode testable assumptions remains unclear. Predicting how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations is a natural test of this ability: it is central to decoding disease mechanisms and therapeutic discovery, yet it demands cross-disciplinary expertise rarely concentrated in a single research group. Here, we introduce CellForge, an organized team of autonomous agents for single-cell perturbation modeling. Given a dataset and a task, it surveys the literature, parses the data, identifies relevant baselines, and formulates a model hypothesis through critic-mediated discussion among agents specialized in data modeling, single-cell biology, and deep learning. It then writes the training code, runs the experiments, and returns a trained predictor including architecture, code, and validation results. The architecture itself is the hypothesis: CellForge produces it end-to-end, with no human specifying the design, loss, or training protocol. Across six perturbation datasets spanning transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic contexts, CellForge yields models that are competitive with hand-crafted state-of-the-art results on established tasks and extends the same workflow to paired multi-omic readouts. Blinded human evaluators rate CellForge's research plans as more scientifically sound and innovative than those from single LLMs or deep-research systems. In summary, we show autonomous agents can complete the full hypothesis-to-validation cycle in single-cell biology, with an AI effectively building another AI, in a complex setting that currently requires a team of human experts.

title: UniFGVC: Universal Training-Free Few-Shot Fine-Grained Vision Classification via Attribute-Aware Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Few-shot fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) aims to discriminate between subtly different categories with very limited data. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) exhibit strong capabilities in both fine-grained visual understanding and open-world category recognition, directly fine-tuning them on few-shot FGVC tasks typically leads to overfitting on sparse samples, which erodes their valuable open-world knowledge and compromises generalization. To fundamentally overcome this limitation, we present UniFGVC, a universal training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from parameter fine-tuning to training-free retrieval-based inference. UniFGVC reframes few-shot FGVC as a multimodal retrieval problem using predefined category templates. Its core is the Category-Discriminative Visual Captioner (CDV-Captioner), an attribute-aware module designed to leverage MLLM for generating structured textual descriptions that explicitly pinpoint discriminative visual attributes between similar classes. By integrating chain-of-thought reasoning and visual references, CDV-Captioner mitigates hallucination and maximizes the discriminative power of textual captions, thereby converting images into attribute-enriched image-description pairs. Subsequently, utilizing arbitrary pre-trained visual and textual encoders in a plug-and-play manner, UniFGVC extracts features from both modalities and computes their similarity with all category templates for recognition. Extensive experiments on 12 FGVC datasets demonstrate UniFGVC's universal compatibility and consistent superiority. It not only outperforms existing few-shot CLIP-based methods but also surpasses several fully-supervised MLLM-based approaches, confirming the general advantage of the proposed retrieval paradigm.

title: Computational Models for Magnetic Drug Targeting, Part 1: Derivation and Numerical Simulation of a Thermodynamically Consistent Magneto Two-phase Flow Model
summary: Motivated by Magnetic Drug Targeting (MDT), we derive a thermodynamically consistent two-phase model for the coupled dynamics of superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (SPIONs), a carrier fluid, and the magnetic field. The model includes a convection-diffusion equation for the SPION dispersion volume density and a modified Navier-Stokes system for the mixture velocity with SPION-dependent density and viscosity, an additional momentum flux due to relative SPION motion, and a magnetic body force. Additionally, the SPIONs interact with a quasi-static Maxwell system through their magnetization which is of Langevin type. The coupled system satisfies a global energy-dissipation balance. Moreover, we develop a semi-implicit finite element scheme with explicit flux-corrected transport stabilization and simulate the attraction of an initially localized SPION dispersion towards an external magnet in a system closed to mass exchange, using parameter values representative of MDT settings. The resulting SPION redistribution and induced flow are analyzed through physical observables, including energy and dissipation contributions and iron mass within a target region. Temporal convergence studies assess the ability of the numerical scheme to reproduce the energy-dissipation balance. Finally, we study the influence of individual coupling mechanisms on particle accumulation, maximum iron density, and peak flow velocity.

title: Multimodal Remote Inference
comments: Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Networking; a preliminary version appeared in the Proceedings of the 22nd IEEE International Conference on Mobile Ad-Hoc and Smart Systems (MASS 2025)
summary: We consider a remote inference system with multiple modalities, where a multimodal machine learning (ML) model performs real-time inference using features collected from remote sensors. When sensor observations evolve dynamically over time, fresh features are critical for inference tasks. However, timely delivery of features from all modalities is often infeasible under limited network resources. To address this challenge, we formulate a multimodal scheduling problem to minimize the ML model's inference error. We model this error as a general function of the Age of Information (AoI) vector, where AoI quantifies data freshness. We cast the problem as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) and derive an equivalent reformulation with a reduced state set. We then show that the problem has fundamentally different chain structures in the two-modality and multi-modality cases. For the two-modality case, we prove that the optimal policy has an index-based threshold structure. For the general multi-modality case (two or more modalities), we develop an optimal switching-type policy (OPT-ST), which is computed using a multichain policy iteration algorithm (MPI). To further reduce complexity, we also develop two low-complexity policies: the round-robin-like switching-type policy (RR-ST) and the round-robin-like threshold policy (RR-Thres). Numerical results show that OPT-ST achieves the lowest inference error among all baselines, with reductions of up to 80.3%. In a five-modality case, RR-ST and RR-Thres achieve $5.2\times$ and $89.8\times$ speedups in offline computation over OPT-ST, respectively, at the cost of increasing the inference error by 23.3% and 38.6%, respectively.

title: Enhancing Knowledge Density via Hierarchical Context Pruning for Retrieval-Augmented Repository-Level Code Completion
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has advanced repository-level code completion by retrieving external code snippets, API documentation, or type definitions to expand the model's contextual awareness. However, under the finite token budget of the context window, existing retrieval-augmented methods often saturate the budget with highly similar or even redundant code, which not only wastes tokens but also suppresses critical cross-file dependencies, preventing synergistic interaction between semantically similar reference snippets and cross-file dependency definitions. Therefore, further gains are limited by low knowledge density in the retrieved context rather than by model capacity. We propose SaraCoder, a retrieval-augmented framework that enhances knowledge density via hierarchical context pruning under a fixed context budget. A Hierarchical Feature Optimization module prunes an over-complete candidate pool in four stages. The freed tokens are then allocated to an External-Aware Identifier Disambiguator, which selectively injects only the most necessary cross-file dependency definitions. SaraCoder transforms context construction into a budget-aware optimization problem, balancing reference snippets and cross-file dependencies to build a context that is both knowledge-dense and semantically complete. Experiments on CrossCodeEval and RepoEval-Updated, across multiple backbone code LLMs, show that SaraCoder consistently outperforms strong RAG baselines such as GraphCoder and Repocoder in both code-level and identifier-level metrics, without increasing token usage, and yields synergistic gains when combined with other cross-file methods.

title: Quality control in sublinear time: a case study via random graphs
summary:
Many algorithms are designed to work well on average over inputs. But when such an algorithm is run on an arbitrary input, the question arises: Can we trust the algorithm on this input? This question is especially relevant in network science, where algorithms for theoretical random graph models are often applied to individual real-world networks.
  We identify a new class of algorithmic problems addressing this, which we call "Quality Control Problems." These problems are specified by a "quality function" $ρ$ and a distribution $D$ such that, with high probability, a sample drawn from $D$ is "high quality," meaning its $ρ$-value is near $1$. The goal is to accept most inputs $x \sim D$ and reject potentially adversarially generated inputs $x$ with $ρ(x)$ far from $1$.
  In this work, we consider the sublinear version of the quality control problem, where $D \in Δ(\{0,1\}^N)$ and the goal is to solve the $(D,ρ)$-quality problem with $o(N)$ queries and time. As a case study, we consider random graphs, i.e., $D = G_{n,p}$ (and $N = \binom{n}2$), and the $k$-clique count function $ρ_k := C_k(G)/\mathbb{E}_{G' \sim G_{n,p}}[C_k(G')]$, where $C_k(G)$ is the number of $k$-cliques in $G$. In suitable parameter ranges, worst-case approximate $k$-clique counting requires $p^{-Ω(k^2)}$ queries. In contrast, we show that the quality control problem for $G_{n,p}$ (with $n\geq p^{-ck}$ for some constant $c$) with respect to $ρ_k$ can be tested with $p^{-O(k)}$ queries and time, showing quality control is provably superpolynomially more efficient in this setting. More generally, for a motif $H$ of maximum degree $Δ(H)$, we show that the corresponding quality control problem can be solved with $p^{-O(Δ(H))}$ queries and running time.

title: Drive As You Like: Multi-Head Diffusion with Reinforcement Learning for Personalized Driving
summary: Personalized autonomous driving requires understanding the driving needs implicit in user requests. This is challenging when driving demonstrations lack style annotations and behavioral adaptation risks degrading planning quality. We propose M-Diffusion Planner with a dual-decoupling design: separating intent understanding from trajectory planning, and general planning capability learning from strategy alignment. A large language model infers driving needs and selects a strategy, which is executed by the corresponding head of a shared diffusion planner. Following imitation pretraining, strategy-specific rewards specialize individual heads without style annotations. We innovatively adapt Group Relative Policy Optimization using surrogate policy-ratio estimation and constrained head-specific updates to mitigate degradation of pretrained planning capabilities. Open-loop and closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan demonstrate distinct strategy-aligned behaviors and competitive planning performance. Further experiments assess intent-to-strategy mapping and collision risk, and analyze the effects of reward design and optimization on strategy alignment and planning quality.

title: How Do LLM-Generated Texts Impact Term-Based Retrieval Models?
summary: As more content generated by large language models (LLMs) floods into the Internet, information retrieval (IR) systems now face the challenge of distinguishing and handling a blend of human-authored and machine-generated texts. Recent studies suggest that neural retrievers may exhibit a preferential inclination toward LLM-generated content, while classic term-based retrievers like BM25 tend to favor human-written documents. This paper investigates the influence of LLM-generated content on term-based retrieval models, which are valued for their efficiency and robust generalization across domains. Our linguistic analysis reveals that LLM-generated texts exhibit smoother high-frequency and steeper low-frequency Zipf slopes, higher term specificity, and greater document-level diversity. These traits are aligned with LLMs being trained to optimize reader experience through diverse and precise expressions. Our study further explores whether term-based retrieval models demonstrate source bias, concluding that these models prioritize documents whose term distributions closely correspond to those of the queries, rather than displaying an inherent source bias. This work provides a foundation for understanding and addressing potential biases in term-based IR systems managing mixed-source content.

title: ZeST: A VLM-based Zero-Shot Traversability Navigation for Unknown Environments
summary: Advances in robotics and autonomous navigation systems hinge on the ability to predict terrain traversability accurately. Traditional methods for generating datasets to train these prediction models often involve putting robots into potentially hazardous environments, posing risks to equipment and safety. To solve this problem, we present ZeST, a novel approach that treats repeated VLM outputs as stochastic measurements and fuses them into an uncertainty-aware posterior. Our approach not only performs zero-shot traversability and mitigates the risks associated with real-world data collection but also accelerates the development of advanced navigation systems, offering a cost-effective and scalable solution. To support our findings, we present navigation results, in both controlled indoor and unstructured outdoor environments. As shown in the experiments, ZeST provides safer navigation with a 90-100% success rate while no baseline exceeds 60%, and keeps complete success under query latencies up to 3.6s.

title: Adaptive Dead-Zone Dual Sliding Mode Observer for Reliable Electrochemical Model-Based SOC Estimation
summary: Accurate state-of-charge (SOC) estimation is essential for safe and efficient lithium-ion battery operation. Electrochemical models provide physically grounded SOC estimates, but nonlinear voltage dynamics and coupled state-parameter errors can destabilize online adaptation. This paper proposes an adaptive dead-zone dual sliding-mode observer (ADZ-DSMO) based on an improved extended single-particle (IESP) model. A state SMO estimates SOC-related states, while a parameter SMO updates dominant model parameters. An online-computable, Lyapunov-guided adaptive boundary selectively gates parameter updates while the state observer remains active at every sampling step. Validation on a Panasonic NCR18650PF cell under 1C and 3C constant-current discharge and the Urban Dynamometer Driving Schedule (UDDS) and New European Driving Cycle (NEDC) profiles shows lower SOC estimation errors than conventional dual SMO and the IESP-based dual extended Kalman filter (DEKF). Compared with DEKF, the proposed observer provides faster recovery from a 30% initial SOC bias. Selective parameter updating reduces the average per-step computation time compared with the always-updating dual SMO. Temperature tests and capacity-based, model-generated aging cases further assess robustness. These results support adaptive gating as a means of reducing error propagation and computational overhead in electrochemical-model-based joint state-parameter estimation.

title: Direction-Shift Keying for High-Mobility mmWave Communications: Geometry-Based Resilience to Short Channel Coherence Times and Phase Noise
summary: Communication reliability in high-mobility millimeter-wave (mmWave) systems is fundamentally challenged by rapid channel variations, manifested in short channel coherence times, and phase noise, which necessitate frequent channel estimation and phase tracking. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Direction-Shift Keying (DSK), a geometry-based modulation scheme that exploits the relative stability of propagation directions rather than the rapidly varying amplitude and phase of the wireless channel. DSK conveys information through distinguishable directions of arrival (DoAs), enabled by a distributed antenna system (DAS), thereby shifting the communication principle from channel-dependent to geometry-dependent signaling. We first derive the structure of the optimal DSK detector for a mobile device equipped with an arbitrary number of antennas. We then establish the fundamental law governing the temporal stability of propagation directions, termed Direction Coherence Time (DCT), and show that DCT scales as $d/v$, where $d$ is the transmitter--receiver distance and $v$ is the relative velocity. In contrast, conventional Channel Coherence Time (CCT) scales as $λ/v$, where $λ$ denotes the wavelength, revealing a coherence-time advantage on the order of $d/λ$, potentially exceeding four orders of magnitude in mmWave systems. Furthermore, we establish the inherent invariance of DSK to common phase rotations, providing resilience to common oscillator phase noise without explicit phase tracking. Numerical results corroborate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the potential of geometry-based signaling for reliable high-mobility mmWave communications.

title: A Fully Analog Implementation of Model Predictive Control with Application to Buck Converters
summary: This paper proposes a novel approach to design analog electronic circuits that implement Model Predictive Control (MPC) policies for dynamical systems described by affine models. Effective approaches to define a reduced-complexity explicit MPC are combined and applied to realize an analog circuit comprising a limited set of low-latency, commercially available components. The practical feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed approach are demonstrated through its application in the design of a novel controller for DC-DC Buck converters. We formally analyze the stability of the resulting system and conduct extensive numerical simulations to demonstrate the control system's performance in rejecting line and load disturbances.

title: Asynchronous Indulgent Gathering of Opaque Robots
summary: We consider the benchmarking problem of gathering in an $(N,f)$-fault system consisting of $N$ robots, of which at most $f$ may fail at any execution. The {\em traditional} version asks $N-f$ non-faulty robots to gather at a point not known a priori. The recently studied {\em indulgent} version asks $N-f$ non-faulty robots to gather at the location of a faulty one. Indulgent gathering is impossible in a $(2,1)$-crash system in the $LUMI$ model under semi-synchrony, even when infinitely many colors and coordinate axis agreement are available. In this paper, we establish four results for indulgent gathering under asynchrony in $LUMI$, considering a {\em mobility fault} model in which a robot crash only impacts its mobility but not the operation of the light. We first show that indulgent gathering is impossible in a $(2,1)$-mobility system using 2-colored lights, and then give an optimal solution w.r.t. the number of colors using 3-colored lights. We then give two deterministic algorithms for an $(N,f)$-mobility system, $f<N$, $N,f$ unknown, that exhibit a nice time-color trade-off: One with time $O(N)$ using 7-colored lights and another with time $O(\max\{\ell,f\})$ using 26-colored lights, where $\ell< N$ is the number of distinct convex layers of robot positions in the initial configuration. Our algorithms for an $(N,f)$-mobility system are the first to be analysed time complexity, can withstand obstructed visibility (opaque robot model) and asynchronous scheduling. Interestingly, our algorithms also solve traditional gathering.

title: IDfRA: Self-Verification for Iterative Design in Robotic Assembly
summary: Design for Robotic Assembly (DfRA) remains largely dependent on manual planning and heuristic simulation, limiting scalability and robustness in complex industrial settings. Although large language models (LLMs) show promise for semantic reasoning and task planning, most approaches remain tightly coupled to pre-built simulators that assume an accurate world model. We introduce Iterative Design for Robotic Assembly (IDfRA), a closed-loop framework that combines an LLM for plan generation with a vision-language model (VLM) for execution assessment. Given a target structure and a partial environmental signature, the LLM proposes an assembly plan, the robot executes it once at test time, and the VLM evaluates the resulting state to provide feedback for replanning. Through this iterative planning-execution-verification loop, the system progressively improves semantic fidelity and physical feasibility. Crucially, IDfRA does not require an accurate a priori world model before deployment. Instead, physical constraints are discovered online through interaction, enabling adaptation to under-specified environments. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that IDfRA attains 73.3% top-1 accuracy in semantic recognisability, surpassing the baseline on this metric. Moreover, the resulting assembly plans exhibit robust physical feasibility, achieving an overall 86.9% construction success rate, with design quality improving across iterations, albeit not always monotonically. Pairwise human evaluation further corroborates the advantages of IDfRA relative to alternative approaches. By integrating self-verification with context-aware adaptation, the framework evidences strong potential for deployment in unstructured manufacturing scenarios.

title: Introspectively Envy-Free and Efficient Allocation of Indivisible Mixed Manna
summary:
The existence of allocations that are simultaneously fair and efficient is a central inquiry in fair division. Prominent results show that these complementary desiderata can be achieved together for indivisible items with nonnegative values. In particular, for indivisible goods and additive valuations, there always exists an allocation that is both envy-free up to one item (EF1) and fractionally Pareto efficient (fPO). An analogous EF1 and fPO guarantee is now known for indivisible chores. For indivisible mixed manna, the compatibility of fairness and efficiency is more delicate. Indeed, recent work shows that EF1 and fPO are incompatible in the additive mixed-manna setting. Through principled relaxations of EF1, we show that compatibility with fPO can be restored even for indivisible mixed manna under additive valuations.
  For indivisible mixed manna and additive valuations, we establish the existence of allocations that are fPO and introspectively envy-free up to one item (IEF1). In an IEF1 allocation, each agent can eliminate its envy toward every other agent by either adding an item to or removing an item from its own bundle. The notion of IEF1 coincides with EF1 for indivisible chores, and hence our result generalizes the existence guarantee for chores. We also prove the existence of allocations that are fPO and satisfy a chiral version of IEF1, which we call extrospectively envy-free up to one item (XEF1). This result generalizes the existence guarantee of EF1 and fPO allocations for goods, since XEF1 is equivalent to EF1 for goods. Finally, we utilize our IEF1 and fPO result for indivisible items to provide a distinct proof of the known EF and fPO guarantee for divisible mixed manna. Our results underscore the power of the Knaster--Kuratowski--Mazurkiewicz Theorem for proving the existence of fair and efficient allocations of indivisible and divisible items.

title: Chronoberg: A 250-Year Diachronic Corpus with Temporal Affective Lexicons for Language Model Analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at operating at scale by leveraging social media and data crawled from the web. Whereas existing corpora are diverse, their frequent lack of long-term temporal structure may however limit an LLM's ability to contextualize semantic and normative evolution of language and to capture diachronic variation. To support the latter, we introduce Chronoberg, a temporally structured corpus of English book texts spanning 250 years, curated from Project Gutenberg and enriched with a variety of temporal annotations. First, the edited nature of books enables us to quantify lexical semantic change through time-sensitive Valence-Arousal-Dominance analysis and to support historically-grounded interpretation. With the lexicons at hand, we demonstrate a need for modern LLM-based tools to better situate their contextualization of sentiment and detection of discriminatory language across various time-periods. In fact, we show how these tools struggle with diachronic shifts in meaning, emphasizing the need for temporally aware training and evaluation pipelines, and positioning Chronoberg as a scalable resource for respective studies. Disclaimer: This paper includes language and display of samples that could be offensive to readers. Open Access: Chronoberg is available publicly on HuggingFace at https://huggingface.co/datasets/spaul25/Chronoberg. Code is available at https://github.com/paulsubarna/Chronoberg.

title: TeraAgent: A Distributed Agent-Based Simulation Engine for Simulating Half a Trillion Agents
summary: Agent-based simulation is a method for studying highly complex systems in disciplines as diverse as biology, medicine, sociology, economics, finance, and more. In this method, an agent represents a small part of the system, such as a human cell, and, through interactions among many agents, the system's behavior emerges, like the growth of cancer in the human body. Real-world complex systems, such as a human organ, comprise billions of agents. However, the state-of-the-art agent-based simulation platform, BioDynaMo, does not support the distributed processing of a simulation across servers. This limitation restricts the scalability of agent counts to the computational resources available within a single server, hindering users from conducting larger and more meaningful simulations. In this paper, we introduce TeraAgent, a new distributed agent-based simulation engine. To overcome BioDynaMo's scalability limitation, TeraAgent enables efficient exchange of agent information across servers by implementing two solutions: 1) a tailored serialization mechanism that allows agents to be accessed and mutated directly at the receive buffer, and 2) delta encoding that significantly reduces data transfer across servers by leveraging the iterative nature of agent-based simulations. Built on our solutions, TeraAgent 1) enables extreme-scale simulations with half a trillion agents (292x that of BioDynaMo) on 84,096 CPU cores, 2) reduces time-to-result leveraging parallelism across compute nodes, 3) improves interoperability with third-party tools, and 4) provides users with more hardware flexibility. TeraAgent serializes agents with a median speedup of 110x (37x for deserialization) over the state-of-the-art ROOT I/O baseline, delivers 8x the agent update rate per CPU core of Biocellion, and improves in-situ visualization performance by 39x.

title: Uncovering Grounding IDs: How External Cues Shape Multi-Modal Binding
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) perform well on multimodal tasks, but their ability to reason and precisely align visual and textual information still has room for improvement. In this study, we show that external visual cues, such as symbols or grid lines, help LVLMs form more accurate connections between visual components, such as objects, and their corresponding textual descriptions, improving their grounding and reasoning abilities. We introduce the concept of Grounding IDs, which are latent identifiers that arise within the model as a result of external cues structuring both visual and textual modalities. Our analysis reveals that partition-inducing external cues lead to Grounding IDs that make better alignment between corresponding visual and text representations, helping the model focus on relevant information. We find that Grounding IDs enhance attention between related components, improving cross-modal grounding and reducing hallucinations. Overall, our results show that Grounding IDs are a key mechanism that enables external cues to improve cross-modal alignment, reduce errors, and enhance the overall performance of LVLMs across a range of multimodal tasks.

title: Thinking-Free Policy Initialization Makes Distilled Reasoning Models More Effective and Efficient Reasoners
comments: ICLR 2026 camera-ready version. 25 pages. Corrected author name
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) effectively solves complex tasks but demands extremely long context lengths during training, leading to substantial computational costs. While multi-stage training can partially mitigate this, starting with overly short contexts often causes irreversible performance degradation, ultimately failing to reduce overall training compute significantly. In this paper, we introduce Thinking-Free Policy Initialization (TFPI), a simple yet effective adaptation to RLVR that bridges long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation and standard RLVR. TFPI employs a simple ThinkingFree operation, explicitly discarding the thinking content via a direct </think> append, to reduce token usage during inference. Training with ThinkingFree-adapted inputs improves performance and lowers token consumption, even in the original slow-thinking mode. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks have shown that TFPI accelerates RL convergence, achieves a higher performance ceiling, and yields more token-efficient reasoning models without specialized rewards or complex training designs. With TFPI only, we train a 4B model to reach 89.0% accuracy on AIME24 and 65.5% on LiveCodeBench using less than 4K H20 hours.
