summary: Looped Transformers, which repeatedly apply a shared transformer block, are an architecturally natural fit for variable-length algorithmic tasks. Although they can exhibit strong length generalization beyond the length of training sequences, this behavior is brittle, yielding high out-of-distribution (OOD) variance, even across well-performing in-distribution solutions. We trace this variance to the spurious correlation in simple algorithmic tasks between sequence length and number of loops. Introducing stochasticity into the number of loops during training sharply reduces OOD variance and stabilizes predictions across inference-time loop counts. To improve upon heuristic randomization schemes, we further analyze RL-Halting as a learned stochastic schedule and find that it generally improves the accuracy-stability trade-off. Across binary addition, Dyck-1, Unique Set, and Copy, learned stochastic stopping often improves this trade-off but can also stabilize a suboptimal computation. Our work suggests that "when to stop" should be treated as a training-time design choice, not merely an inference-time computation-allocation rule.

title: Words Speak Louder Than Code: Investigating Cognitive Heuristics in LLM-Based Code Vulnerability Detection
comments: Accepted at IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE S&P) 2027
summary: Researchers and practitioners increasingly apply Large Language Models (LLMs) for automated vulnerability detection. Recent work has shown that LLMs are susceptible to the same cognitive heuristics that bias human judgment. Yet, no work has investigated whether these heuristics affect a model's assessment of code vulnerabilities. In this paper, we present the first systematic exploration of cognitive heuristics in LLM-driven code vulnerability detection. We introduce a controlled framework that holds the code fixed and only varies the surrounding context to trigger three cognitive heuristics: the halo effect through author attribution, the framing effect through task objectives and consequences, and the anchoring effect through prior analysis results. Within this framework, we evaluate eight LLMs across three programming languages. Our results demonstrate that all evaluated models are susceptible to these heuristics. Cross-model average susceptibility is highest for framing at 33.2%, followed by anchoring at 23.5% and halo at 18.4%. Vulnerabilities that require semantic reasoning for detection are more susceptible to cognitive heuristics than those identifiable through pattern matching. Furthermore, models often change their verdict from safe to vulnerable based on the cognitive condition, without accurately identifying the actual vulnerability. To highlight the practical impact, we demonstrate a proof-of-concept black-box cognitive attack that can suppress up to 97\% of previously detected vulnerabilities. Together, these findings show that cognitive bias is a consistent and exploitable property of LLM-based vulnerability detection.
comment: Accepted at IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (IEEE S&P) 2027

title: MemSyco-Bench: Benchmarking Sycophancy in Agent Memory
summary: Memory has emerged as a cornerstone of modern LLM-based agents, supporting their evolution from single-turn assistants to long-term collaborators. However, memory is not always beneficial: retrieved memories often induce a critical issue of sycophancy, causing agents to over-align with the user at the cost of factual accuracy or objective reasoning. Despite this emerging risk, existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate whether memories are correctly stored, retrieved, or updated, while overlooking how retrieved memories influence downstream reasoning and decision-making. To bridge this gap, we propose MemSyco-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating memory-induced sycophancy in agent systems. MemSyco-Bench measures when memory should influence a decision and how valid memory should be used. Specifically, it covers five tasks that assess whether agents can reject memory as factual evidence, respect its applicable scope, resolve conflicts between memory and objective evidence, track memory updates, and use valid memory for personalization. All related resources are collected for the community at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/MemSyco-Bench.

title: UniWind: Day-Ahead Wind Power Forecasting via Physics-Informed State Routing
summary: Accurate day-ahead wind power forecasting is essential for cost-effective power-system operation. Wind power generation is primarily driven by future meteorological conditions while retaining temporal dependencies in power generation. In practice, observed wind-farm power reflects both meteorology-driven generation potential and deviations associated with local environmental and operational factors. Existing physical models provide useful constraints but adapt poorly across wind farms, whereas data-driven models can capture rich correlations but do not explicitly structure these two sources of variation. To bridge this gap, we propose UniWind, a wind power forecasting framework that integrates physics-informed generation priors with data-driven state-aware corrections. UniWind first employs a Physical Prior Estimator to construct a site-calibrated physical prior by combining a site-conditioned monotone warp with a shared physical power curve. It further applies a physical upper-bound constraint to shape this prior as a soft envelope of available wind power generation. UniWind then uses a Latent State Encoder to construct latent power-state representations from historical prior-power discrepancies and future meteorological context, and transforms the physical prior into final power forecasts through a State-aware Power Corrector with pseudo-label-guided routing and bounded expert correction. Experiments on 24 real-world datasets demonstrate UniWind's strong forecasting accuracy, robustness, and generalization across full-shot, cross-farm zero-shot, and cross-region zero-shot settings.

title: Measuring Harness-Induced Belief Divergence in Multi-Step LLM Agents
summary: Software agents are becoming increasingly important in modern coding workflows, where they solve complex tasks through multi-step interaction with code repositories. A central component of these systems is the execution harness, which governs how the underlying LLM observes, acts on, and verifies its environment. We show that the harness can in turn shape the agent's evolving beliefs about the environment, even when the task, environment, and base LLM remain fixed. To reveal this effect, we introduce a belief-rollout diagnostic that traces how an agent's anticipated world state and future decisions evolve under alternative harnesses. We further separate immediate divergence introduced by the interface from divergence that develops over longer horizons. Across controlled coding tasks include HIBench-Code, SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench, we find substantial cross-harness belief divergence that is often invisible from terminal success alone and can propagate into different downstream actions. Building on this observation, we introduce Belief-Invariant World-Modeling (BIWM), which exposes evidence hidden or compressed by harness execution and aligns the resulting belief trajectories across different harnesses. Our findings reveal that harness design can systematically shape how software agents understand and act on their environments, providing practical guidance for building and evaluating more reliable coding agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hik289/Harness-induce-bias.git.

title: ManifoldFlow: Spectrum-Learnable Stiefel Optimization via SPD Relaxation
summary: Orthogonal and Stiefel constraints are widely used in neural network optimization to control weight geometry, improve conditioning, and stabilize signal propagation. Yet standard Stiefel optimization imposes a hidden restriction: while learning the directions of a linear map, it fixes every singular value to one, preventing the model from learning how strongly different directions should be amplified or suppressed. We introduce ManifoldFlow, a spectrum-learnable extension of Stiefel optimization that separates directional geometry from spectral scaling through $W=QS^{1/2}$, where $Q^\top Q=I$ and $S\succ0$. Beyond simply making the spectrum trainable, ManifoldFlow uses the gradient component rejected by the Stiefel constraint as a signal for how the spectrum should change, accumulates this signal across aligned tangent spaces, and jointly updates the orthonormal basis and a bounded SPD spectrum. This construction preserves exact spectral interpretability because $W^\top W=S$, while recovering standard Stiefel optimization when $S=I$. We establish the geometry of the rejected gradient, characterize optimization over the resulting Stiefel--SPD product space, and derive how the learned spectrum affects conditioning, signal propagation, and spectral complexity. Across diverse tasks, ManifoldFlow consistently outperforms matched fixed-spectrum Stiefel baselines, with particularly strong gains in recurrent language modeling. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hik289/manifold_flow.git.

title: LCPNet: Latent Consistent Proximal Unfolding Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) aims to identify long distance small targets from complex infrared backgrounds, and is a fundamental task in remote sensing. Deep learning methods have improved IRSTD by learning discriminative image-to-mask mappings, but such feed-forward designs often underuse physical decomposition structure between targets and backgrounds. Deep unfolding methods partially address this issue by embedding model-driven iterations into neural networks, yet existing designs still operate mainly in image domain and use updates and memory mechanisms that are not fully coupled with underlying optimization process. To address these limitations, we propose Latent Consistent Proximal unfolding network (LCPNet). First, we verify that low-rank prior remains valid in latent representations and perform unfolding in this space, preserving physical constraint while avoiding repeated compression of intermediate states. Second, we derive a Latent Consistent Proximal (LCP) solver that evolves each latent variable from its previous state rather than reconstructing through an indirect residual, and stabilizes small target updates through task-adaptive normalization and gain control. Third, we introduce Shared Optimization Memory (SOM), a common historical state shared by all decomposition variables to provide coordinated guidance across unfolding stages. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate that LCPNet achieves accurate and robust detection with low false-alarm rates, together with competitive efficiency among high-accuracy deep unfolding methods. Model and code are available at Model and code are available at https://github.com/Tianfang-Zhang/LCPNet.

title: HarnessMDP: Learning to Control LLM Agent Harnesses with Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: The execution harness is a critical component of LLM agents, shaping how the agent interacts with its environment and organizes multi-step execution. Prior work has shown that improving tools, workflows, and other harness components can substantially improve agent performance. This suggests that the harness can be treated as a learnable control layer that adapts execution decisions from experience, rather than as a predetermined execution configuration. In this work, we introduce HarnessMDP, a learning-based framework that makes harness control itself learnable. HarnessMDP formulates agent execution as a finite-horizon Markov decision process, where the harness learns to select structural execution actions from the evolving agent state. The harness policy is learned offline from collected trajectories using task performance and deployed online to adaptively control new executions. Extensive experiments on coding tasks, $τ$-bench, AgentBench, and other agent evaluation settings show that HarnessMDP consistently improves execution behavior and final task performance over baseline harnesses. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of HarnessMDP and establish learnable harness control as a practical mechanism for improving LLM agents through better execution. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hik289/Agentic-RL-harness.git.

title: FADRA: Frequency-Aware Diffusion with Residual Adaptation for Video Face Restoration
summary: Video face restoration (VFR) aims to recover high-quality and temporally consistent facial details from severely degraded video sequences; however, existing methods still struggle to balance spatial fidelity and temporal coherence under complex degradations. To address this, we propose FADRA, a frequency-aware diffusion framework with iterative residual adaptation specifically tailored for robust VFR. We first leverage the strong temporal consistency of a pre-trained text-to-video diffusion model and introduce lightweight LoRA adapters together with a Low-Quality (LQ) Pixel-Alignment Feature Fusion module to efficiently adapt the frozen generative prior to the VFR task. To further adapt the frozen diffusion backbone to the downstream VFR task beyond LoRA-based adaptation, we introduce a Repeated Residual Adaptation Head (RRAH) for step-wise residual refinement after the diffusion backbone. To make this refinement explicitly guided by the degraded observation, RRAH further takes the LQ latent together with the current velocity prediction as input, allowing the model to repeatedly revisit LQ cues and predict residual updates at each flow-matching step. This LQ-guided repeated residual adaptation helps recover fine facial details while preserving the inherent temporal priors of the pre-trained model. Furthermore, to ensure the structural integrity of perceptually important details, we introduce a Frequency-Aware Loss that provides explicit supervision across multiple spectral bands, emphasizing visually sensitive frequency components that are crucial for perceptual quality and prone to temporal jittering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FADRA recovers better facial structures and produces more temporally consistent videos than state-of-the-art methods, leading to clear gains in both quantitative metrics and visual perception. Our project page is available.

title: AirPASS: Over-the-Air Federated Learning via Pinching Antenna Systems
summary: This paper investigates over-the-air federated learning (AirFL) in wireless systems where the access point is equipped with a multi-waveguide pinching antenna system (PASS). We adopt the widely studied learning-oriented AirFL formulation, which seeks to maximize the number of selected devices while keeping the aggregation distortion below a prescribed threshold. The resulting joint optimization of device selection, receive beamforming, and pinching-antenna placement is highly nonconvex due to the intricate coupling among these system variables. To address this challenge, we develop AirPASS, an alternating optimization framework with two main components: a homotopy-Riemannian margin-consolidation method for device selection and receive beamforming under a fixed PASS configuration, and a homotopy-assisted geometry optimization method for updating the pinching-antenna positions under fixed selected devices and beamformer.

title: Right Answer, Wrong Tokens: Tail-Aware Credit Calibration for RLVR
summary: Although reinforcement learning (RL) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), GRPO-style methods can suffer from a positive-credit contamination failure mode. Specifically, uniform credit assignment can reinforce locally erroneous tail tokens alongside useful tokens within successful trajectories. To address this problem, we propose Tail-Aware Credit calibratiOn (TACO), which calibrates the positive credit assigned to such tokens without token-level error labels. To this end, TACO lets the policy serve as its own reference, assessing each sampled token's rarity relative to the policy's local expectations to compute a tail-risk score. Using this score as a proxy for potential local errors, TACO softly reduces positive credit for high tail-risk tokens while retaining nonzero weights, limiting their reinforcement without eliminating opportunities to learn useful rare patterns. Experiments across four LLMs and eight reasoning benchmarks show that TACO consistently improves over GRPO-style baselines. Notably, TACO also improves training stability, supporting sustained performance gains in long-horizon RL. The source code is available at: https://github.com/xiuyilou/TACO.

title: X-Alpha: An AI Quant Researcher with Memory-Driven Self-Evolution
summary: Human quantitative researchers mine alpha through an iterative process: they derive hypotheses from financial knowledge, implement and test them as factors, and use the resulting evidence to guide subsequent research. Yet automated alpha mining faces three key bottlenecks: noisy financial knowledge is not directly actionable, exploration can remain confined to similar mechanisms, and feedback may remain tied to individual mining runs. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce X-Alpha, an AI Quant Researcher that couples persistent research memory with continuous hypothesis-to-code discovery. Report-to-Memory Abstraction (RMA) uses a multi-layer filtering-and-abstraction process to convert financial reports into actionable, data-compatible research paths. Memory-driven routing uses accumulated experience to redirect exploration and define a targeted search space for each cycle. Within each cycle, hypotheses are implemented as executable factors and refined through empirical validation and code-based evolution. Empirical outcomes are consolidated into persistent research memory to guide subsequent exploration, enabling memory-driven self-evolution across cycles. We evaluate X-Alpha on five equity indices spanning mainland China, the United States, and Hong Kong, with comprehensive experiments centered on CSI300. Experiments show strong alpha discovery performance against baselines, with improvements in factor quality and signal diversity and consistent generation-level gains across multiple markets and prediction horizons.

title: Bidirectional Elaborators à la Carte
comments: Add further discussion of related work; other minor wording and typographical improvements
summary:
Surface syntax in proof assistants like Rocq, Lean, Agda, and Idris is highly implicit, lacking many details that are needed for user-written code to denote precisely defined mathematical objects. Elaboration is an algorithm that accounts for these details by translating surface syntax to an explicit enough core syntax. The reliability and predictability of elaboration relies on several critical properties of the core type system, including decidability of judgemental equality and the injectivity of type constructors; these dependencies are witnessed in a concrete system by explicit calls to conversion checking and weak-head reduction subroutines.
  We introduce a dependently typed monadic domain specific language for the executable specification of correct-by-construction elaboration algorithms that is abstracted from any particular representation of normal forms or algorithm for conversion checking. In particular, we represent a bidirectionally typed surface language for Martin-Löf type theory by shallow embedding in this DSL so that the translation of surface terms into core terms amounts to elementary equational calculation. This translation is correct by construction in the sense that it cannot produce ill-typed terms, and is automatically stable under judgemental equality of core terms and even under substitution; from the latter property, we obtain a new denotational interpretation of the suspension of elaboration problems. Finally, a concrete elaboration algorithm is extracted by algebraic means from a presheaf model of the DSL built out of the bi-initial natural model of Martin-Löf type theory.

title: BeatEdit: Symbolic Music Generation as Explicit Editing
summary: Music creation is fundamentally a process of revision. Yet symbolic music generation remains dominated by paradigms that produce complete sequences from scratch, with limited support for selective modification. Edit-based methods have proven effective for text transformation tasks, but remain largely unexplored for symbolic music. We trace this absence to the representational level: conventional event-based music encodings lack the structural properties required by explicit music editing. In contrast, the BEAT encoding, a beat-grid-anchored representation originally designed for autoregressive generation, possesses structural properties amenable to editing. We propose BeatEdit, the first framework for symbolic music generation based on explicit edit operations, recasting generation as producing new content by editing a draft rather than synthesizing from scratch. BeatEdit comprises three complementary mechanisms along an axis of increasing edit density: per-token sequence tagging for error correction, iterative refinement for accompaniment editing, and tag-then-fill for segment completion. All these mechanisms share a single encoding and pre-trained backbone, achieving higher precision and perceptual quality than autoregressive and diffusion methods across all three tasks, while remaining efficient, with single-pass inference completing in under 100 ms. Cross-encoding evaluation further reveals that encoding design substantially influences editing effectiveness, with notable encoding-method interaction effects. Code is available at https://github.com/Haoyu-Gu/BeatEdit-code

title: Amplitude-Only FFN Intervention for Tool-Structured LLM Inference: Method, Gated Evaluation Protocol, and Cross-Model Empirical Results
comments: 48 pages, 11 figures, 29 tables. Revised abstract, introduction, and methods; expanded figures; clarified intervention-site definitions, baseline variation, and RF results
summary: We study Amplitude Gating (AG), an inference-time intervention that masks feed-forward network (FFN) activation coordinates while keeping pretrained weights fixed. Six SwiGLU sites separate shared and gate-only inputs, expanded gate/value channels, and the FFN output. Magnitude-ranked entropy masks and a Newton-Schulz windowed ranking variant provide alternative forward paths without retraining. The corrected September collection covers three Qwen checkpoints and eight text/tool endpoints. Under frozen local text scorers, the displayed Qwen3.5-9B non-NS configurations improve two function-call endpoints by +2.61 and +2.67 percentage points (pp), and static ToolBench in/out-domain endpoints by +1.64 and +2.82 pp. Comparing the lower historical/September AG mean with the higher baseline mean leaves positive margins on these routes. This supports robustness to the two observed executions, rather than formal statistical significance. JSON gains are small and displayed L-Eval effects are negative. These endpoints measure lexical or answer/action-name agreement rather than executed-tool success. Protocol-specific offline selector and Per-Sample Fix-Harm Evaluation (PFHE) analyses complement the fixed-route results. Current experimental data do not establish a significant random-forest (RF) benefit; further experiments are needed. AG provides a task-dependent intervention surface, with causal mechanisms, equal-budget advantages, repeated-run uncertainty, and serving cost still open.

title: Discriminative Barrier Functions for Safe Adversarial Imitation Learning from Observation
summary: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) algorithms are powerful tools for learning from and generalizing expert demonstrations, but they often rely on unconstrained exploration, rendering them unsafe for real-world deployment. Meanwhile, Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) can guarantee the safety of control systems, but the analytical design of CBFs can be time-consuming and esoteric. In this work, we address these limitations jointly by constraining reward function candidacy during IRL to the space of CBFs, yielding a formulation that exhibits safe online control with continuous experiential improvement. Crucially, this framework enables the data-driven recovery of barrier functions directly from unlabeled expert observations. We demonstrate that the recovered barrier function is robust to unsafe states entirely absent from the expert data. Furthermore, we benchmark our method against standard IRL baselines in a simulated navigation environment, demonstrating improved safety performance. Finally, we investigate the trade-offs of planning-based versus policy-based IRL methods across both simulation and a real world obstacle avoidance task.

title: Volition Elicitation: Operational Semantics for People and Their Machines
summary:
The most prevalent distributed systems today include people and their personal machines (smartphones), and computations in them are driven by people's volitions. Volition-guarded multiagent atomic transactions were proposed as an abstract specification language for such systems, in which a transaction has a precondition on the machine states of its participants and is guarded by the volitions of some of them.
  Here we develop an abstraction cascade that derives smartphone apps from such specifications and prove it correct down to the base programming language, GLP. The cascade consists of: (1) communicating volitional agents (CVA), which implement every local volition-guarded specification with simple guards, correctly, and completely for its strongly fair runs, by two-phase commit coordinated by the initiating agent; (2) volition-guarded GLP (vGLP), an extension of GLP with volitional procedures, whose goals put an interactively-typed question to the person, into which that implementation compiles; and (3) GLP, which implements vGLP by eliciting the person's answers through the widgets of their interactive types, correctly, and completely for complete widgets. We demonstrate the approach on three grassroots platforms --- a social graph, a social network, and currencies: a compiler carries the social graph and the currencies down the cascade to GLP programs that run with scripted persons, and earlier programs of the three run as mini-apps of one smartphone app.

title: Mind the Delay: Latency-aware Query Routing for Heterogeneous LLM pools
summary: Large language model (LLM) query routers typically assign each query to a suitable model that balances response accuracy and monetary cost. Subsequently, separate system-level load balancers based on policies such as join-the-shortest-queue or round-robin distribute the queries across replicas of each model to reduce latency. However, decoupling accuracy-cost and latency considerations can lead to suboptimal routing decisions. We introduce the Batch Evolution Aware (BEA) estimator to provide a fine-grained estimate of the latency, that is, the time-to-first-token (TTFT) experienced by an arriving query. Unlike existing load balancers that rely on coarse signals such as queue lengths, per-model processing rates, or historical average latencies, BEA replays the serving framework's token-batch formation using a snapshot of an instance's current workload, stopping when the incoming query's first token is generated. Taking into account the compute and memory requirements of the prefill and decode phases of language queries as well as the contention between multiple queries that are served in the same batch, BEA predicts TTFT within an error of approximately 5%. Each prediction takes about 0.1 ms, which is fast enough to run on the critical routing path. We also design an analytical framework for a model instance under a limited processor-sharing scheme that calculates expected TTFT in closed form and captures the qualitative trend of latencies as the load increases. The TTFT estimates produced by BEA are then used in our latency-aware router, BEAR, which simultaneously balances accuracy, cost, and latency to select the best model instance from a heterogeneous pool of LLMs. Against seven baselines, BEAR improves the utility of responses delivered within their targets by 63% on average over existing latency-aware routers, and by 30.5% over the best baseline at each arrival rate.

title: Reasoning Error from Known Fact: Step-Level Self-Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization for LLMs
summary: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), modern systems not only possess strong foundational capabilities and extensive knowledge, but can also solve complex problems via long, multi-step reasoning. However, as reasoning traces become longer, LLMs may produce a substantial amount of hallucinated content during the reasoning process, which is often difficult to detect. In this work, we conduct a fine-grained analysis of hallucinations arising in LLM reasoning and find that the reasoning traces are particularly prone to Context-Sensitive Factual Hallucinations: cases where the model actually has the relevant knowledge, yet makes factual errors due to contextual interference during reasoning. To address this issue, we propose Step-level Self-Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization (SSC-GRPO), which assigns step-level rewards to reasoning traces by computing self-consistency scores of individual steps across multiple rollouts. Compared with prior methods, SSC-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both mathematical reasoning benchmarks and hallucination leaderboards. Our results offer a new perspective for detecting and mitigating hallucinations in the reasoning process of large language models.

title: Circuit Claims Depend on What Is Extracted and How It Is Compared
comments: 35 pages. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Extended version with appendices
summary: Circuit extraction identifies model components whose presence preserves a target behavior under ablation, but preserving behavior does not single out one circuit. We study this in a synthetic Lean tactic-prediction benchmark with fixed proof rules and randomized surface form. Across dense and weight-sparse checkpoints of the same transformer, evaluated on atomic and compositional proofs, we vary which extracted object is reported: a compact prediction-preserving circuit, a broader graph retaining surrounding read, write, and routing structure, or a subgraph extracted with a post-ablation loss budget. First, overlap between groups of component-to-component connections is low, sometimes close to a random baseline. Overlap is much higher for selected attention-head sets under deterministic selection, but falls sharply when selection among equally scored heads is randomized. Second, the normalized graph-size ranking of conditions that differ in which supervised checkpoint initializes reinforcement learning (RL) agrees between repeated extractions of the compact circuit and between joint and separate query/key representations of each of the other two graphs. For the loss-budgeted graph, query/key ordering agreement persists through the budget sweep. Finally, across those same conditions, the largest exact-match accuracy gains from RL on compositional proofs come with the largest proportion of components in the compositional circuit that lie outside the corresponding atomic circuits. Ablating these additional components in the sparse RL model reduces compositional accuracy while largely preserving accuracy on the corresponding atomic tasks. A circuit-level claim therefore requires specifying which circuit is reported and how it is extracted and compared; behavior alone does not determine its interpretation. We distill these requirements into a reporting practice for circuit-extraction studies.

title: Beyond Relevance-Centric Retrieval: Rubric-Oriented Document Set Selection and Ranking
summary: As large language models and AI agents become the primary consumers of search results, document set quality determines the upper bound of downstream generation. Yet existing evaluation systems remain confined to scoring documents independently and aggregating via nDCG, ignoring inter-document interactions (redundancy, conflict, complementarity) and unable to answer what makes one document set better than another. To address these issues, we propose a complete evaluate-diagnose-optimize framework. We design SetwiseEvalKit, a three-level, nine-dimension document set evaluation benchmark covering both short-form and long-form scenarios, comprising approximately 28K high-quality evaluation rubrics. We systematically evaluate 12 rerankers: even the best method achieves no more than 45% coverage, cross-document coordination dimensions are universally weak, and no single method maintains top performance across both settings. Building on this, we propose Rubric4Setwise, a training-free method that converts rubric-based evaluation criteria into document set selection signals, achieving the best downstream generation performance with fewer documents and search rounds. It is the only method that maintains state-of-the-art results across both scenarios, validating the effectiveness of closing the loop from evaluation to optimization.

title: Covering Planar Lattices with Interior-Disjoint Unit Disks
summary: We study an infinite variant of the coin-covering problem for periodic point sets in the plane. Given a point set of spacing $d$, we ask whether all of its points can be covered by pairwise non-overlapping unit disks. We consider the triangular lattice, the square lattice, and the honeycomb point set, and construct periodic motif patterns that certify several intervals of coverable spacings. For the triangular lattice, our constructions include single-family patterns with vertex, face, and off-lattice realizing centers, as well as multi-family patterns. For the honeycomb point set, additional native motifs fill gaps left by the triangular-lattice constructions. For the square lattice, we revisit the constructions of Alm et al., identify an unintended overlap in one motif realization, and give new patterns that recover part of the affected interval and establish an additional coverability interval.

title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
comments: 22 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://joliang17.github.io/VisualCSD/
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) removes the external teacher required by on-policy distillation (OPD), but still needs asymmetric information between teacher and student so that the self-teacher provides a stronger learning signal. Existing methods create this asymmetry through privileged answers or visual evidence. We ask whether both can be removed, yielding a simpler form of OPSD driven purely by input conditioning. We propose Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation, namely VCSD, which converts image-content removal into an on-policy self-distillation signal. At each student-generated response prefix, the EMA teacher produces two next-token distributions under the same prompt and prefix: one conditioned on the original image and the other on a content-erased control. Their token-wise log-probability difference highlights candidates whose likelihood is specifically increased by the instance-level visual content. We use this contrast to sharpen the teacher's original-image distribution within its plausible support, and distill the resulting full-distribution target into the student. On ViRL39K, VCSD consistently outperforms matched OPSD across Qwen3-VL and Qwen3.5 models. It improves the seven-benchmark aggregate from 72.51% to 76.26% on Qwen3-VL-8B and from 74.97% to 79.24% on Qwen3.5-9B, with gains at all six evaluated scales. VCSD requires no external teacher, privileged answers, visual evidence signals, reasoning traces, or additional inference-time cost.

title: Risk-Routed Implicit Boundary Refinement for Robust Ultrasound Image Segmentation
summary: Accurate boundary delineation in medical ultrasound (US) images remains challenging because of speckle noise, low contrast, acoustic shadowing, and acquisition variability. We propose Risk-routed Implicit Boundary Refinement (RIBR), a compact framework that refines convolutional segmentation through spatially weighted implicit residuals. A coordinate-conditioned implicit branch uses regional features to predict logit corrections, and a learned gate controls their contribution using predictive uncertainty and local appearance. Geometry- and speckle-aware regularization provides contour supervision and discourages probability fluctuations away from boundaries. We compare RIBR with ten baselines on nine datasets covering lymph nodes, breast lesions, thyroid nodules, and prostate, including four external lymph-node and breast cohorts. Across three seeds, RIBR achieves the best overall dataset macro-average among the evaluated configurations, with $76.67{\pm}0.42\%$ Dice and a 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of $29.55{\pm}0.55$ pixels on the resized evaluation grid. It obtains the lowest HD95 on all nine datasets, with task-dependent Dice rankings. These results support controlled implicit residual refinement for boundary-sensitive US segmentation. Source code is available at https://github.com/jinggqu/ribr.

title: Filling Before Advancing: Capability-Gap-Driven Post-Training for Scenario-Specialized Remote Sensing MLLMs
summary: Remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS-MLLMs) have advanced aerial-image understanding, but scenario specialization remains constrained by scarce high-quality supervision and incomplete capability coverage. We propose filling before advancing (FBA), a capability-gap-driven post-training route that develops prerequisite capabilities before scenario-specific adaptation. For coastal harbor understanding, we construct CPRS (Coastal-Port Remote Sensing), a three-layer dataset covering RGB, SAR, PAN, and NIR imagery. FBA organizes supervision into RS semantic anchoring, multi-source bridging, and evidence-grounded scenario tuning. We also introduce HarborEval, an eight-track benchmark assessing perception, spatial understanding, robustness, and generation. Using the same final-task supervision pool, FBA raises the HarborEval score from 57.95 to 70.29 on LLaVA-v1.5 and from 81.09 to 83.37 on Qwen3-VL compared with Direct-SFT. It also outperforms collapsed training and leads the evaluated comparisons on harbor-related VRSBench and RSVQA subsets and expert-scored OpenEval. Stage-wise and supervision-replacement analyses examine the contributions of the supervision roles. A lightweight urban instantiation further supports cross-scenario applicability, with the proposed stage order achieving stronger overall performance than the tested alternatives. Project resources and release updates are available at https://github.com/Z0ngL1ng/filling-before-advancing.

title: Optimal Polynomial Tractability Exponents for the Inverse Star Discrepancy
summary:
The inverse of the star discrepancy $n^\ast(d, \varepsilon)$ satisfies
  \[ d \varepsilon^{-1} \lesssim n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\lesssim d\varepsilon^{-2} \] for all $d \in \mathbb{N}$ and $0 < \varepsilon < \varepsilon_0$. The upper bound was established by Heinrich, Novak, Wasilkowski and Woźniakowski (2001), while the lower bound is due to Hinrichs (2004). Steinerberger (2023) subsequently gave an elementary proof of the latter result. These bounds imply that the inverse of the star discrepancy depends linearly on the dimension, but the exact exponent of $\varepsilon^{-1}$ had remained open.
  In this paper we prove a lower bound which shows that the exponent $2$ of $\varepsilon^{-1}$ in the upper bound cannot be improved. More precisely, for every $0<α<1$ and fixed $0<A\le B$, there exist constants $c_{α,B}>0$ and $\varepsilon_{α,A}>0$ such that, for every $0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_{α,A}$ and every integer $d$ satisfying \[
  A\varepsilon^{-α}\le d\le B\varepsilon^{-α}, \] one has \[
  n^\ast(d,\varepsilon)
  \ge c_{α,B}\,d\,\varepsilon^{-(2-α)}. \] Along these polynomial strips the right-hand side is of order $\varepsilon^{-2}$.
  Consequently, every uniform polynomial upper estimate $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\le C d^q\varepsilon^{-p}$ must satisfy $p\ge2$. Together with the lower bound of Hinrichs (2004), which forces $q\ge1$, this proves that the exponents $p=2$ and $q=1$ in the Heinrich--Novak--Wasilkowski--Woźniakowski upper bound are individually optimal. In particular, the optimal exponent $p^\ast = 2$.

AI.motivation: 逆星散度 $n^{\ast}(d, \varepsilon)$ 的上下界已被建立，但 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的精确指数仍未确定。
AI.method: 通过证明一个新的下界来确定 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的最优指数。
AI.result: 证明了对于 $A\varepsilon^{-\alpha} \le d \le B\varepsilon^{-\alpha}$ 范围内的 $d$，有 $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon) \ge c_{\alpha,B}\,d\,\varepsilon^{-(2-\alpha)}$。这表明任何均匀多项式上界 $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\le C d^q\varepsilon^{-p}$ 必须满足 $p\ge2$。结合 Hinrichs (2004) 的下界 $q\ge1$，证明了 Heinrich-Novak-Wasilkowski-Woźniakowski 上界中的指数 $p=2$ 和 $q=1$ 是单独最优的。
AI.conclusion: 逆星散度上界中 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的最优指数 $p^{\ast} = 2$，并且 $d$ 的最优指数 $q=1$。
AI.translation:
逆星散度 $n^{\ast}(d, \varepsilon)$ 满足 $d \varepsilon^{-1} \lesssim n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\lesssim d\varepsilon^{-2}$，适用于所有 $d \in \mathbb{N}$ 和 $0 < \varepsilon < \varepsilon_0$。上界由 Heinrich, Novak, Wasilkowski 和 Woźniakowski (2001) 确立，而下界则归因于 Hinrichs (2004)。Steinerberger (2023) 随后给出了后者的一个初等证明。这些界限意味着逆星散度线性依赖于维度，但 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的确切指数仍然是一个开放问题。

在本文中，我们证明了一个下界，表明上界中 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的指数 $2$ 不能被改进。更精确地说，对于每个 $0<\alpha<1$ 和固定的 $0<A\le B$，存在常数 $c_{\alpha,B}>0$ 和 $\varepsilon_{\alpha,A}>0$，使得对于每个 $0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_{\alpha,A}$ 和满足 $A\varepsilon^{-\alpha}\le d\le B\varepsilon^{-\alpha}$ 的每个整数 $d$，有 $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon) \ge c_{\alpha,B}\,d\,\varepsilon^{-(2-\alpha)}$。沿着这些多项式带，右侧的阶为 $\varepsilon^{-2}$。

因此，任何均匀多项式上界 $n^{\ast}(d,\varepsilon)\le C d^q\varepsilon^{-p}$ 必须满足 $p\ge2$。结合 Hinrichs (2004) 的下界（它强制 $q\ge1$），这证明了 Heinrich-Novak-Wasilkowski-Woźniakowski 上界中的指数 $p=2$ 和 $q=1$ 是单独最优的。特别是，最优指数 $p^{\ast} = 2$。
AI.summary: 本文研究了逆星散度 $n^{\ast}(d, \varepsilon)$ 的多项式可处理性指数。尽管已知其上下界，但 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的精确指数一直未决。通过引入一个新的下界，研究证明了现有上界中 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的指数 $2$ 是不可改进的。此外，结合先前的工作，本文最终证明了 Heinrich-Novak-Wasilkowski-Woźniakowski 上界中 $d$ 和 $\varepsilon^{-1}$ 的指数 $q=1$ 和 $p=2$ 是单独最优的，并确定了最优指数 $p^{\ast} = 2$。
AI.keywords: 逆星散度, 多项式可处理性, 最优指数, 下界, 星散度
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了逆星散度理论中一个重要的开放问题，精确确定了其多项式可处理性中的最优指数。通过引入一个精密的下界证明，它完善了对逆星散度行为的理解，对于数值积分和高维计算等领域具有重要意义。

title: Learning Traversability for Long Horizon Off-Road Navigation
summary: Autonomous navigation across large off-road environments remains a challenging problem. Onboard sensors perceive only the immediate surroundings, yet safe and efficient routes depend on terrain features that extend well beyond the sensor horizon. Geo-spatial data sources such as satellite imagery, aerial LiDAR, and vector maps can close this gap, but learning traversability from them is difficult: dense labels are unavailable at scale, and existing methods rely on short-range sensing. We propose an efficient formulation that learns a continuous traversability map from overhead data, supervised directly by human-driven GPS trajectories and shaped by supervised geometric priors from LiDAR. Alongside the model, we release a dataset, curated from public sources, consisting of 299 scenes spanning $\sim\!1{,}244\,\mathrm{km}^{2}$ of diverse terrain, paired with $1{,}130\,\mathrm{km}$ of human driving. In field trials on a Clearpath Warthog across seven routes at two sites,our method achieves trajectories within $5.5\%$ of human path length and reduces operator interventions by $\sim\!85\%$ compared to local-planner-only autonomy.

AI.title_translation: 长距离越野导航的可行性学习
AI.tldr: 提出一种利用鸟瞰数据和人类驾驶轨迹学习长距离越野导航可行性的方法，显著减少了自主导航的干预。
AI.motivation: 由于车载传感器感知范围有限，自主导航在长距离越野环境中面临挑战，而利用地理空间数据学习可行性缺乏大规模密集标签，现有方法也主要依赖短距离传感。
AI.method: 提出了一种高效的表述方法，利用鸟瞰数据学习连续的可行性地图，直接由人类驾驶的GPS轨迹监督，并结合来自LiDAR的有监督几何先验进行塑造。
AI.result: 在野外试验中，该方法实现了与人类路径长度相差5.5%以内的轨迹，并将操作员干预减少了约85%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了基于头顶传感数据的长距离越野导航可行性预测，极大地提升了自主导航系统的效率和安全性，减少了对操作员干预的依赖。
AI.translation: 在大型越野环境中进行自主导航仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。车载传感器只能感知直接的周围环境，然而安全高效的路线取决于延伸到传感器视距之外的地形特征。诸如卫星图像、机载LiDAR和矢量地图等地理空间数据源可以弥补这一差距，但从中学习可行性是困难的：大规模下无法获得密集的标签，且现有方法依赖于短距离传感。我们提出了一种高效的公式，从头顶数据中学习连续的可行性地图，直接由人类驾驶的GPS轨迹监督，并由来自LiDAR的有监督几何先验塑造。伴随着该模型，我们发布了一个从公共来源整理的数据集，包含299个场景，跨越约1244平方公里的多样化地形，并配有1130公里的驾驶轨迹。在搭载于Clearpath Warthog机器人在两个地点的七条路线上的野外试验中，我们的方法实现了路径长度在人类路径长度5.5%以内的轨迹，与仅使用本地规划器的自主性相比，减少了约85%的操作员干预。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种从高空数据学习连续越野导航可行性地图的方法，该方法结合了GPS人类驾驶轨迹监督与LiDAR几何先验，并发布了一个包含299个场景的大型数据集，在实际测试中显著降低了人工干预并提高了导航效率。
AI.keywords: 越野导航, 可行性学习, 鸟瞰图数据, 轨迹监督, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该论文通过将鸟瞰图数据、人类驾驶GPS轨迹以及LiDAR几何先验相结合，提出了一种创新的长距离越野导航可行性学习方法，显著减少了人工干预，在实际野外测试中表现优异。

title: On the Power Distance Representation of Bregman Divergences
summary: We express Bregman divergences between parameters as power distances between corresponding weighted points, and investigate several applications of this representation. First, we show that the Bregman closest pair and diameter problems can be reformulated as bichromatic weighted point problems under the power distance. This reformulation enables Bregman nearest and farthest neighbor queries under power distances to be handled in practice through corresponding Euclidean neighbor queries in one additional dimension, after offsetting the weights. Next, we revisit the problem of computing minimum enclosing Bregman balls (Bregman MEBs) and establish their equivalence to double-sided weight power MEBs. We further show that Bregman MEBs can be approximated by relaxing the double-sided weight power MEB problem to its single-sided weight counterpart. We then present two approaches to solving general power MEB problems: An exact algorithm based on the LP-type framework and an arbitrarily accurate approximation scheme based on iterative Frank-Wolfe optimization. Finally, we show that the potential-function lifting transformations used to construct Bregman Voronoi diagrams can be reinterpreted as classical paraboloid lifting transformations applied to the corresponding weighted point sets. This establishes a direct connection between Bregman Voronoi diagrams and power diagrams, further illustrating how Bregman divergences can be represented as power distances.

AI.title_translation: 布雷格曼散度幂距离表示
AI.tldr: 该论文将布雷格曼散度表示为幂距离，并将其应用于最近点对、直径、最小包围球和Voronoi图等问题，提出新的计算方法和近似算法。
AI.motivation: 探索布雷格曼散度与幂距离之间的联系，并利用这种联系来解决计算几何中的相关问题。
AI.method: 将布雷格曼散度表示为幂距离，并在此基础上进行问题转化和算法设计，包括LP-type框架和Frank-Wolfe优化。
AI.result: 实现了布雷格曼最近点对和直径问题的幂距离重构，提出了布雷格曼最小包围球与双边加权幂距离最小包围球的等价性，并给出了精确算法和近似算法，同时揭示了布雷格曼Voronoi图与幂图的联系。
AI.conclusion: 布雷格曼散度可以有效地表示为幂距离，这种表示方法为解决一系列计算几何问题提供了新的视角和有效的计算工具。
AI.translation: 我们发现，参数之间的布雷格曼散度可以表示为相应加权点之间的幂距离，并研究了这种表示法的若干应用。首先，我们证明了布雷格曼最近点对和直径问题可以在幂距离下重构为双色加权点问题。这种重构使得通过在偏移权重后，在额外一维中进行相应的欧几里得邻近查询，就可以实际处理布雷格曼最近和最远邻近查询。接下来，我们重新审视了计算最小包围布雷格曼球（Bregman MEBs）的问题，并建立了它们与双边加权幂距离MEBs的等价性。我们进一步证明，可以通过将双边加权幂距离MEB问题松弛为其单边加权对应问题来近似布雷格曼MEBs。然后，我们提出了两种解决一般幂距离MEB问题的方法：一种基于LP-type框架的精确算法，以及一种基于迭代Frank-Wolfe优化的任意精度近似方案。最后，我们发现用于构建布雷格曼Voronoi图的势函数提升变换可以被重新解释为应用于相应加权点集的经典抛物面提升变换。这建立了布雷格曼Voronoi图和幂图之间的直接联系，进一步说明了布雷格曼散度如何可以表示为幂距离。
AI.summary: 本研究将布雷格曼散度与幂距离联系起来，提出了一种新的表示方法。该方法被应用于解决计算几何中的多个问题，包括最近点对、直径、最小包围球和Voronoi图的构建。研究者提出了一种将布雷格曼问题转化为幂距离问题的重构方法，并设计了相应的精确算法和近似算法。最终，该研究揭示了布雷格曼散度和幂距离之间的深刻联系，为相关问题的计算提供了新的途径。
AI.keywords: 布雷格曼散度, 幂距离, 计算几何, 最小包围球, Voronoi图
AI.comments: 该研究将抽象的布雷格曼散度与直观的幂距离联系起来，为理解和解决一系列计算几何问题提供了一个统一的框架。研究提出的算法和近似方案具有实际应用价值。

title: WHTMix: Efficient Stereo Depth Estimation via Walsh-Hadamard Token Mixing
summary: Stereo depth estimation for driving, robotics and augmented reality must run at high resolution under tight latency budgets, yet in transformer-based matchers the global self-attention that aggregates scene context grows quadratically with the number of pixels and comes to dominate runtime. We show that the joint self-attention stage of a stereo transformer, whose role is to spread context across both views, can be replaced by a data-independent Walsh-Hadamard token mixer that mixes tokens globally in the transform domain at log-linear cost, while the data-dependent cross-attention that performs left-right correspondence is retained. On synthetic driving data the mixer matches the attention baseline in end-point error while reducing model compute by a factor of 2.46 and single-image inference latency by a factor of 2.65. A complexity analysis shows the benefit is governed by the ratio of sequence length to channel width, which explains why high-resolution stereo matching is a particularly favorable setting and why classification transformers are not; we confirm this token-to-channel scaling on non-stereo long-sequence benchmarks. Furthermore, we introduce a hybrid log-disparity loss function designed to up-weight small-disparity pixels corresponding to long-range objects. This approach reduces the error on distant objects without incurring any additional computational overhead.

AI.title_translation: WHTMix：通过Walsh-Hadamard令牌混合实现高效立体深度估计
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为WHTMix的方法，用Walsh-Hadamard变换取代了Transformer中计算成本高昂的自注意力机制，用于立体深度估计。这种方法在保持精度的同时，显著降低了计算量和推理延迟，尤其适用于高分辨率场景。此外，还引入了一种新的损失函数来改善对远距离物体的深度估计。
AI.motivation: Transformer在立体深度估计中用于聚合场景上下文的全局自注意力机制，其计算复杂度随像素数量呈二次方增长，导致在需要高分辨率和低延迟的应用（如驾驶、机器人和增强现实）中成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为WHTMix的方法，将Transformer中的联合自注意力阶段替换为数据无关的Walsh-Hadamard令牌混合器。该混合器在变换域中以对数线性成本全局混合令牌，同时保留了用于左右对应的数据相关交叉注意力。此外，还引入了一种混合对数视差损失函数，以增加对远距离物体（对应于小视差像素）的权重。
AI.result: 在合成驾驶数据集上，WHTMix在端点误差方面达到了与基线注意力相当的性能，同时将模型计算量减少了2.46倍，单图像推理延迟减少了2.65倍。复杂度分析表明，这种方法的优势在于序列长度与通道宽度的比例，这解释了为何高分辨率立体匹配特别适合该方法。混合对数视差损失函数在不增加额外计算开销的情况下，减少了对远处物体的误差。
AI.conclusion: WHTMix通过使用Walsh-Hadamard令牌混合器替代Transformer中的自注意力机制，为立体深度估计提供了一种高效的解决方案。该方法在保持精度的同时，显著降低了计算复杂度和推理延迟，特别适合高分辨率场景。引入的混合对数视差损失函数进一步提高了对远距离物体的估计精度，而无需额外的计算成本。
AI.translation: 立体深度估计在驾驶、机器人和增强现实中必须在高分辨率下以严格的延迟预算运行，然而在基于Transformer的匹配器中，聚合场景上下文的全局自注意力会随着像素数量的增加而二次方增长，并最终主导运行时间。我们表明，立体Transformer的联合自注意力阶段（其作用是在两个视图之间传播上下文）可以用一个与数据无关的Walsh-Hadamard令牌混合器替换，该混合器在变换域中以对数线性成本全局混合令牌，同时保留了执行左右对应的数据相关交叉注意力。在合成驾驶数据上，该混合器在端点误差方面与注意力基线相匹配，同时将模型计算量减少了2.46倍，单图像推理延迟减少了2.65倍。复杂度分析表明，这种优势是由序列长度与通道宽度的比例决定的，这解释了为什么高分辨率立体匹配是一个特别有利的设置，以及为什么分类Transformer不是；我们证实了这种令牌到通道的缩放适用于非立体长序列基准。此外，我们引入了一种混合对数视差损失函数，旨在增加对应于远距离物体的低视差像素的权重。这种方法在不产生任何额外计算开销的情况下，减少了对远处物体的误差。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为WHTMix的新型立体深度估计方法，它用计算效率更高的Walsh-Hadamard令牌混合器取代了Transformer模型中计算密集型的全局自注意力机制。该方法在保持与传统自注意力相当的性能的同时，显著降低了计算量和推理延迟，特别适用于对速度和分辨率要求苛刻的应用场景。此外，研究还引入了一种优化的损失函数，以提高对远距离物体的深度估计精度。
AI.keywords: 立体深度估计,Transformer,Walsh-Hadamard变换,令牌混合,计算效率
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了Walsh-Hadamard变换的计算优势，解决了Transformer在立体深度估计中面临的效率瓶颈。将全局自注意力替换为对数线性的令牌混合，尤其在高分辨率场景下，带来了显著的性能提升。混合对数视差损失函数的引入也为解决长距离物体深度估计的挑战提供了有效的补充。然而，该方法在不同类型数据集上的泛化能力以及在实际部署中的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Static In, Dynamic Out: Counterfactual Action Augmentation for Moving Object Manipulation
summary: Visuomotor policies have advanced on manipulation tasks where the target object stays static during execution, but real deployments break this assumption: parts drift on conveyors and fruits sway in the wind. We introduce Static In, Dynamic Out (SIDO), a counterfactual action augmentation that enables a policy trained only on static object demonstrations to adapt to unseen object motion at test time. Our key idea is to factorize moving object manipulation into two sub-problems: predicting where the object will be, and reaching that predicted pose. SIDO displaces the object to a counterfactual future position and morphs the demonstrated action chunk to preserve the hand-object relative pose, yielding a goal-conditioned policy. At deployment an object pose predictor supplies the future position. Across three simulated tasks (Mug, Square, Stack) under five object motion patterns and two real-world tasks (Gantry, Peachtree), SIDO improves moving object success over the baselines while preserving static object performance. Project website: https://sido-staticindynamicout.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: 静态输入，动态输出：用于移动物体操作的对策动作增强
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为SIDO的对策动作增强方法，使仅在静态物体演示上训练的策略能够适应测试时未知的物体运动。
AI.motivation: 在实际应用中，目标物体在执行过程中可能会发生漂移或摇摆，而现有的视觉运动策略在处理静态目标上表现良好，但在动态场景下能力不足。
AI.method: SIDO将移动物体操作分解为两个子问题：预测物体的未来位置，以及到达该预测位置。它将物体移动到未来的对策位置，并调整演示动作片段以保持手-物相对姿态，从而生成一个目标条件策略。在部署时，一个物体姿态预测器提供未来位置。
AI.result: 在三种模拟任务（Mug、Square、Stack）和两种真实世界任务（Gantry、Peachtree）中，SIDO在五种物体运动模式下均优于基线方法，同时保持了静态物体的性能。
AI.conclusion: SIDO是一种有效的对策动作增强方法，能够使仅在静态物体演示上训练的策略适应动态物体操作，并在各种模拟和真实世界任务中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 视觉运动策略在目标物体在执行过程中保持静态的操作任务上取得了进展，但实际部署打破了这个假设：传送带上的零件会漂移，风中的水果会摇摆。我们引入了静态输入、动态输出（SIDO），一种对策动作增强，使仅在静态物体演示上训练的策略能够在测试时适应未知的物体运动。我们的核心思想是将移动物体操作分解为两个子问题：预测物体将在哪里，以及达到该预测姿态。SIDO将物体位移到对策的未来位置，并改变演示动作块以保持手-物相对姿态，从而产生一个目标条件策略。在部署时，物体姿态预测器提供未来位置。在三种模拟任务（Mug、Square、Stack）下，在五种物体运动模式和两种真实世界任务（Gantry、Peachtree）下，SIDO在移动物体上的成功率优于基线，同时保持了静态物体性能。项目网站：https://sido-staticindynamicout.github.io/。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为SIDO（静态输入，动态输出）的对策动作增强技术，旨在解决机器人操作任务中目标物体运动的问题。该方法将移动物体操作分解为预测物体未来位置和执行到达动作两个步骤，并通过将物体位移到预测的未来位置并调整动作来适应物体运动。实验结果表明，SIDO在多种模拟和真实世界任务中均能有效提升移动物体的操作成功率，同时不影响静态物体的性能。
AI.keywords: 对策动作增强,移动物体操作,视觉运动策略,物体姿态预测,静态输入动态输出（SIDO）
AI.comments: 该研究提出的SIDO方法巧妙地利用了对策学习的思想，通过在训练时引入物体运动的“对策”来增强策略对动态环境的适应性。将复杂问题分解为预测和执行两个子问题是解决该类问题的有效途径。然而，该方法在预测物体未来位置的精度以及对复杂、非线性运动的适应性方面可能存在局限性，这在实际部署中需要进一步考虑。

title: Flow Matching with Missing Data
summary: Flow matching assumes fully observed training data, which many real-world applications rarely provide. We study Missing-Data Flow Matching, which treats the missing coordinates of training samples as latent variables and averages the flow matching loss over the values they could take. We first prove that the oracle correction is exact: completing from the true pattern-conditioned posterior recovers the complete-data flow-matching objective under any missingness mechanism. Under missing completely at random (MCAR) and missing at random (MAR), this posterior equals the ordinary complete-data conditional, while under missing not at random (MNAR) it generally depends on the missingness mechanism and may require additional structure to identify. Our finite-sample analysis then answers design questions that the algorithm leaves open. Missingness transfers estimator variance rather than adding it, and for the fixed-parameter loss estimator one completion per example matches complete-data variance and is optimal under a fixed evaluation budget. A learned completion model contributes population completion bias, which we bound by its expected conditional Wasserstein distance to the true completion law. Experiments numerically validate the theoretical predictions, show that deterministic rather than frozen imputation reduces generated conditional variability, and place our method alongside strong classical and deep imputation baselines on real tabular data.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了缺失数据流匹配（Missing-Data Flow Matching）方法，将缺失的坐标视为潜在变量，并通过对缺失值进行平均来处理缺失数据。研究证明了该方法在MCAR和MAR条件下可以精确恢复完整数据流匹配目标，并在MNAR条件下需要额外的结构。理论分析表明，缺失数据会转移而非增加估计方差，并且在固定参数损失估计器中，每次仅需一个样本即可达到与完整数据相当的方差。实验验证了理论预测，并表明该方法在实际表格数据上表现优于传统和深度插补基线。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的许多应用场景都缺乏完整的数据集，而现有的流匹配方法通常假设数据是完全可观测的，这限制了其在实际中的应用。
AI.method: 提出缺失数据流匹配（Missing-Data Flow Matching）方法，将缺失的坐标视为潜在变量，并通过对缺失值进行平均来处理缺失数据。在理论上，证明了在MCAR和MAR条件下，通过真实模式条件后验（true pattern-conditioned posterior）进行补全是精确的，可以恢复完整数据流匹配目标。对于MNAR条件，后验通常依赖于缺失机制，可能需要额外的结构来识别。对有限样本进行了分析，以回答算法设计问题。
AI.result: 研究表明，缺失数据会转移估计方差而非增加方差。对于固定参数损失估计器，每次使用一个样本进行补全即可匹配完整数据的方差，并且在固定的评估预算下是最优的。学习到的补全模型会引入总体补全偏差，其偏差可以通过与真实补全律的期望条件Wasserstein距离来界定。实验结果在数值上验证了理论预测，表明确定性插补而非冻结插补可以减少生成条件变异性，并且该方法在实际表格数据上与强大的经典和深度插补基线方法相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 缺失数据流匹配是一种处理缺失数据的有效方法，能够在不完全可观测的情况下实现流匹配。该方法在理论上具有保证，并且在实践中表现出色，优于现有基线方法。
AI.translation: 流匹配假设训练数据是完全可观测的，而许多实际应用很少提供这样的数据。我们研究了缺失数据流匹配，它将训练样本的缺失坐标视为潜在变量，并对它们可能取的值平均流匹配损失。我们首先证明了oracle校正是精确的：从真实模式条件后验进行补全可以在任何缺失机制下恢复完整数据流匹配目标。在完全随机缺失（MCAR）和随机缺失（MAR）下，这个后验等于普通的完整数据条件，而在非随机缺失（MNAR）下，它通常取决于缺失机制，并且可能需要额外的结构来识别。然后，我们的有限样本分析回答了算法留下的设计问题。缺失会转移估计方差而不是增加它，并且对于固定参数损失估计器，每个样本一次补全可以匹配完整数据的方差，并在固定的评估预算下是最优的。学习到的补全模型会产生总体补全偏差，我们通过其期望条件Wasserstein距离到真实补全律来界定它。实验在数值上验证了理论预测，表明确定性而非冻结插补可以减少生成的条件变异性，并将我们的方法与真实表格数据上的强大经典和深度插补基线方法相提并论。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了缺失数据流匹配（Missing-Data Flow Matching）方法，以解决现实世界中数据不完全可观测的问题。该方法将缺失的坐标视为潜在变量，并通过对缺失值进行平均来计算流匹配损失。研究证明了该方法在MCAR和MAR条件下可以精确恢复完整数据流匹配目标，并在MNAR条件下具有一定的依赖性。理论分析表明，缺失数据会转移估计方差，并且通过一次样本补全即可达到最优效果。实验结果验证了理论预测，并显示该方法在实际表格数据上的性能优于现有基线方法。
AI.keywords: 缺失数据流匹配, 流匹配, 缺失数据, 潜在变量, 估计方差, 补全偏差, MCAR, MAR, MNAR
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了流匹配在实际应用中的一个关键限制——缺失数据。通过将缺失值视为潜在变量并采用平均损失的方法，该研究为处理不完整数据集提供了新的视角。理论分析的严谨性以及实验结果的有效性，都为该方法的可靠性提供了有力支持。然而，对于MNAR条件下对缺失机制的依赖性以及可能需要的额外结构，是未来研究可以进一步探索的方向。

title: Sharp bounds for non-adaptive randomized approximation of high-dimensional vectors
summary: We study the complexity of approximating the finite-dimensional vector space embedding $\ell_p^m \hookrightarrow \ell_q^m$ for $2 \leq p < q \leq \infty$ based on non-adaptive randomized algorithms that use up to $n$ arbitrary linear functionals as information on a problem instance $x \in \mathbb{R}^m$, where $n \ll m$. We prove lower bounds on the non-adaptive randomized approximation error with a joint dependence on $(n,m)$ matching previously known upper bounds.

AI.title_translation: 高维向量的非自适应随机近似的精确界限
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了非自适应随机算法在嵌入 $\ell_p^m \hookrightarrow \ell_q^m$ $(2 \leq p < q \leq \infty)$ 时的近似误差的下界，该下界与先前已知的上界相匹配。
AI.motivation: 研究高维向量空间嵌入 $\ell_p^m \hookrightarrow \ell_q^m$ $(2 \leq p < q \leq \infty)$ 的近似复杂度，特别是使用非自适应随机算法的情况。
AI.method: 证明了非自适应随机近似误差的下界，该下界联合依赖于 $(n, m)$。
AI.result: 证明了非自适应随机近似误差的下界，该下界联合依赖于 $(n, m)$，并与先前已知的上界相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 非自适应随机算法在嵌入 $\ell_p^m \hookrightarrow \ell_q^m$ $(2 \leq p < q \leq \infty)$ 时的近似误差的下界与上界相匹配。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在非自适应随机算法下，嵌入 $\ell_p^m \hookrightarrow \ell_q^m$ $(2 \leq p < q \leq \infty)$ 的有限维向量空间近似复杂度，该算法使用最多 $n$ 个任意线性函数作为问题实例 $x \in \mathbb{R}^m$ 的信息，其中 $n \ll m$。我们证明了非自适应随机近似误差的下界，该下界联合依赖于 $(n, m)$，并匹配了先前已知的上界。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了使用最多 $n$ 个线性函数（其中 $n \ll m$）的非自适应随机算法来近似高维向量空间嵌入 $\ell_p^m \hookrightarrow \ell_q^m$ $(2 \leq p < q \leq \infty)$ 的问题。研究人员证明了近似误差的下界，该下界联合依赖于 $n$ 和 $m$，并且与先前已知的上界相匹配，表明了该算法的紧界。
AI.keywords: 非自适应随机近似, 高维向量, 向量空间嵌入, 近似复杂度, 线性函数
AI.comments: 这项工作为理解高维向量空间嵌入的非自适应随机近似的复杂度提供了重要的理论界限。联合依赖于 $(n, m)$ 的下界与上界的匹配是一个显著的贡献，突显了该模型下近似的极限。

title: Optimal Unambiguous DNFs and Alon-Saks-Seymour
summary: We construct unambiguous DNFs having width $O(n)$ but $0$-certificate complexity $Ω(n^2)$. By utilizing the special structure of these DNFs, we prove a lifting theorem with a constant-sized gadget that lifts the DNF to a communication problem, while losslessly translating the separation in certificate complexity to a separation in communication complexity. This leads to an optimal refutation of the Alon-Saks-Seymour conjecture, as well as an optimal communication lower bound for the Clique versus Independent Set problem, improving the previous results of Balodis, Ben-David, Göös, Jain and Kothari (FOCS 2021, SICOMP 2023) by several doubly logarithmic factors. As further applications of our construction to query complexity and learning theory, we exhibit: (a) a family of Boolean functions that has an optimal quartic separation between certificate complexity and approximate degree, and (b) a sample compression lower bound of $Ω(\sqrt{\log c})$ for multiclass concept classes over $c$ labels.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构造特殊的无歧义DNF，成功对Alon-Saks-Seymour猜想给出了最优反驳，并大幅改进了通信复杂度和学习理论中的多个核心下界。
AI.motivation: 为了改进先前关于Alon-Saks-Seymour猜想、Clique与Independent Set问题以及证书复杂度的研究结果，消除其中的双对数因子差距。
AI.method: 构造具有特定宽度的无歧义DNF，利用常数大小的gadget证明提升定理，将证书复杂度的分离无损地转化为通信复杂度的分离。
AI.result: 得到了Alon-Saks-Seymour猜想的最优反例，Clique与Independent Set问题的最优通信下界，证书复杂度与近似度的最优四次分离，以及多 multiclass 概念类的样本压缩下界。
AI.conclusion: 本文构造了最优的无歧义DNF并证明了提升定理，成功反驳了Alon-Saks-Seymour猜想，并在通信复杂度、查询复杂度和学习理论中获得了多项最优下界。
AI.translation: 我们构造了宽度为 $O(n)$ 但 $0$-证书复杂度为 $\Omega(n^2)$ 的无歧义DNF。通过利用这些DNF的特殊结构，我们证明了一个带有常数大小gadget的提升定理，该定理将DNF提升为一个通信问题，同时将证书复杂度的分离无损地转化为通信复杂度的分离。这导致了对Alon-Saks-Seymour猜想的最优反驳，以及Clique与Independent Set问题的最优通信下界，将Balodis、Ben-David、Göös、Jain和Kothari（FOCS 2021, SICOMP 2023）先前的工作改进了几个双对数因子。作为我们的构造对查询复杂度和学习理论的进一步应用，我们展示了：(a) 一个布尔函数族，它在证书复杂度和近似度之间具有最优的四次分离；(b) 具有 $c$ 个标签的多分类概念类的 $\Omega(\sqrt{\log c})$ 样本压缩下界。
AI.summary: 本文通过构造具有特定宽度和大0-证书复杂度的无歧义DNF，并结合提升定理，对Alon-Saks-Seymour猜想给出了最优反驳，同时在通信复杂度、查询复杂度和学习理论中取得了多项重大的最优下界突破。
AI.keywords: 无歧义DNF, Alon-Saks-Seymour 猜想, 通信复杂度, 证书复杂度, 提升定理
AI.comments: 本文在组合数学、通信复杂度和学习理论中取得了突破性进展，通过巧妙构造无歧义DNF，完美反驳了Alon-Saks-Seymour猜想，并改善了多项前人的次优界。

title: Don't Regenerate, Debug: A Domain-Specific Agent for Repairing Near-Miss Accelerator Kernels
summary: Kernel generation for hardware accelerators such as GPUs and NPUs has become a proving ground for large language models (LLMs), and state-of-the-art systems raise correctness through pipelines that couple LLMs with agentic reinforcement learning and evolutionary search. Such pipelines generate, compile, and execute large numbers of candidate kernels, discarding most of them and forgoing the opportunity to distill failures into reusable knowledge. Many discarded candidates are near-miss operators that compile and run but fail numerical validation; each embodies genuine domain knowledge and a nontrivial investment in LLM inference, cross-compilation, and hardware execution. We argue for a paradigm shift: rather than regenerate, debug. Debugging is far more constrained than generating from scratch: the search space is small and feedback is dense. We present a domain-specific debug agent that addresses three core challenges in autonomous repair: mitigating knowledge scarcity through retrieved patterns and diagnostic instrumentation, ensuring integrity through anti-cheat detection and full-coverage evaluation, and controlling cost via convergence guards and bounded iteration. Debugging serves two complementary roles: it extends the capability frontier by recovering operators that repeated regeneration fails to produce, and it lowers cost per deliverable operator. Debug Pass@1 achieves 66.7% versus Regenerate Avg Pass@1's 25.9% and Regenerate Pass@3's 40.7%, while consuming 92.8% fewer tokens per success than three-trial regeneration. Component ablations show that the knowledge base drives recovery, while integrity gates reject 12.5-33.3% of the successes the workflow itself accepted.

AI.title_translation: 不要重新生成，去调试：用于修复近失加速器内核的领域特定智能体
AI.tldr: 针对硬件加速器内核生成，提出将丢弃的近失算子进行调试而非盲目重新生成，该方法在提升修复成功率的同时大幅降低了Token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有的硬件加速器内核生成流程会丢弃大量能够编译运行但数值验证失败的“近失”候选算子，造成了计算资源和领域知识的巨大浪费。为此，作者主张从“重新生成”转向“调试”的范式。
AI.method: 提出一个领域特定的调试智能体，通过检索模式与诊断插桩缓解知识稀缺，利用防作弊检测和全覆盖评估确保完整性，并通过收敛保护和有界迭代来控制成本。
AI.result: Debug Pass@1 的成功率达到 66.7%，显著优于多次重新生成的平均 Pass@1（25.9%）和 Pass@3（40.7%），并且每个成功算子消耗的 Token 数量减少了 92.8%。消融实验证明了知识库和完整性门控的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 专用的调试智能体能够有效修复硬件加速器的近失内核，相比于反复重新生成，该方法在大幅提升Pass@1成功率的同时显著降低了Token消耗，实现了性能与成本的双赢。
AI.translation: 诸如GPU和NPU等硬件加速器的内核生成已成为大型语言模型（LLM）的竞技场，其中先进的系统通过将LLM与智能体强化学习及演化搜索相结合的管道来提高正确性。此类管道会生成、编译并执行大量的候选内核，但会丢弃其中大多数，从而错失将失败转化为可复用知识的机会。许多被丢弃的候选者是近失算子（即能够编译和运行但未通过数值验证的算子），每一个都体现了真正的领域知识以及在LLM推理、交叉编译和硬件执行方面的大量投入。我们主张实现范式转变：与其重新生成，不如进行调试。调试受到的限制远比从头生成要小：搜索空间小且反馈密集。我们提出了一种领域特定调试智能体，它解决了自主修复中的三个核心挑战：通过检索到的模式和诊断插桩缓解知识稀缺，通过防作弊检测和全覆盖评估确保完整性，并通过收敛保护和有界迭代控制成本。调试发挥着两个互补的作用：它通过恢复重复重新生成无法产出的算子来扩展能力边界，并降低了每个可交付算子的成本。Debug Pass@1 的准确率达到了 66.7%，而 Regenerate 平均 Pass@1 为 25.9%，Pass@3 为 40.7%，同时每个成功案例消耗的 Token 比三次试验重新生成减少了 92.8%。组件消融实验表明，知识库驱动了恢复，而完整性门控拒绝了工作流本身接受的 12.5%-33.3% 的成功案例。
AI.summary: 本文针对硬件加速器内核生成中由于数值验证失败而丢弃大量近失算子的问题，提出了一种领域特定的调试智能体。该智能体通过检索模式、完整性保证和成本控制，将“重新生成”转变为“调试”，在显著提高修复成功率的同时大幅降低了推理成本。
AI.keywords: 硬件加速器, 内核生成, 大语言模型, 调试智能体, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极具洞察力的范式转变：从“盲目重新生成（Regenerate）”转向“基于调试（Debug）”。通过将因数值验证失败而被丢弃的近失（near-miss）算子转化为调试目标，不仅大幅提升了硬件加速器内核的生成正确率，还极大地降低了LLM的推理成本。这一思想对于大模型在垂直领域（特别是代码生成与硬件加速）的应用具有重要的启发意义。

title: ValueFormer: Stage-Aware Value Labels for Online Failure Detection and VLA Post-Training
comments: Accepted as a poster at the 8th Robot Learning Workshop (WRL) at NeurIPS 2026. 12 pages, 6 figures. Video: https://bit.ly/4i4kWTL
summary: Generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies now transfer to new scenes with little task-specific training, but they still fail silently: from the action stream alone, a collapsing rollout looks much like one making clean progress, because imitation supplies no notion of progress. The cheap alternative, a terminal success / failure bit, is learnable in principle yet too sparse to say when a rollout went wrong. We argue that the per-frame label is the hard part, and that it works better when continuous and non-monotonic: a score rather than a single success or failure, and one free to fall and then rise again as a rollout goes wrong and recovers. Such a label is cheap to obtain: a person marks only the stage at which an episode went wrong, and the per-frame values are computed from that. We present ValueFormer, a policy-agnostic causal transformer (3.5M parameters) over a frozen DINOv3 backbone, emitting two per-frame signals in one forward pass: a smooth Monte Carlo value for advantage estimation and a sharp binary value for online mistake detection. Failed episodes carry a stage-aware, success-then-decay return. A teleoperation station already records an intervention flag; reusing it lifts held-out detection from 0.38 to 0.82 average precision and flags 95% of mistakes before the operator reacts. On a real bimanual sandwich station, feeding the critic back as a per-frame post-training weight raises task completion from 70% to 85% and removes a repeat-pick failure mode in our trials, although at n=20 that gain sits within noise.
comment: Accepted as a poster at the 8th Robot Learning Workshop (WRL) at NeurIPS 2026. 12 pages, 6 figures. Video: https://bit.ly/4i4kWTL

AI.title_translation: ValueFormer：用于在线故障检测和VLA后训练的阶段感知价值标签
AI.tldr: ValueFormer通过引入阶段感知的每帧连续价值标签，解决了机器人VLA策略的“沉默失败”问题，大幅提升了在线故障检测的准确性和策略后训练的性能。
AI.motivation: 通用的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在迁移到新场景时往往会“沉默失败”，因为模仿学习不提供进度概念，而传统的终止成功/失败比特过于稀疏，无法准确指出执行过程中的出错时刻。
AI.method: 提出ValueFormer，这是一个基于冻结的DINOv3骨干网络的3.5M参数的策略无关因果Transformer，通过人工标记的错误阶段计算每帧价值，在单次前向传播中输出用于优势估计的平滑蒙特卡洛价值和用于在线错误检测的尖锐二元价值。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于保持集检测时，平均精度从0.38提升至0.82，并在操作员反应前标记了95%的错误；在真实双臂三明治制作任务中，将任务完成率从70%提升至85%，消除了重复抓取失败模式。
AI.conclusion: ValueFormer通过阶段感知的连续价值标签，有效解决了VLA策略中缺乏进度感知和故障检测稀疏的问题，显著提升了在线故障检测能力和任务完成率。
AI.translation: 通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略现在能够以很少的任务特定训练迁移到新场景，但它们仍然会默默失败：仅从动作流来看，崩溃的轨迹看起来与进展顺利的轨迹非常相似，因为模仿不提供进度概念。廉价的替代方案——终端成功/失败位，原则上是可以学习的，但太稀疏，无法说明轨迹何时出错。我们认为每帧标签是困难的部分，当它连续且非单调时效果更好：一个分数而不是单一的成功或失败，并且在轨迹出错又恢复时可以自由下降和上升。这样一个标签获取成本低：一个人只需标记剧集出错的阶段，每帧价值就可以据此计算出来。我们提出了ValueFormer，这是一个基于冻结的DINOv3骨干网络的策略无关因果Transformer（3.5M参数），在一次前向传播中发出两个每帧信号：用于优势估计的平滑蒙特卡洛价值和用于在线错误检测的尖锐二元价值。失败的剧集带有阶段感知的、先成功后衰减的回报。遥操作站已经记录了干预标志；重复使用它将保留集的检测平均精度从0.38提升到0.82，并在操作员反应之前标记了95%的错误。在一个真实的两手三明治工作站上，将评论家反馈作为每帧后训练权重，在我们的试验中将任务完成了从70%提高到85%，并消除了重复抓取的失败模式，尽管在n=20时该增益在噪声范围内。
AI.summary: ValueFormer是一种阶段感知的价值标签方法，旨在解决在线故障检测和VLA策略后训练问题。它通过利用人类标记的错误阶段计算连续且非单调的每帧价值，使用一个3.5M参数的Transformer模型输出平滑的蒙特卡洛价值和二元价值，从而显著提高了故障检测的准确率和任务完成率。
AI.keywords: ValueFormer, Vision-Language-Action, 故障检测, 策略后训练, 阶段感知价值
AI.comments: ValueFormer提出了一种新颖的阶段感知价值标签方法，解决了VLA策略在执行过程中“沉默失败”的痛点。通过利用人工标记的错误阶段来计算连续、非单调的每帧价值，该方法在在线故障检测和后训练加权方面展示了极高的效率和有效性，具有很强的实用价值。

title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
summary: Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five domains, each with 100 tasks ordered by difficulty and opportunities for skill transfer. Our experiments show that sequential execution generally improves performance, but the gains vary substantially across models and domains. Moreover, across two models and three domains, retaining context and feedback without skill maintenance yields nearly the same mean performance as maintaining an explicit skill library. Explicit skills nevertheless provide selective benefits for tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. We further find that the weaker model (GPT-4o) accumulates more skills but reuses them less often, suggesting difficulty consolidating task-specific experience into reusable procedures. These findings show that current in-context skill evolution mechanisms can support continual adaptation, but still struggle to consistently consolidate experience into robust and transferable skills.

AI.title_translation: 持续技能基准：LLM代理能否真正进化其能力？
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了ContinualSkillBench，一个用于评估LLM代理在上下文持续学习和进化技能能力的框架。实验表明，虽然持续学习通常能提高性能，但模型和领域间的增益差异很大。与显式维护技能库相比，仅保留上下文和反馈也能获得相似的性能，但显式技能库在需要可重用程序或精确输出的任务上具有优势。较弱模型（GPT-4o）虽然能累积更多技能，但重用率较低，表明其在将任务特定经验转化为可重用程序方面存在困难。总体而言，当前的上下文技能进化机制支持持续适应，但在将经验巩固为鲁棒和可迁移技能方面仍有不足。
AI.motivation: 评估LLM代理在上下文持续学习和进化技能方面的能力，以及这些进化的技能是否能真正提高解决任务的能力。
AI.method: 提出ContinualSkillBench，一个动态评估框架，包含五个领域，每个领域有100个按难度和技能转移机会排序的任务，用于评估LLM在上下文中的持续技能学习能力。
AI.result: 序列执行通常能提高性能，但增益因模型和领域而异。在两个模型和三个领域中，仅保留上下文和反馈的性能与维护显式技能库的性能几乎相同。显式技能库在需要可重用程序或精确输出的任务上具有选择性优势。GPT-4o（较弱模型）积累了更多技能但重用较少，表明其在巩固任务特定经验为可重用程序方面存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 当前的上下文技能进化机制能够支持持续适应，但在将经验巩固为鲁棒和可迁移技能方面仍然存在挑战。
AI.translation: 现代代理框架为大型语言模型配备了外部技能库来解决复杂任务。然而，这些系统是否能有效地进化它们的技能，以及由此产生的技能是否能提高解决任务的能力，仍然不清楚。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了ContinualSkillBench，一个用于上下文持续技能学习的动态评估框架。它涵盖了五个领域，每个领域有100个按难度和技能转移机会排序的任务。我们的实验表明，序列执行通常能提高性能，但增益因模型和领域而异。此外，在两个模型和三个领域中，仅保留上下文和反馈而不维护技能，其平均性能几乎与维护显式技能库相同。尽管如此，显式技能在需要可重用程序或精确输出的任务上提供了选择性优势。我们还发现，较弱的模型（GPT-4o）积累了更多的技能，但重用得更少，这表明其在将任务特定经验巩固为可重用程序方面存在困难。这些发现表明，当前的上下文技能进化机制能够支持持续适应，但仍然难以将经验持续巩固为鲁棒和可迁移的技能。
AI.summary: ContinualSkillBench是一个新的评估框架，用于衡量大型语言模型（LLM）代理在上下文学习和进化其技能方面的能力。研究发现，虽然持续学习通常能提升LLM代理的性能，但效果因模型和任务领域而异。与显式维护技能库相比，仅依靠上下文和反馈也能达到相似的性能水平，尽管显式技能库在特定类型的任务（如需要可重用程序或精确输出的任务）中表现更优。此外，研究还观察到，较弱的模型在积累和重用技能方面存在挑战，这表明当前的技能进化机制在将经验转化为稳健且可迁移的技能方面仍需改进。
AI.keywords: 持续学习, LLM代理, 技能进化, ContinualSkillBench, 上下文学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个新颖的评估框架ContinualSkillBench，解决了LLM代理技能进化能力评估的空白。研究结果揭示了当前LLM代理在持续学习和技能巩固方面的优势与局限性，特别是模型间的差异以及显式技能库与上下文学习的权衡。这些发现对于未来开发更具适应性和鲁棒性的LLM代理具有重要意义。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索不同技能表示方式和学习机制对技能巩固的影响。

title: Multi-Modal, Multi-Temporal Geospatial Foundation Models Improve Global Above-Ground Biomass Estimation
summary: Accurate estimation of above-ground biomass (AGB) from satellite imagery is essential for the large-scale monitoring of carbon stocks, yet it remains a challenging regression task at global scale. Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising machine learning paradigm to derive general-purpose representations from Earth observation (EO) data, but their utility for quantitative regression tasks like biomass estimation remains largely unexplored, as most benchmarks focus on classification and segmentation. Here, we benchmark 13 GFMs for above-ground biomass estimation, specifically GEDI L4A biomass values. We compare them against a fully supervised state-of-the-art (SOTA) baseline trained on A Global-scale Biomass Dataset (AGBD), a machine learning-ready benchmark spanning diverse biomes and geographies. Most of the GFMs evaluated substantially underperform with respect to the supervised baseline, whether frozen or fine-tuned; only TESSERA and AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) features with certain prediction heads yield a better performance. Our SOTA model trained on AEF embeddings and selected raw EO features achieves the best overall result (RMSE of 50.79 Mg/ha vs. 53.73 Mg/ha on AGBD features). This feature combination also generalizes better than AGBD features: it reduces RMSE by up to 25% in selected regions excluded from training, and, trained on single-year data alone, it outperforms the model trained on multi-year AGBD features. With labels from only 11 regions around the world, the AEF-based model also performs on par with the globally calibrated ESA CCI biomass product on independent reference plots. These findings indicate that GFM features can be highly informative for biomass estimation, when the underlying model is trained on rich multi-modal data.

AI.title_translation: 多模态、多时空地理空间基础模型改进全球地上生物量估算
AI.tldr: 该研究评估了13种地理空间基础模型（GFMs）在估算全球地上生物量（AGB）方面的表现，发现大多数GFMs表现不佳，但TESSERA和AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）表现出潜力。结合AEF嵌入和精选的原始地球观测（EO）数据训练的模型取得了最佳结果，并且在特定区域表现出更好的泛化能力，甚至在仅使用单年数据的情况下也优于多年度数据集训练的模型。
AI.motivation: 准确估算地上生物量（AGB）对于全球碳储量监测至关重要，但这是一个具有挑战性的回归任务。虽然地理空间基础模型（GFMs）在地球观测（EO）数据中提取通用表示方面显示出潜力，但它们在生物量估算等定量回归任务中的应用仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 对13种地理空间基础模型（GFMs）进行基准测试，以估算地上生物量（AGB），特别是GEDI L4A生物量值。将它们与在AGBD（一个包含多样化生物群落和地理区域的机器学习就绪基准）上训练的完全监督的SOTA基线进行比较。在AEF嵌入和选定的原始EO特征上训练的模型被用于实现最佳结果。
AI.result: 大多数GFMs的表现均显著低于监督基线。TESSERA和AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）特征与特定的预测头相结合，表现出更好的性能。在AEF嵌入和选定的原始EO特征上训练的SOTA模型取得了最佳的整体结果（RMSE为50.79 Mg/ha，而AGBD特征为53.73 Mg/ha）。这种特征组合的泛化能力优于AGBD特征，在排除在训练之外的特定区域可将RMSE降低高达25%。仅使用单年数据训练的模型也优于使用多年度AGBD特征训练的模型。基于AEF的模型在独立参考样地上，其表现与全球校准的ESA CCI生物量产品相当。
AI.conclusion: 地理空间基础模型（GFMs）的特征，特别是那些在丰富的多模态数据上训练的模型，对于生物量估算非常有信息量。尽管大多数GFMs在此任务上表现不佳，但TESSERA和AEF显示出潜力，并且结合AEF嵌入和精选的原始EO数据可以实现最先进的生物量估算性能，并具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 准确估算地上生物量（AGB）对于大规模监测碳储量至关重要，但它仍然是全球范围内一项具有挑战性的回归任务。地理空间基础模型（GFMs）最近作为一种有前景的机器学习范式出现，可以从地球观测（EO）数据中提取通用表示，但它们在定量回归任务（如生物量估算）中的效用在很大程度上仍未得到探索，因为大多数基准测试都侧重于分类和分割。在这里，我们对13种GFMs进行基准测试，以估算地上生物量（AGB），特别是GEDI L4A生物量值。我们将它们与在AGBD（一个机器学习就绪的、跨越不同生物群落和地理区域的基准）上训练的完全监督的SOTA基线进行比较。大多数经过评估的GFMs，无论是在冻结还是微调的情况下，其表现都明显低于监督基线；只有TESSERA和AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）特征与特定的预测头相结合才能产生更好的性能。我们在AEF嵌入和选定的原始EO特征上训练的SOTA模型取得了最佳的整体结果（RMSE为50.79 Mg/ha，而AGBD特征为53.73 Mg/ha）。这种特征组合的泛化能力也优于AGBD特征：在排除在训练之外的特定区域，它可将RMSE降低高达25%，并且仅使用单年数据训练的模型，其性能优于使用多年度AGBD特征训练的模型。仅使用全球11个地区的标签，基于AEF的模型在独立参考样地上也与全球校准的ESA CCI生物量产品相媲美。这些发现表明，当底层模型在丰富的多模态数据上进行训练时，GFM特征对于生物量估算可能具有高度信息量。
AI.summary: 这项研究评估了13种地理空间基础模型（GFMs）在估算全球地上生物量（AGB）方面的表现，重点关注GEDI L4A数据。研究发现，大多数GFMs的表现不如传统的监督学习方法。然而，TESSERA和AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）模型表现出一定的潜力。最终，结合AEF嵌入和精选的原始地球观测（EO）数据训练的模型取得了最佳的估算结果（RMSE为50.79 Mg/ha），并且在泛化能力和在特定区域的性能方面优于使用标准AGBD数据集训练的模型。该研究强调了在丰富多模态数据上训练的GFMs在改进AGB估算方面的潜力。
AI.keywords: 地上生物量估算, 地理空间基础模型, AlphaEarth Foundations, 多模态数据, GEDI
AI.comments: 这项研究首次对多种地理空间基础模型（GFMs）在地上生物量（AGB）估算任务上的表现进行了全面的基准测试，为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的参考。研究结果表明，虽然当前大多数GFMs在此任务上表现不佳，但TESSERA和AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）展现出巨大的潜力，特别是当结合多模态数据和先进的训练策略时。该研究强调了多模态数据融合和模型架构选择对于提高AGB估算精度和泛化能力的重要性。未来的研究可以进一步探索更先进的GFM架构，以及更有效的微调策略，以充分发挥GFMs在地球科学定量应用中的潜力。

title: A priori error estimator for reduced-order models based on the higher-order Craig-Bampton method in dynamic substructuring
summary: The higher-order Craig-Bampton (HCB) method improves reduced-model accuracy through successive residual-mode enrichments. This study proposes an a priori estimator for the eigenvalue error remaining in the first-order HCB model (HCB-1) without using the full-order eigensolution. The estimator is defined as the relative difference between the HCB-1 and HCB-2 eigenvalues. Under symmetric Ritz approximation assumptions, ordered positive eigenvalues, nested augmented spaces, and preservation of retained eigenvalues by the System Equivalent Reduction Expansion Process (SEREP), the estimator is shown to be non-negative and to provide a lower bound on the relative HCB-1 eigenvalue error. A projection-based expression and an exact error identity are also derived, clarifying the conditions under which the estimator is accurate and showing that the lower-bound property alone does not guarantee a prescribed tolerance. Numerical results for a plate, an elbow pipe, and a reactor pressure vessel show estimation-to-error ratios of about 0.85-0.99, while a cost assessment reports the additional expense associated with the HCB-2 reference solution.

AI.title_translation: 动力子结构中基于高阶Craig-Bampton方法的降阶模型先验误差估计器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需全阶求解的先验误差估计器，用于高效评估高阶Craig-Bampton降阶模型的特征值误差。
AI.motivation: 为了在不使用全阶特征解的前提下，高效地估计动力子结构中降阶模型（基于一阶高阶Craig-Bampton方法）所剩余的特征值误差。
AI.method: 通过计算第一阶和第二阶HCB模型特征值的相对差来定义估计器，在特定Ritz近似假设和嵌套空间下推导其非负性、下界性质、基于投影的表达式以及精确误差恒等式。
AI.result: 证明了该估计器是非负的且提供了相对一阶HCB特征值误差的下界；数值实验（板、弯管、反应堆压力容器）表明其估计误差比约为0.85-0.99，并对其计算成本进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种针对一阶HCB模型特征值误差的有效先验估计器，通过理论和数值算例证明了其高精度与实用性。
AI.translation: 高阶Craig-Bampton (HCB) 方法通过连续的残差模态丰富来提高降阶模型的准确性。本研究提出了一种针对第一阶HCB模型（HCB-1）中剩余特征值误差的先验估计器，且无需使用全阶特征解。该估计器定义为HCB-1和HCB-2特征值之间的相对差。在对称Ritz近似假设、有序正特征值、嵌套增广空间以及系统等效约简扩展过程（SEREP）对保留特征值的保持下，证明了该估计器是非负的，并且为相对HCB-1特征值误差提供了下界。此外，还推导了基于投影的表达式和精确误差恒等式，阐明了估计器准确的条件，并表明仅靠下界属性不能保证达到规定的公差。针对平板、弯管和反应堆压力容器的数值结果表明，估计与误差的比率约为0.85-0.99，同时成本评估报告了与HCB-2参考解相关的额外开销。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种针对动态子结构中高阶Craig-Bampton降阶模型的先验特征值误差估计器。该估计器无需全阶特征解，通过一阶和二阶HCB模型的特征值相对差来定义。理论和多项数值算例均证明了其作为误差下界的有效性和高准确性。
AI.keywords: 高阶Craig-Bampton方法, 动力子结构, 先验误差估计, 特征值误差, 降阶模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对动力子结构中的高阶Craig-Bampton (HCB) 方法，创新性地提出了一种无需全阶特征解的先验特征值误差估计器。理论分析严密，并通过多个工程算例验证了其高效性和准确性，对降阶模型误差控制具有重要意义。

title: M$^3$R-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Metaphor Understanding
comments: 21 pages, 15 figures and 11 tables (including appendices). Hong Jiang, Junnan Zhu, and Jingwang Huang contributed equally. Jiang Zhong and Kaiwen Wei are corresponding authors. Code and data are available at https://github.com/hongshi4/m3r-bench-artifact
summary: Multimodal metaphor understanding requires identifying cross-domain Target-Source mappings and inferring sentiment from visual and textual evidence. However, existing benchmarks largely evaluate these subtasks separately and lack evidence-grounded explanations, limiting their ability to assess coherent cross-modal reasoning. To enable unified and evidence-grounded evaluation, we introduce M$^3$R-Bench, a benchmark of 1,000 human-annotated image-text instances with joint labels for metaphor occurrence, Target-Source mapping, and sentiment, alongside stage-wise explanations for evidence identification, mapping establishment, and sentiment inference. Evaluations reveal that existing models frequently rely on textual shortcuts and produce Target-Source mappings inconsistent with visual evidence. To address this evidence-mapping mismatch, we propose M$^3$R-Reasoner, which combines curriculum-based reasoning supervision with task-aware reinforcement learning. Built on an 8B-parameter backbone, M$^3$R-Reasoner achieves 37.90% Joint Label Accuracy (JLA) metric, outperforming the strongest proprietary baseline by 19.50 percentage points. It further surpasses GPT-5.5 in image-text evidence and sentiment justification scores by 28.45 and 28.11 points, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/hongshi4/m3r-bench-artifact.
